product_name: Infinite Sterling Silver Lab-grown Diamond Ring
description: A solid sterling silver ring hand set with a 0.15 carat lab-grown diamond.  A beautiful statement of empowerment and possibility, or a simple yet eloquent declaration of love.   This ring features a scintillating round brilliant excellent cut lab-grown diamond in a modern infinity setting that flows seamlessly around the stone. It can be worn alone or stacked with other rings from the Infinite collection. Extra sizes now available so you can find the perfect fit. Featuring a row of sparkling clear cubic zirconia, this piece is sure to become a staple in your jewellery box that you reach for over and over again. product_name: Moments Heart Closure Snake Chain Bracelet

product_name: Signature Two-tone Logo T-Bar Snake Chain Bracelet

product_name: Limited Edition Moments Sparkling Snowflake Clasp Bangle
description: Catch a falling snowflake and wear it at the centre of your story. product_name: Moments Peace Knot T-bar Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Wear an icon of luck with our Moments Peace Knot T-bar Snake Chain Bracelet. Inspired by a traditional Chinese peace knot, this 14k rose gold-plated bracelet features an intricately-shaped openwork clasp flush-set with four clear cubic zirconia and secured with a T-bar closure. Style it with up to 16-18 of your favourite charms, dangle charms or pendants.

For a mother like no other, give a bangle that will symbolise her uniqueness. Crafted from sterling silver, this meaningful bracelet features a heart-shaped clasp that puts love at the centre, decorated with openwork detail that emulates the one-of-a-kind wings of a butterfly. Finished with a sparkling cubic zirconia at its centre, the bangle can hold up to 16-18 charms and would make a perfect gift for the mother figure in your life this Mother's Day.

We recommend adding charms with silicone grips or safety chains to secure your styling.

product_name: Limited Edition Moments Sparkling Shooting Star Clasp Bangle
description: Bring celestial energy to your everyday style with the Moments Sparkling Shooting Star Clasp Bangle. Featuring a barrel clasp with a pavé-covered shooting star swirling around it, this 14k rose gold-plated bangle is ready for you to make it your own. Style this shooting star bracelet with a selection of your favourite charms and wear it as to symbolise bringing good luck, hope and serendipity into your life.

Make minimal stacking your mantra with the Signature Two-tone I-D Pavé Bangle. The minimalist bracelet is crafted from two metal finishes; sterling silver and a 14k rose gold-plated unique metal blend. The band's profile transitions from square to round; the squared half features evenly spaced sparkling baguette stones, while the rounded part is warm-toned. The engraved logo on the side corresponds with the placement of the baguette stones. The unique hinge and click closure clasp make it easy to wear and remove this bangle bracelet. Wear alone as your signature piece, or stack multiple bracelets for a bold look.

product_name: Signature Two Two-tone Logo & Pavé Chain Bracelet
description: Build your look around the Signature Two Two-tone Logo & Pavé Chain Bracelet. Crafted in both sterling silver and our 14k rose gold-plated unique metal blend, this chain bracelet features a two-tone circular motif in the middle, accentuated with a row of sparkle and microbeads in its centre. The back is polished and its sides are engraved with two logos. Thanks to its openwork D-ring, the motif is free to spin with your every move. An essential piece in every collection, this easy-to-wear style is set to become your most hard-working bracelet yet.

product_name: Moments Heart Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Make your story shine with the Moments Heart Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet. Our iconic snake chain bracelet gets a gleaming update in 14k rose gold plating, with a polished heart-shaped clasp. The clasp includes an engraved logo on one side and the Crown O logo on the other. Style this snake chain bracelet with up to 16 to 18 charms for an iconic everyday look that is all yours.

Our Studded Chain Slider Bracelet is the ultimate versatile carrier, adjustable to any length thanks to its slider clasp. Crafted in 14k rose gold plating, one size fits all. The bracelet has a flexible core for easy movement, while its sliding silicone ball on the slimmer chain allows for size adjustment, so you can find your perfect fit every time. Customise yours with up to 10 charms or dangle charms of your choice to make it extra personal.

Celebrate the power of love with our Moments Encircled Clasp Bangle, a shimmering statement piece plated with 14k rose gold. Featuring an encircled clasp, the bangle is a symbol of infinite connections. The openwork design of the clasp with encircled lines on both sides is highlighted by a clear cubic zirconia and symbolically captures the essence of forever. Playfully versatile, you can style it with up to 14-18 charms, celebrating your life's most important moments. This style features no threaders, just smooth end caps to frame your favourite charms.

This blush pink snake chain bracelet is a new take on a best-selling style. Crafted in PANDORA Rose, the new ESSENCE COLLECTION arrival is perfect for making chic, feminine statements. Please note, only Me and ESSENCE charms will fit this bracelet.

product_name: Moments Pavé Heart Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Put some love in your look with our classic Moments Pavé Heart Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet that's been given a romantic update with a heart-shaped, 14k rose gold-plated clasp. Wear yours solo or stack with other charm bracelets, adding favourite charms to suit your mood.

Hand-finished and 14k rose gold-plated – it features interchangeable end caps set with shimmering stones and an innovative sliding clasp that makes it easy to adjust. The perfect present for friends and loved ones, it can be worn as it is or filled with your favourite charms. The lobster clasp and jump ring are made from sterling silver plated with 14k rose gold.

Adding polished edge to any look, try using silicone-lined clips to space out charms or dare to bare and wear it solo.

The 14k rose gold-plated unique metal blend glows with a blush-pink hue. Wear it solo or layer with similar pieces from our collection to create a look that's naturally you.

product_name: Moments Heraldic Radiance Padlock Clasp Bracelet

product_name: Limited Edition Moments Entwined Infinite Hearts Clasp Bangle
description: Inspired by love, the Moments Entwined Infinite Hearts Clasp Bangle features eight clear cubic zirconia on a sterling silver heart that’s encased by the outline of another heart. The engraving reads: "Forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever." Wear the bangle on its own or style it with up to 18 charms, dangle charms or pendants to tell your story.

product_name: Moments Star Wars™ Light & Dark Side Logo Open Bangle
description: Celebrate the Force with this Moments Star Wars™ Light & Dark Side Logo Open Bangle. One end of the bangle is set with blue man-made crystals to create the Rebel Alliance logo, while the other features red man-made crystals in the shape of the symbol for the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker's iconic lightsaber is engraved across the inside of the bangle, while the outside reads "MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU, ALWAYS". Show your allegiance to Star Wars™ everywhere you go with this detailed celebration of the Force, or gift it to the Star Wars™ fan in your life.

Fall in love many times over with the Sparkling Endless Hearts Chain Bracelet. This tennis bracelet-inspired design features six heart-shaped clear cubic zirconia set in alternating directions. A small heart-shaped stone dangles beside the lobster clasp to add extra sparkle. Wear it on its own or stack bracelets of different colours and metal finishes for a modern look.

Tennis bracelets, anyone? This sterling silver Sparkling Tennis Bracelet features squared collets and is decorated with a bold line of clear cubic zirconia to make a statement fit for any occasion. Wear it on its own or stack bracelets of different colours and metal finishes for a modern look.

Our reimagined classic tennis bracelet is crafted from sterling silver and features a sparkling row of 34 prong-set round brilliant-cut royal blue man-made crystals. Designed with layering in mind, this is the ultimate piece to add scale and depth to your stacks with its larger stone size. Wear yours as a sparkling statement all season and beyond, or wrap it up as a glittering surprise for the one you love.

Our braided leather bracelet gets an update with a sterling silver T-bar closure featuring our iconic snake-chain pattern. Loop the T-bar through the smallest circle inside the large snake chain ring to make sure that the bracelet clasp is securely closed. As leather is a natural material, normal wear and tear may occur over time. Style up to 9 charms on the leather bracelet to add an edge to your look.

product_name: Moments Pavé Heart Clasp Snake Chain Slider Bracelet
description: A heart is the ultimate symbol to express love: for life, for another or to symbolise self-love. Let love guide your charm collection displayed on the Moments Pavé Heart Clasp Snake Chain Slider Bracelet. Hand-finished in sterling silver, add a little sparkle to your day with 174 pavé-set round brilliant-cut clear cubic zirconia covering both the heart clasp and the ends of the chain. To add charms, click the openable end cap on the side of the bracelet and slide them on. Please note, the end cap on the other side does not open.

product_name: Moments Disney Stitch Biting Clasp Bangle
description: Our classic Moments bangle gets an update thanks to Disney's much-loved Stitch. The mischievous character from Disney's Lilo & Stitch is biting the ball clasp of this sterling silver bangle (incorporated as part of the clasp). The message "Love at first bite" is engraved on the inside of the bangle. The bangle can be styled with up to 16-18 charms, dangle charms or pendants - it's the perfect home for your Disney x charm collection.

product_name: Treated Freshwater Cultured Pearl Blue Cord Chain Bracelet
description: Introducing the perfect pearl statement to layer into your looks. Inspired by sunny days on the beach, one half of this pearl bracelet features a row of treated freshwater cultured pearls strung onto knotted blue cord. The other half is a sterling silver chain with an easy lobster clasp closure, featuring a small disc near the clasp engraved with the Crown O. Note: normal wear and tear may occur with natural materials such as treated freshwater cultured pearls. The relevant treatments for treated freshwater cultured pearls are bleaching or dyeing and lustre enhancement.

The one-clip bracelet is made from several delicate chains of sterling silver which are connected by a barrel clasp. There is the option to add one of your favourite PANDORA clips to personalise your bracelet. PLEASE NOTE: ONLY CLIPS MAY BE WORN ON THIS BRACELET. CHARMS AND SPACERS WILL NOT FIT ON THE ONE-CLIP BRACELET.

A beautiful chain bracelet with the option to add up to five of your beloved PANDORA clips! Made from sterling silver, the bracelet has a PANDORA barrel clasp to keep it secure on your wrist. It would make the perfect gift for someone special. PLEASE NOTE: ONLY CLIPS MAY BE WORN ON THIS BRACELET. CHARMS AND SPACERS WILL NOT FIT ON THIS BRACELET.

product_name: Infinite Sterling Silver Lab-grown Diamond Bangle
description: Celebrate your power to shine with this sterling silver bangle, hand-set with a radiant 0.15 carat lab-grown diamond. The round brilliant excellent cut lab-grown diamond floats inside our unique infinity motif, which flows around the stone as if it's ethereally suspended in mid-air. Our closed bangle design features a slender profile and functional hinge and clasp mechanisms, promising security and comfort. We recommend handling it with extra care to ensure optimal functionality and longevity. Let yours shine alone or inspire an elevated everyday stack. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing. Since August 2022, all Lab-Grown Diamonds have been grown, cut and polished using 100% renewable energy and set in 100% recycled silver and gold. Infinite pieces crafted prior to this date are still sold in the United Kingdom and Australia. The lab-grown diamonds in these pieces were grown using more than 60% renewable energy on average and set in a mix of recycled and non-recycled silver and gold.

product_name: Era Bezel Sterling Silver Lab-grown Diamond Chain Bracelet
description: Meet your new essential lab-grown diamond bracelet. The Era Bezel Sterling Silver Lab-grown Diamond Chain Bracelet features a single 0.15 carat lab-grown diamond at its centre, in a sterling silver bezel setting with a sleek, contemporary aesthetic. Cut-outs on the back and sides of the bezel setting let in the light for ultimate sparkle. The lab-grown diamond is fixed to a sterling silver diamond-cut cable chain with faceted links that reflect the light, lending the bracelet a subtle shimmer. Adjustable to two lengths, this sterling silver bracelet is the perfect elevated staple for your everyday looks.

product_name: Keith Haring™ x Moments Radiant Heart Snake Chain Bracelet​
description: Bring an artistic touch to your everyday looks with our Keith Haring™ x Moments Radiant Heart Snake Chain Bracelet​. With one of the artist's iconic radiating heart motifs as the clasp, think of this artistic bracelet as your canvas, ready to be filled with your creativity. The artist's signature bold lines and graphic style has been recreated using black and pink enamel to achieve the heart clasp. Embrace the art of individual styling with this collector's item and add your favourite Keith Haring™ x charms as a constant reminder that art is for everyone. The jewellery comes in a distinct packaging that echoes the artist’s colour palate and style, making it a truly must have. product_name: Moments O Closure Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Say hello to a whole new level of customisation. Crafted from sterling silver, our fresh take on a much-loved design features The brand's iconic snake chain pattern and a round closure. The closure can hold up to two dangles or pendants and spins for a touch of dynamic movement. Style this iconic bracelet with your favourite charms and create a personalised look.

product_name: Limited Edition Moments Sparkling Snowflake Clasp Bangle
description: Catch a falling snowflake and wear it at the centre of your story. This limited edition detailed sterling silver bracelet features a special snowflake motif as its clasp, with intricate openwork details, creating a wintry effect. Small faceted and cut-out snowflake shapes reach out from the centre of the snowflake, creating a magical winter look to bring a unique touch to your holiday styling.

product_name: Moments Marvel Spider-Man Mask Clasp Bangle
description: Gather your ultimate team of heroes with our Moments Marvel Spider-Man Mask Clasp Bangle. Collect all of the Spider-Man charms and style them on this sterling silver bangle with Spider-Man's mask at the centre. The stylised heart clasp features bright enamel details to recreate the characteristic mask, while the bangle is engraved with the iconic quote "With great power comes great responsiblity". Style yours with up to 18 charms, dangle charms or pendants and let your strengths shine.

Link what you love like never before. Our sterling silver ME XS-Link Chain Bracelet holds endless styling possibilities, with more dimensions of links than ever before. The design features two larger openable links separated by a double openable link, a line of slimmer link chains and a carabiner clasp closure. First customise your link chain: four links can be swapped out for one openable double link or one openable link - keep the original length or adjust it to suit you. Once you’ve curated your link chain, style up to two meaningful medallion charms or up to eight mini dangle charms on each openable link to show the world who you are. NOTE: medallion charms with openable tops can be styled on closed styling links.

product_name: Moments Disney Aladdin Princess Jasmine Bangle
description: Style your love for Disney's Princess Jasmine at the centre of your story, with this bangle inspired by the Disney classic: Aladdin. Crafted from sterling silver, the bangle can be styled with your favourite Disney x charms. The design features an exclusive clasp inspired by the Agrabah kingdom, set with an oval moonlight blue stone, inspired by Princess Jasmine herself. Complete with the engraving "It's all so magical", make your own wishes come true with this meaningful piece, or gift it to an Aladdin fan to take their jewellery into a new world.

product_name: Moments Asymmetric Star T-bar Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Our Moments Asymmetric Star T-bar Snake Chain Bracelet puts starry magic at the centre of your styling. This celestial-inspired design features an asymmetric star T-bar clasp in polished sterling silver, carefully detailed by hand with rows of clear cubic zirconia pavé and a cut-out star in the centre and featuring the engraved message "Make a wish." Inspired by the sparkle of the night sky, gift this special charm holder to a loved one as a reminder that organic, asymmetrical imperfection is beautiful and to always reach for the stars.

Bring the beauty of nature to your jewellery with our Sparkling Herbarium Cluster Stud Earrings. These sterling silver studs feature three pear and marquise-shaped stones around a round centre stone, forming a geometric shape inspired by petal and leaf elements. An elegant reinterpretation of the shapes we find in nature, these sparkling studs are perfect for bringing a delicate, floating feel to your everyday looks.

Make your holiday season sparkle. This sterling silver Sparkling Drops Tennis Bracelet is made up of a row of sparkling round brilliant cut cubic zirconia, decorated with dangling stones along the chain to make a statement fit for any occasion. Wear it on its own or stack bracelets of different colours and metal finishes for a modern look.

product_name: Red Sparkling Round Pavé Tennis Bracelet
description: Bring elegance to your outfit with the Red Sparkling Round Pavé Tennis Bracelet. Crafted from sterling silver, this tennis bracelet features a large central round brilliant-cut man-made crystal in a beautiful rich red, framed by a row of clear cubic zirconia pavé. The bracelet includes a lobster clasp for safe closure and can be adjusted to three lengths. Style this design on its own or with other shimmering Timeless pieces for a classic look that stands out.

Wear the magic of the winter night sky as part of your bracelet stack. This asymmetrical bracelet features a central shooting star shape with two moving pieces forming star trails, leading into a double chain, a dynamic contrast with a larger chain on the other side of the bracelet. Crafted from sterling silver, the shooting star is set with sparkling round brilliant-cut cubic zirconia, so you can sparkle like the star you are for the holiday season and beyond.

product_name: Moments Peace Knot T-bar Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Wear an icon of luck with our Moments Peace Knot T-bar Snake Chain Bracelet. Inspired by a traditional Chinese peace knot, this sterling silver bracelet features an intricately-shaped openwork clasp flush-set with four clear cubic zirconia and secured with a T-bar closure. Style it with up to 16-18 of your favourite charms, dangle charms or pendants.

Update your collection with our new Moments Studded Chain Bracelet. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this bracelet features a flexible, textured chain and an infinity-detailed openable heart-shaped clasp with an interior infinity symbol. Please note: a maximum of 14-18 charms, dangle charms or pendants can be styled among the three sections divided by the threaders.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Moments Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Make precious memories last forever with our Disney 100th Anniversary Moments Snake Chain Bracelet. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this limited edition collector’s piece features a Mickey Mouse-shaped clasp with a 14k gold circle engraved with “Disney 100”. Style it with your favourite Disney x charms to celebrate 100 years of wonder.

description: Spark something special this new year with our Firecracker Pavé Bars Bracelet. description: Make every day magical with our Disney Tinker Bell Clasp Moments Snake Chain Bracelet. Style this sterling silver bracelet with Disney x charms to relive your favourite Disney stories everywhere you go.

product_name: Moments Marvel Logo Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Build your dream team. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this legendary bracelet features our iconic snake chain pattern and a Marvel logo brick clasp detailed with slightly raised letters in white enamel. It can hold up to 18 charms, dangle charms or pendants. Simply add a clip charm on each thread to divide it into three sections and then choose your favourite hero charms. Wear our Moments Marvel Logo Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet as an everyday reminder to find your power.

For a mother like no other, give a bangle that will symbolise her uniqueness. Crafted from 14k rose-gold plating, this meaningful bracelet features a heart-shaped clasp that puts love at the centre, decorated with openwork detail that emulates the one-of-a-kind wings of a butterfly. Finished with a sparkling cubic zirconia at its centre, the bangle can hold up to 16-18 charms and would make a perfect gift for the mother figure in your life this Mother's Day.

Take inspiration from the beautiful shapes of nature with the Sparkling Herbarium Cluster Chain Bracelet. Inspired by pressed flowers and leaves, this hand-finished sterling silver bracelet is set with cubic zirconia stones in alternating round and marquise shapes along half the chain, with two clusters of round, marquise and pear-shaped stones creating nature-inspired shapes, attached by jump rings so they move naturally with the chain. The bracelet is adjustable to three sizes. Elevate your looks with this elegant reminder of the beauty of nature.

product_name: Moments Sparkling Infinity Heart Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Representing the eternal love that binds family together, the Moments Sparkling Infinity Heart Clasp Snake Chain Bracelet is a meaningful gift for the ones that matter most to you. The openwork heart clasp features stones along the edge and an asymmetrical infinity symbol entwining around the heart. The back of the clasp is engraved with the message "Family forever and Always". The bracelet features two threaders (raised charm dividers) dividing it into three sections. Style it with up to 16-18 of your favourite charms or dangle charms to symbolise the ones you love, or gift it to someone close to your heart.

product_name: Limited Edition Moments Sparkling Shooting Star Clasp Bangle
description: Bring celestial energy to your everyday style with the Moments Sparkling Shooting Star Clasp Bangle. Featuring a barrel clasp with a pavé-covered shooting star swirling around it, this sleek sterling silver bangle is ready for you to make it your own. Style this shooting star bracelet with a selection of your favourite charms and wear it to symbolise bringing good luck, hope and serendipity into your life.

Crafted in sterling silver, this chain bracelet features a pair of intertwined moveable circles accentuated with a row of sparkle and microbeads in their centres. While they are the same size, one features a polished back and the other an engraved back with two logos. An essential style in every collection, this easy-to-wear piece is set to become your most-worn style to date.

product_name: Disney Parks Castle Shooting Star Snake Chain Bracelet
description: Make your favourite memories last with the Disney Parks Castle Shooting Star Snake Chain Bracelet. Crafted in sterling silver, this Disney bracelet can be styled with 16-18 of your favourite charms and features an openwork clasp with different star shapes. For added movement, the clasp has a dangling Disney castle with extra sparkle. Inspired by the iconic Disney Park castle everyone knows and loves, it's the perfect piece to take home to keep treasured memories by your side.

Elevate your signature style with the Signature Pavé Bold Chain Bracelet. Crafted in sterling silver, the bracelet features a single moveable circular shape in the middle, set with sparkle and microbeads for an eye-catching effect. The link chain is made up of oval and rectangular links for a chunky geometrical look. An essential style in every collection, this easy-to-wear adjustable piece stands out on its own or can be stacked with other chain bracelets.

Celebrate the magic of the night sky with our Sparkling Crescent Moon Open Bangle. The open bangle bracelet in sterling silver features a prism shape throughout, as well as a moon set slightly asymmetrically. The crescent moon is adorned with different-sized sparkles for added shine. Inspired by the Chinese Valentine's Day, the shining and intricate moon design combines the mystical romance of love with the magical night sky, making the perfect gift for a loved one. The bangle has been designed to fit perfectly on the wrist and does not need to be twisted or flexed to be worn.

product_name: Moments Round Clasp Blue Braided Leather Bracelet
description: Channel the depths of the ocean and the calm of a midnight sky. The Moments Round Clasp Blue Braided Leather Bracelet is crafted from deep blue braided leather and finished with a round sterling silver clasp and threaded sterling silver end caps. Style it with up to 9 charms or dangle charms to perfectly offset your favourite charms.

Balancing 90s punk rock influences with the timelessness of sleek silver, this statement bracelet can stand alone or be layered and styled in fresh ways every day.

Two asymmetrical stars set with sparkling stones dangle from the clasp, adding a dash of movement to this essential piece.

Combining the linear geometry of our iconic chains with sparkling pavé, this sterling silver chain bracelet is a forever piece with of-the-moment appeal.

Featuring triangular prism bars punctuated by eight sparkling stones in open basket settings, this sterling silver bracelet balances sleek lines with round curves. Designed for creative stacking with other pieces, this classic bar bracelet has endless styling potential.

product_name: Heart Snowflake Snow Globe Dangle Charm
description: Embrace the nostalgia of festive days of old with the Heart Snowflake Snow Globe Dangle Charm. Plated in 14k gold, this Murano glass snow globe charm features engraved snowflakes that capture the beauty of a winter wonderland. The snow globe is inspired by our existing sterling silver snow globe charm with a new twist: it features a heart inside the Murano glass with three clear cubic zirconia stones. This special festive charm adds the perfect touch of sparkle to any look – just in time for the holidays.

Wear your heart on your sleeve with the Openwork Family Heart & Star Charm. Heart and star motifs adorn the latest Moments charms; their symbolism honouring the importance of family. A gift for yourself or someone you love, this charm features cut-out stars along the side of the charm and a larger cut-out star at each side of the heart. Two beloved motifs come together to create a 14k gold-plated charm that shines (almost) as bright as the ones you love the most.

Make every day radiant with the Sparkling Sun Charm. This intricate 14k gold-plated charm features a double-sided sun sparkling with pavé. Surrounding the centre of the sun are sleek, striking rays, half of which are polished and half of which are set with cubic zirconia stones and microbeads. Inspired by the brilliant beauty of the sun, this charm is sure to bring light and positivity to your look and your mood.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Two-tone Spinning Moon Dangle Charm
description: Capture the magic of Disney with the Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Two-tone Spinning Moon Dangle Charm. Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse take to the stars in their very own twinkling crescent moon, in this Disney x charm. The crescent sterling silver moon features Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse embracing in a hug, inside a border of 14k gold-plated metal. Making it even more special, everybody's favourite Disney duo can spin 360°. Wear this two-tone charm with your favourite mixed-metal look for a playful festive touch.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Crescent Moon Charm
description: Wear your favourites with the Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Crescent Moon Charm. Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse take to the stars in their very own twinkling crescent moon. This charm is crafted from two deep blue bioresin man-made mother of pearl pieces in the shape of a moon with a cut-out star pattern. Made from 14k gold-plated metal, style it with your favourite charms for a pop of colour and shine.

product_name: Game of Thrones Spinning Astrolabe Dangle Charm
description: Never forget who you are and where you're going, thanks to the Game of Thrones Spinning Astrolabe Dangle Charm. This charm, made of three 14k gold-plated openwork spinning discs, represents the Game of Thrones astrolabe. An ancient astronomical instrument that was used to model the universe, here it represents the history of the continent of Westeros and its Seven Kingdoms. Also featuring sun, moon and star details and swirling patterns, no Westeros collection is complete without this intricate charm.

product_name: Game of Thrones Dragon Fire Dangle Charm
description: Collect your way through Westeros with the Game of Thrones Dragon Fire Dangle Charm. Here, a Game of Thrones dragon in 14k gold-plated metal wraps its body around a red lab-created opal. Intricately detailed, the dragon has two red lab-created crystals for eyes and textured lines that imitate scales and wings. In the world of Game of Thrones, dragons possess great power, as do the humans who ride them. Carry this dragon charm as a token of your own power.

Let the holiday fun begin with the Rocking Unicorn Dangle Charm. Embrace the nostalgia of bygone festive days with a rocking horse – or rather, a rocking unicorn – inspired by a merry vintage playroom. This unicorn charm is bejewelled with sparkling stones and has snowy white enamel details on its mane to capture the beauty of a winter wonderland. The body of the unicorn also has round cubic zirconia stones set in star shapes. This 14k gold-plated charm brings a dash of festive spirit to all your holiday looks.

Have your very own moon landing with the Two-tone Key & Moon Dangle Charm. Crafted from a pink moon-shaped lab-created opal set in a sterling silver dangle charm, this charm encourages endless dreaming. A 14k gold-plated key dangles from the tip of the moon, offering a beautiful contrast: a standout addition to your collection of charms. Featuring a "Believe in yourself" engraving on the back side, wear this dangle charm on its own or paired with your other everyday favourites.

Enhance your styling possibilities with the ME Rectangular Openable Link. Featured in our 14k gold-plated unique metal blend, this rounded rectangular link features grooved lines, polished inner and outer sides and a spring back function for secure closure. Give yourself the freedom to mix and remix your look with this essential piece. Can be styled on bracelets, necklaces or earrings to adjust ME link chains, with up to 8 mini dangle charms or 2 medallion charms.

product_name: ME Heart Four-leaf Clover Medallion Charm
description: Get lucky with the ME Heart Four-leaf Clover Medallion Charm. With four heart-shaped leaves, this 14k gold-plated clover medallion charm has two distinctly different sides. One side is polished with three cut-out hearts and one solid heart set with a sparkling stone inside an triangle detail; the other side is covered in a microbead pattern on all four leaves. This clover medallion charm will bring a golden glow to your look while reminding you that you make your own luck. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Treated Freshwater Cultured Pearl Sun Mini Dangle Charm
description: Be a one-of-a-kind with the ME Treated Freshwater Cultured Pearl Sun Mini Dangle Charm. This sun-inspired 14k gold-plated mini dangle charm centres on a treated freshwater cultured pearl surrounded by pyramid-shaped rays. The reverse side features a domed metal sun and grooved detailing. In much the same way as the real sun provides us all with warmth and energy, this sun charm will be a symbol of life, light and renewal for you whenever you wear it. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Power of the Light Sun Medallion Charm
description: Be all light and no shade when you wear the ME Power of the Light Sun Medallion Charm. This 14k gold-plated medallion charm is embellished with details that represent the sun and its radiating rays. One side features sparkling stones pavé-set inside the sun and surrounding triangles; the other side boasts microbead rays and cut-out triangles. Accessorise this piece with sleek, linear styles to make this statement medallion charm shine even brighter. Compatible with ME and Moments.

Manifest your own luck when you wear the ME Lucky Horseshoe Medallion Charm. A 14k gold-plated octagon-shaped disc forms the base of this medallion charm. On one side, a polished horseshoe is surrounded by shimmering white hand-applied enamel. On the other side, a cut-out sun with a raised heart is surrounded by rays with microbead detailing. Golden and glowing, this intricate horseshoe charm will brighten every look and bring positive energy to your day. Compatible with ME and Moments.

Spell out your feelings with this meaningful handwritten-style charm. Crafted from a 14k gold-plating, the design features layered openwork lettering, writing out “love”, with the “o” shaped like a heart. Inspired by love letters and gestures of affection, this charm is a unique way to show your loved ones how you feel about them.

product_name: Openable & Engravable Love Locket Dangle Charm
description: Keep what's most dear to you close to your heart with the Openable & Engravable Love Locket Dangle Charm. This 14k gold-plated locket charm features a clear cubic zirconia stone on the front in the shape of a keyhole, and opens and closes securely so you can keep a tiny picture, note or lock of hair inside. The inside of the locket is engraved with the message "TODAY TOMORROW ALWAYS", and the back is blank for your own engraving. Wear it on your Moments necklace or bracelet as a symbol of keeping your love safe and a reminder to cherish it, every day.

product_name: Chinese Year of the Dragon Charm
description: Invite good fortune in the coming year with the Two-tone Chinese Year of the Dragon Charm. 2024 is the Year of the Dragon - the 5th animal in the Chinese zodiac, this mythical creature represents good fortune, strength, power, wisdom and health. This 14k gold-plated charm features an intricately detailed dragon with a row of pavé along one side of its body and scale details on the other. Sparkling red pear-shaped stones bring the dragon's eyes to life, and its body is curled to wrap around your bracelet or charm holder, creating a sense of movement. Wear this charm to invite the qualities of the dragon into your year ahead, or gift it to a loved one who was born in the Year of the Dragon.

product_name: Disney Cinderella's Carriage & Heart Double Dangle Charm
description: Have a ball every day with the Disney Cinderella's Carriage & Heart Double Dangle Charm. Inspired Cinderella's beloved story, this 14k gold-plated charm features two heart-shaped discs. Behind it sits the second heart-shaped disc with glittery blue enamel, and on the back is the engraved message "A Dream is a wish your heart makes." Wear it on your favourite necklace, bracelet or charm holder as a reminder of the power of following your dreams.

New year, new mantra. The My 2024 Butterfly Dangle Charm is inspired by a symbol of beauty, strength and transformation: the butterfly. This sterling silver butterfly charm features movable wings with transparent two-tone blue enamel revealing intricate patterns beneath. The backs of the wings are engraved with the message "Believe you can." At the centre of the butterfly is a 14k gold-plated heart set with a sparkling lab-grown diamond, and the bail in engraved with the year 2024. Add it to your My Charm collection as a symbol of good things to come and the power of believing in your own potential.

product_name: Game of Thrones Needle Dangle Charm

It features decorative elements for an added touch of mystery and power. Essential piece for those that love House Stark, this dangle charm also features the engraving "NOT TODAY." Wear it alone as a reminder of inner strength and resilience or style it with your other favourite Game of Thrones pieces.

One side is engraved with "There is no place like home... except Grandma's," adding a touch of humour to the heartfelt piece. Let this meaningful charm remind you of the warmth of home with every glance.

The charm's standout motif showcases a sophisticated rounded design, accented by sparkling stones all around, which are set in prominent prongs. The stones are set in rows and there are three in each one to allow for more radiance. Perfect for adding a touch of shine to your existing collection or for gifting it to the sparkle lover in your life.

description: The power of motherly love shines bright in our Lab-grown Diamond Engravable Mum Double Dangle Charm. The other disc crafted in sterling silver carries a heartfelt engraving that reads "Mum you are so precious to me", while its back is engravable for a personalized touch. Please note, that each lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.

Embracing the essence of family, the charm gracefully forms the infinity symbol, echoing the timeless nature of those cherished connections. Engraved with the heartfelt words 'Family' and 'Forever and Always,' this infinity charm captures the enduring spirit of kinship. The unique design incorporates an imprinted heart for the 'u' and a sterling silver circle attached at an angle. Inspired by diverse mother figures, this piece is a heartfelt expression of family love.

A 14k gold-plated spare tire and grill add contrast, while sparkling stones function as head and tail lights. Cut-out letters on the car's raised roof read "ADVENTURE" and an engraving on the car's underside reads "HAPPINESS is planning a trip with those you LOVE." A token of summer adventure on the road.

Lighten up your look with the Two-tone Movable Monkey Dangle Charm. A creature known for its joy and mischief, the monkey inspired this two-toned charm's design. A smiling sterling silver monkey hangs upside down holding a 14k gold-plated banana, with a clear stone sparkling from its belly button and two black stones forming eyes. Its tail, legs and arms are movable, adding to the charm's playfulness. Wear it as a reminder to smile and embrace the fun in life.

description: Carry a piece of Paris wherever you go with the Paris Eiffel Tower Lab-Grown Diamond Engravable Double Dangle Charm. description: Wear an ode to nature with the Sparkling Monstera Leaf Dangle Charm. Set the mood for a joyous celebration with the cheerful sound of bells.

Elevate your winter-inspired looks with the Festive Snowflake Charm. Featuring an intricate openwork snowflake design in elegant 14k rose gold plating, this piece celebrates the symbolism of the snowflake motif - every single snowflake is special, just like you and the ones you love. The charm features a central cubic zirconia stone on each side along with 36 micro bead-set cubic zirconia for a frosty shimmer. A delicate, meaningful piece for your seasonal jewellery collection.

Bring the beauty of nature to your jewellery with the Sparkling Herbarium Cluster Round Charm. This 14k rose gold-plated charm is composed of four clusters of clear cubic zirconia stones forming a spherical shape. The clusters alternate between two subtly different designs created with round or pear-shaped stones around a cluster of microbeads at the centre. An elegant reinterpretation of how nature forms beautiful shapes with petal and leaf-inspired elements.

Explore the wonders of the galaxy with the Planet Saturn Sparkling Dangle Charm. People have been fascinated by the night skies since ancient times - our solar system series takes inspiration from the beauty of the planets and the way they are represented in modern pop culture. This hand-finished dangle charm features Saturn's famous planetary ring set at an angle around its surface, detailed with a row of clear cubic zirconia pavé and small raised stars on one side and imprinted stars on the other. The charm is finished in warm 14k rose gold plating, and the lower half of the planet is covered with man-made crystals in shades of purple, with a raised asymmetric star set with a clear cubic zirconia stone to represent Saturn's pole. The bail is adorned with a row of pavé and small raised stars. Wear it as a standalone statement or add it to your solar system collection to channel the beauty of the cosmos.

Open it to reveal a surprise - a luminous treated freshwater cultured pearl. Engraved with the message "One of a kind", wear yours as a reminder of the experiences that have shaped you, inside and out. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.

Wear your heart on your sleeve with our Two-tone Radiant Heart Dangle Charm. This 14k rose gold-plated open heart charm is detailed with hand-applied red enamel and a floating cubic zirconia heart within, symbolising the radiating energy of love. A sterling silver pavé bail and "All for love" engraving add an extra sparkle of romance. Style yours on your favourite Moments bracelet to tell your love story.

Share the love with our Two-tone Padlock Splittable Heart Charm. Hand-finished and engraved in multiple places with the message “Love is love”, this sterling silver charm features a 14k rose gold-plated removable inner heart detailed with a keyhole cut-out that forms the ‘o’ in its “Love” engraving. Wear the charms together, separately or split the charm with someone special.

product_name: Two-tone Key, Padlock & Heart Triple Dangle Charm
description: Lock in your love with our Two-tone Key, Padlock & Heart Triple Dangle Charm. The sterling silver key is engraved with the words "The key" and the 14k rose gold-plated padlock features the engraving "To my", referencing the sterling silver heart charm embellished with pavé. Adding extra sparkle, a clear cubic zirconia is shaped to fit the padlock's keyhole. Give it to the one who holds the key to your heart - whether that's yourself or someone else.

Celebrate your everlasting love with our Love Padlock Dangle Charm. This 14k rose gold-plated padlock is hand-finished with black enamel, accentuating the polished lifted script across the front and heart on the back. The script reads "Love" with a clear cubic zirconia set in the 'o' to match the sparkling pavé bail. The bottom of the padlock features the engraving "Precious to me". Please note: the padlock cannot be opened, symbolising the strong bond of love.

product_name: Two-tone key & Sliding Heart Dangle Charm
description: Unlock your love for yourself with our Two-tone Key & Sliding Heart Dangle Charm. The 14k rose gold-plated key features a raised sterling silver heart that slides up and down its blade detailed with realistic notches and teeth. The charm dangles from a heart-shaped cut-out on the head of the key. Engraved with the message "The key to happiness", wear yours as an empowering reminder that you make yourself happy every day.

description: Crush hard on our ME Styling Nailed Heart Double Link, hand-finished in 14k rose gold plating. Wear yours between openable links on your ME link chain bracelets or necklaces, or hang it on a pair of hoops for a unique statement.

product_name: Pink Butterfly & Quote Double Dangle Charm
description: Embrace the change with our Pink Butterfly & Quote Double Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in 14k rose gold plating, it features a butterfly detailed with transparent pink enamel in the heart-shaped cut-outs of each wing and sparkling pavé along the edges. Celebrating the beauty and uniqueness of every butterfly, a round disc is engraved with "One of a kind" on one side and fluttering butterflies on both sides. Mix and match this double dangle charm with other spring-inspired pieces to celebrate the season of new beginnings.

product_name: Two-Tone Rainbow Heart, Butterfly & Peace Triple Dangle Charm
description: Bring extra meaning to your styling with our Two-tone Rainbow Heart, Butterfly & Peace Triple Dangle Charm. This triple dangle charm features a sterling silver heart set with two rows of rainbow pavé and engraved with "L<3ve" on the back; a sterling silver butterfly shaded with hand-applied blue enamel and engraved with "Freedom" on the back; and a 14k rose gold-plated peace sign detailed with microbeads and a stone at its centre and engraved with "Peace" on the back. Wear it as an everyday reminder of your values.

Catch the season's light with our Floating Curved Feather Dangle Charm. This 14k rose gold-plated dangle charm features a feather curved to look like it is suspended in the air, delicately falling to the ground. The front of the feather is set with round brilliant-cut clear cubic zirconia following its whimsical shape. Style it with other 14k rose gold-plated pieces to enhance your spring glow.

A sweet gift to make your loved one's birthday even more special. The Openable Birthday Gift Dangle Charm is finished in warm 14k rose gold plating and is shaped like a gift box with a soft pink enamel ribbon and bow. Open the box and you'll discover a raised heart with the engraved message "Happy Birthday." A special jewellery gift they can wear all year to remember that birthday glow.

product_name: Two-tone Wedding Bells Double Dangle Charm
description: Let the bells ring for the happy couple! The Two-tone Wedding Bells Double Dangle Charm is a celebration of a new milestone in your love story. It features two dangling wedding bells in sterling silver, each with a small 14k rose gold-plated heart dangle inside - one bell is engraved with "You" and the other with "Me". A 14k rose gold-plated disc engraved with the message "Just married" completes the charm. Wear it on your favourite bracelet or charm holder as a memento of your special day and a celebration of all the new memories you'll make together.

product_name: Disney Minnie Mouse Mum Silhouette Double Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate a mum who's your best friend with Disney's Minnie Mouse. The Disney Minnie Mouse Silhouette Double Dangle Charm features two discs shaped like the iconic Minnie Mouse head silhouette - at the front is an openwork silhouette in 14k rose gold plating set with glittering clear pavé and finished with Minnie's signature bow with red cubic zirconia stones. Behind it is a sterling silver dangle engraved with the message "Mum you are my best friend" with a cut-out Minnie Mouse silhouette to represent the "u" in Mum, with the other side covered in shimmering white enamel. A sweet surprise for a mum who loves Disney, to thank her for all the laughter, love and special moments you share.

product_name: Two-tone Infinity Mum Heart Double Dangle Charm
description: A jewellery gift for a mum who will always be perfect to you, just as she is. The Two-tone Infinity Heart Double Dangle Charm features an openwork heart dangle in 14k rose gold plating forming an infinity symbol in the centre, adorned with a row of pink pavé and engraved with the word "Mum" with a pink stone as the central letter. Behind it is a sterling silver heart-shaped disc engraved with the message "To me you are perfect" creating a repeating pattern on both sides. Pink pavé on the bail adds a finishing touch. A celebration of motherly love in all its forms.

Inspired by a meeting of heart and infinity motifs, the Two-tone Openwork Infinity Heart Charm is a tribute to your family's infinite love. The top part of the charm is a sterling silver openwork heart with an organic, swirling shape; linked through it is a smaller heart in 14k rose-gold plating, representing your eternal link to your family. The sterling silver heart features two infinity symbols and the engraved message "Family is love." Wear it on your jewellery as a reminder of the ones who are closest to your heart.

product_name: Two-tone Splittable Family Generation of Hearts Triple Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate generations of love with the Two-tone Splittable Family Generation of Hearts Triple Dangle Charm. This charm is made up of three individual heart charms, crafted from sterling silver with 14 rose gold-plated bails. Each one is engraved with a different family member: "Grandmother", "Mother" and "Daughter". Share them between the three of you and each wear them as a love message between generations, wherever you go.

The Two-tone Openwork Mum & Heart Charm is a celebration of all the amazing mums in our lives. This sterling silver openwork heart charm features a pink heart-shaped cabochon stone on one side with an engraved heart on the back visible through the stone, creating a frosted look. On the other side of the charm is the word "M♥M" in sterling silver script with a pink heart-shaped stone as the central letter. Each side of the charm is outlined with clear cubic zirconia pavé, and a pattern of cut-out hearts runs around the edges. A small rose-gold-plated heart dangles from the bottom of the charm. A heartfelt jewellery gift to show your appreciation to the one who raised you.

Manifest harmony, balance and endless love with our ME Infinity Symbol Medallion Charm. Glowing in 14k rose gold plating, this piece shines bright with a row of glittering pavé on one half of the infinity symbol and round brilliant-cut clear and blue stones on the circular frame of the medallion charm. The infinity symbol gives the illusion it's wrapping around the openwork medallion charm, representing eternal connections and infinite possibilities. The bail is made to style on openable ME openable links and hoop earrings.

product_name: Pink & Yellow Murano Glass Butterfly Dangle Charm
description: Transform into your best self with the Pink & Yellow Murano Glass Butterfly Dangle Charm. This 14k rose gold-plated charm features Murano glass wings in an orange-and-pink gradient with a cut-out pattern on the back that shows through the glass, and 14k rose gold swirls on the front. Microbeads on the butterfly's body and pavé on the bail add a touch of delicate sparkle. Add this bright butterfly to your look as a powerful symbol of transformation and new beginnings.
category: The most loved summer jewellery trends 2024

description: Bring even more of the iconic studded texture into your look with the Studded Clip Charm. With its pyramid and spherical stud texture and a thin profile, this clip charm in our 14k rose gold-plated unique metal blend will feel right at home on your studded chain bracelet, as its pattern echoes the new icon. The 14k rose gold-plated charm features silicone grips on the inside and cannot be styled on threads, so it will stay fixed in one place on the chain as you move, while spacing out your charms. Create a camouflage-style look by adding it to the studded chain for a bold take.

Set your intentions in style with the ME Lunar Phases Medallion Charm. Detailed with a pink lab-created opal as the new moon at the top, and a clear cubic zirconia as the full moon at the bottom, this 14k rose gold-plated medallion charm shows the eight phases of a lunar cycle, representing intuition. Just as the moon is ever-changing, so are you. Style yours as a reminder of self-care and let each phase guide your journey of personal growth. Wear this meaningful medallion charm across your ME link chain bracelets, necklaces, rings and hoop earrings.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Halloween Pumpkin Charm
description: Have a charmed Halloween with the Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Halloween Pumpkin Charm. The 14k rose gold-plated pumpkin design features cut-out and grooved details that create realistic dimension. A sterling silver Mickey and Minnie Mouse pop out of the pumpkin. Mickey wears a Halloween costume with glittering enamel, while Minnie wears a costume with glow-in-the-dark details. A festive addition to any Disney or Halloween lover's collection, this playful piece will add some spooky fun to your styling.

Shine bright from all angles with the Sparkling Pavé Triple-row Charm from the Moments collection. This cubic zirconia charm is made from a 14k rose gold-plated metal and is designed to shine on its own, or next to one of your existing 14k rose gold-plated charms. Crafted from exactly 85 pavé-set round brilliant-cut clear cubic zirconia, this sparkling pavé charm lends an elevated sparkle to the everyday.

product_name: Two-tone Shooting Star Double Dangle Charm
description: Wish upon a star with the Two-tone Shooting Star Double Dangle Charm. Crafted with both sterling silver and 14k rose gold-plated metal, this one's sure to be a hit among lovers of two-tone charms. With a "Love you more than all the stars in the sky" engraving, this shooting star charm features shimmering blue enamel to represent a galaxy filled with twinkling stars. The dangle charm's second disc has an openwork pattern of shooting stars, where each star has a curved trail of sparkling stones and beaded details. A row of stones on the bail adds a sparkling touch. Add some special shine to your everyday, or inspire someone you love to always shoot for the stars.

product_name: Two-tone Santa Claus in Hot Air Balloon Charm
description: Tis the season for the Two-tone Santa Claus in Hot Air Balloon Charm. Crafted from sterling silver and 14k rose gold plating, one of this year's most playful holiday charms features enamel detailing and festive-coloured stones in star-shaped settings. The main character of Christmas gets a fun new mode of transport, hitching a ride in a hot air balloon that also features the message "Love peace and joy" – to remind us all what this season is truly about. Wear this cheerful Christmas charm to all your holiday parties!

All eyes will be on you when you wear the ME Sparkling Eyes Medallion Charm. Engraved with the words "With sparkling eyes like the stars in the sky. It makes my soul fly high," this 14k rose gold-plated medallion charm is shaped like an octagon. On one side, eye and star shapes are hand-set with stones that sparkle from a base of shimmering white enamel. Detailed and delicate, this soulful charm will put stars in your eyes. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Pink Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Love has no limits when you wear the ME Pink Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm. This 14k rose gold-plated charm features light pink hand-applied enamel and a pink heart-shaped man-made crystal at the centre. The reverse side features a 14k rose gold-plated polished heart with grooved lines and cut-out detailing. A reminder that wild hearts can't be broken, this mini dangle charm brings a depth to your look, symbolising that love – for yourself and others – always wins. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Lucky Ladybird Mini Dangle Charm
description: Keep luck on your side when you wear the ME Lucky Ladybird Mini Dangle Charm.
