Note: This mini dangle charms bail is not openable and can only be styled on openable links.

Bring a little pop punk to your ME looks with the latest paper clip styling link design. This realistic motif will transform your link chains with a very cool, modern touch. Crafted from sterling sliver, the paper clip is set with 100 micro bead-set round brilliant-cut clear cubic zirconia on one side to make your unique self-expression shine. The length of your paper clip styling link perfectly matches the length of any styling double link, or four small interlocking links. Style between openable links on your ME link chain bracelets or necklaces, or hang on a pair of hoops for a unique statement.

product_name: ME Faceted Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Our ME Faceted Heart Mini Dangle Charm takes tattoo-inspired aesthetics and translates them into a symbol of self-expression. Crafted from sterling silver, this unique mini dangle charm features a faceted heart on one side and a flat surface on the other; a design that brings 2D motifs to life through 3D elements. Style on openable links across your ME link chain bracelets and necklaces, rings and earrings to create a look that's entirely your own.

Our ME Butterfly Medallion Charm will bring a symbol of freedom to your styling. The butterfly is a symbol of transformation, femininity, beauty and colour. With its pale purple man-made crystals and blue enamel details, this sterling silver medallion charm showcases the butterfly within an outline of a triangle, so you can add a completley new shape to your everyday looks. Style the mini dangle charm on openable links on your link chain necklace, bracelet or hoop earrings and let your style speak volumes.

product_name: ME Balance Yin & Yang Medallion Charm
description: Our ME Balance Yin & Yang Medallion Charm will bring balance to your styling. Yin & Yang is an ancient symbol representing duality and harmony. Crafted from sterling silver, this mystical medallion charm is decorated with colourful enamel detailing and set with brilliant-cut man-made crystals in purple and blue, ready to bring even more meaning to your everyday combinations. Style yours on openable links on your link chain necklace, bracelet or hoop earrings and let your style speak volumes.

A sophisticated addition to your jewellery box. Crafted in sterling silver, the Moments Logo Pavé & Beads Charm features two circular bands enveloped within a diagonal band to create a unique geometrical shape. A row of pavé adds sparkle, while microbeading gives it texture and dimension. Wear this charm on your bracelet and tell your story, your way.

Did somebody say Spider-Man? Wear everyone's favourite web-slinger on your charm holders, with our new Marvel Hanging Spider-Man Dangle Charm. Featuring Spider-Man in his iconic hero get-up, the charm is crafted from sterling silver and decorated with accurate enamel detailing to create the characteristic Spidey suit. It is engraved with the words "friendly neighbourhood" and "SPIDER-MAN" as script, while Spider-Man's belt features a spider motif on the reverse. Style the quirky wall-crawler on your bracelets, earrings or charm holders as a reminder that you're amazing as you are.

product_name: Disney Parks 2023 Mickey Mouse Pennant Dangle Charm
description: Capture the fun of your favourite Disney Parks moments with this colourful pennant-shaped dangle charm. Crafted from sterling silver and brought to life with vibrant blue, yellow and orange enamel, the charm features beloved symbols of Disney Parks: Mickey Mouse's head in profile and a Mickey Mouse head-shaped ice-cream bar. The charm is dated with the year 2023, making it a collectible reminder of sweet treats and even sweeter moments.

product_name: Red Nose Reindeer Murano Dangle Charm
description: Brighten your holiday season with the Red Nose Reindeer Murano Dangle Charm. This cheery sterling silver reindeer charm features detailed antlers and an iconic red nose created from frosted matte Murano glass. On the reverse, a heart cut-out reveals the festive red of the Murano, and below the heart is the engraving "Let your light shine." The bail is decorated with clear and red cubic zirconia stones for an added touch of holiday magic.

Tis the season for special surprises. Rediscover a magical Christmas tale this year with our new Nutcracker dangle charm, a classic seasonal character with a touch. Thoughtful craftsmanship details like microbeading, realistically grooved hair and colourful enamel bring the Nutcracker to life, as if it might jump up and start dancing at any moment. The year "2022" is engraved at the back of the Nutcracker's crown, making this collectible piece an extra-special reminder of cherished memories from this holiday season.

Capture the love in the air these holidays with this sterling silver Christmas heart charm, hand-finished in glossy red transparent enamel with a cute Santa hat detail and an engraving that reads "All I want for Christmas is" (followed by a heart symbol). Gift that warm fuzzy holiday feeling to a loved one (or yourself!) and celebrate the love and togetherness that make the season special.

product_name: Disney Aladdin Princess Jasmine Dangle Charm
description: Dare to dream with Disney's Princess Jasmine. Celebrate the 30th anniversary of Disney’s classic film, Aladdin, with this sterling silver dangle charm featuring the brave and self-assured Princess Jasmine. Wearing her iconic outfit, our Disney Aladdin Princess Jasmine Dangle Charm is set with round brilliant-cut icy green man made crystals in her favourite colour. Prepare to be swept away on a magical adventure and style this meaningful dangle charm on your favourite charm holder, to let your bravery shine for all to see.

product_name: Disney Aladdin Magic Carpet Dangle Charm
description: Prepare to be swept away on a magical adventure with this charm inspired by Disney's Aladdin. Celebrate the 30th anniversary of the Disney classic with our Disney Aladdin Magic Carpet Dangle Charm. Crafted from sterling silver, this realistic charm features Carpet's iconic motifs, created in colourful enamel, finished with moving tassels attached to each corner. The charm is engraved with the words "I can show you the world" on the reverse, in reference to the iconic scene of Aladdin and Jasmine soaring through the clouds in the night sky. Style this symbolic Disney Aladdin Scarab Beetle Dangle Charm on your favourite charm holder to face the world with your favourite stories by your side.

Join Disney x as we capture the indescribable feeling of embracing adventure, with loveable character charms and enchanted symbols inspired by the Disney classic, Aladdin. Crafted from sterling silver, Genie is finished with characteristic glittering blue enamel details, and is attached to a dangling lamp, as if he's just been summoned. Add this meaningful symbol to your favourite charm holder and carry your wishes with you always.

product_name: Disney Aladdin, Princess Jasmine & Genie Glow-in-the-dark Charm
description: Celebrate the 30th anniversary of Disney’s Aladdin with this story-filled charm, crafted from sterling silver. The openwork design showcases the iconic scene of Aladdin visiting Jasmine on her balcony, silhouetted in front of a glow-in-the-dark enamel moon, which creates a magical effect in darkness. The back of the charm features Genie, with his crossed arms and characteristic grin, surrounded by star-set teal cubic zirconia. Style this story-filled charm on your favourite charm holder to face the world with your favourite characters by your side.

Soar above the city skyline just like Spider-Man with our new charm featuring the web-slinger himself. Crafted from sterling silver, this detailed charm features everyone's favourite neighbourhood Spider-Man swinging into action, activating his powers in front of an openwork web, with a sprawling metropolis seen from Spider-Man's point-of-view on the reverse of the charm. Finished with bright red enamel detailing to recreate the characteristic Spidey suit, style this quirky charm on your bracelets, earrings or charm holders as a reminder that you're amazing as you are.

Spin your own Spider-Man story with our Marvel Spider-Man Mask Charm. Crafted from sterling silver in the shape of Spider-Man's mask, the charm's front is made up of graphic font that spells out the iconic reminder "With great power comes great responsibility." The back of the charm features openwork web detailing, while the front includes black enamel eye outlines. Style this quirky charm on your bracelets, earrings or charm holders as a reminder that you're amazing as you are.

Would you be fast enough to catch the wall-crawling, web-slinging Spider-Man on film? Now you can keep his spidey selfie forever, with our Marvel Spider-Man Camera Selfie Charm. Crafted from sterling silver, the charm is the shape of a camera, with everyone's favourite neighbourhood Super Hero in the display, as if he's just cheekily taken a selfie and left it on the camera for a budding photographer to find. Finished with enamel detailing in bright, bold colours, the camera's lens features a bezel-set round brilliant-cut cubic zirconia, plus silver web detailing on the corner of the camera. Style this quirky charm on your bracelets, earrings or charm holders as a reminder that you're amazing as you are.

Celebrate what makes each of us unique with this double dangle charm featuring a delicate snowflake design crafted in sterling silver. One snowflake dangle features sparkling clear cubic zirconia pavé around a central stone, and the other has an engraving that reads "You are one of a kind." Cut-out and imprinted details create an intricate piece that captures the beauty of snowflakes dancing in the winter air. The perfect gift to express how special your loved one is to you.

product_name: Celestial Shooting Star Heart Double Dangle Charm
description: Two shooting stars come together to create a heart-shaped outline in this playful and romantic double dangle charm, crafted in sterling silver. Each star is set with a blue man-made crystal and the star trails feature clear cubic zirconia pavé. Behind the stars, a swirling galaxy effect shows through from the back part of the dangle, created with shimmering enamel in different shades of blue. The back of the enamelled part is engraved with the message "I fall in love with you every day." Capture the magic of the night sky and gift it to the one you love.

This Festive Car & Christmas Tree Charm captures the excitement of decorating our homes for the holidays and the anticipation of celebrating together. The sterling silver charm depicts a car with a Christmas tree tied to the roof and tiny 3D gifts all wrapped up in the back. The number plate reads "X-MAS" and engraved beneath the car is the message "Home for Christmas." Red and green enamel details add to the festive feel of the charm. A special gift to delight your Christmas companions.

Catch a falling snowflake and wear it on your jewellery. This detailed sterling silver charm features a cut-out five-point star motif on both sides, within a larger eight-point star with intricate openwork details and micro-beading, creating a snowflake-like effect. Small faceted and cut-out stars surround the central star, creating a magical starburst look to bring a celestial touch to your holiday styling.

Celebrate what makes the holidays sweet with this Festive Gingerbread House Charm. This cute sterling silver house-shaped charm is decorated with realistic caramel brown, red and green enamel and features delicious details including candies and lollipops on the walls, a door with a tiny heart-shaped handle and a swirled icing roof complete with a chimney and rows of sparkling pavé. A Christmas tree detail on one wall adds the final festive touch. Wear a reminder of cozy holiday traditions on your jewellery and celebrate the happy memories of the season.

product_name: Disney Parks Mickey Mouse Holiday Sweater Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate joyful holiday moments with the Disney Parks Mickey Mouse Holiday Sweater Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm depicts Mickey Mouse enjoying the season with a Santa hat, a candy cane and his cosy holiday sweater. Mickey strikes a jaunty pose, brought to life by details like the ribbed edge and letter M on his sweater and his cheerful expression. Red enamel on his Santa hat and cane add festive cheer. Here's to the joy of the season!

Capture the magic of waking up on Christmas morning with this Festive Mouse & Stocking Charm. Crafted from sterling silver, this hand-finished charm features a Christmas stocking with true-to-life knitted texture detailing and a cute mouse and candy cane peeping out the top. The mouse comes to life with adorable whisker and paw details and pink enamel inside its ears. Red enamel on the candy cane and red and green enamel on the stocking add an extra festive touch. The perfect surprise to unwrap with loved ones in front of a cosy fireplace.

A celebration of the beauty and uniqueness of nature, this hand-finished Icy Snowflake Drop Charm features an intricate cut-out snowflake in sterling silver, set with a sparkling pale blue man-made crystal on each face and with cut-out snowflake details around the sides of the charm. Three smaller snowflakes dangle from the charm, bringing a sense of movement that recalls snowflakes swirling in the frosty air - each dangle is subtly different and contains a man-made crystal. Wear it on your winter-inspired jewellery styling as a reminder to celebrate what makes each of us unique.

product_name: Celestial Galaxy Star Murano Dangle Charm
description: Capture the wonder of a clear, starry night with the Celestial Galaxy Star Murano Dangle Charm. This sterling silver dangle charm features a unique asymmetrical star-shaped stone created from Murano glass, with a glittering deep blue starry effect. Sterling silver openwork stars bring an extra layer of detail to the reverse side of the charm, and the bail is decorated with clear cubic zirconia stones set within imprinted star shapes. Style it on your bracelet of charm holder to add a touch of stardust to your look.

Capture a piece of holiday magic with this Snowflake Snowglobe Dangle Charm. Crafted from sterling silver and Murano glass, this charm features a snowflake motif surrounded by glitter and set within a glass ball, which creates a special, magical feeling. The intricate design requires high levels of craftsmanship to create, as it features lots of details including grooved and raised snowflake shapes on the base, scattered across the snowglobe and along the bail. Turn the charm over to find the message "One in a Million" engraved on the base. A special gift for a loved one or a magical addition to your jewellery styling.

Wear a winter wonderland with the Winter Blue Snowflake Murano Charm. The pale blue frosty effect of this Murano glass charm captures the feeling of looking through the ice of a frozen lake in wintertime. The glass features a mesmerising frozen water bubble effect, with sterling silver cut-out snowflakes framing the core as if they have just landed on the ice. An elegant addition to a winter-inspired jewellery look.

Bring the beauty of nature to your jewellery with the Sparkling Herbarium Cluster Dangle Charm. This sterling silver dangle charm features a cluster of alternating pear and marquise-shaped stones around a round centre stone, forming a geometric shape inspired by petal and leaf elements. An elegant reinterpretation of the shapes we find in nature, perfect to bring a delicate, floating feel to your bracelet, necklace or earrings.

Bring the beauty of nature to your jewellery with the Sparkling Herbarium Cluster Round Charm. This sterling silver charm is composed of four clusters of clear cubic zirconia stones forming a spherical shape. The clusters alternate between two subtly different designs, composed of round or pear-shaped stones with a cluster of microbeads at the centre. An elegant reinterpretation of how nature forms beautiful shapes with petal and leaf-inspired elements.

Bring a sophisticated touch of colour to your jewellery with the Blue Sparkling Levelled Rectangular Charm. Crafted from sterling silver, each side of the charm features a princess blue rectangular radiant-cut man-made crystal at the centre, outlined by two rows of clear cubic zirconia pavé. A cut-out heart pattern features on the sides. Style this piece on your go-to Moments bracelet to make a sparkling statement.

Bring a sophisticated touch of colour to your jewellery with the Red Sparkling Levelled Round Charm. Crafted from sterling silver, each side of the charm features a round brilliant-cut man-made crystal at the centre, outlined by two rows of clear cubic zirconia pavé. A cut-out heart pattern features on the sides. Style this piece on your go-to Moments bracelet to make a sparkling statement.

Channel the cosmic beauty of the solar system with the Planet Jupiter Sparkling Charm. People have been fascinated by the night skies since ancient times - our solar system series takes inspiration from the beauty of the planets and the way they are represented in modern pop culture. This hand-finished spherical charm features hand-applied enamel in subtle tones of amber, yellow, light blue and white, with sparkling rows of wavy pavé to represent Jupiter's "rivers." A honey-coloured marquise-shaped stone on one side represents the famed "eye of Jupiter." Add it to your jewellery for an elegant touch to any styling.

Carry a daily reminder of the power of love with our Radiant Open Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and featuring a unique 3D effect, this charm symbolises the coming together of two halves and the radiating impact love can have when we share it with the world. Add it to your favourite Moments bracelet with other charms to tell your love story. Please note: this charm is smaller than the Radiant Heart & Floating Stone Charm.

What the heart wants. Inspired by the joining of two hands to form a heart gesture, our Radiant Heart & Floating Stone Charm makes a sweet statement about the power of love. Hand-finished in sterling silver, a 3D open heart reveals a dangling heart-shaped faceted cubic zirconia within, sparkling as it catches the light. Gift it to the one who completes you.

product_name: Frosted Red Murano Glass & Hearts Charm
description: Fall in love with our Frosted Red Murano Glass & Hearts Charm. A sterling silver core covered with a 24k solid gold foil casts a warm glow through the frosted red Murano glass, and multidimensional cut-out hearts represent how love radiates out into the world. Create a red colour story on your favourite bracelet for the perfect look on Valentine’s Day and beyond.

product_name: Love Potion Murano Glass Heart Dangle Charm
description: Add an enchanting new piece to your collection with our Love Potion Murano Glass Heart Dangle Charm. Pink gradient heart-shaped Murano glass and a sterling silver tag engraved with "Potion" cast an intriguing spell. A single brilliant-cut pink man-made crystal adorns the bail for an extra touch of romance.

Bring out the lighthearted side of love with our Devil Heart Double Dangle Charm. This sterling silver double dangle charm features an openwork heart with a row of pavé along its edge and a heart-shaped disc with pavé horns and a heart-tipped pavé tail. Flames and the Crown O are printed on the back, and "You set my heart on fire" is engraved across the front. Wear yours as a reminder that love can be delightfully devilish.

Surround yourself with love with our Openwork Heart & Script Charm. This sterling silver charm features a small polished heart within a large openwork heart on one side and the message "Love starts from within" on the other. Style it with more charms that inspire your self-love journey.

product_name: Disney Pixar Wall-E & Eve Glow-in-the-dark Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate an out-of-this-world love with our Disney Pixar Wall-E & Eve Glow-in-the-dark Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm features kind-hearted Wall-E giving Eve a precious plant on a cut-out heart dangle. A second flat heart dangle is engraved with the message "LOVE YOU MORE THAN WORDS CAN SAY" and lights up their world with a glow-in-the-dark blue enamel moon. Add this charm to your collection, or gift it to the one you'd go to the moon and back for.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Oswald Lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm
description: For the ultimate Disney fan - collect our Disney 100th Anniversary Oswald Dangle Charm and celebrate one of the original characters. Oswald is hand-finished in sterling silver with hand-applied black enamel eyes and 14k gold trousers. He is playfully holding a sparkling lab-grown diamond in one hand and swinging from the bail with the other. To commemorate 100 years of magic, "Disney 100" is engraved on the back of his head. Wear this limited edition charm as a reminder to reach for your dreams - just like Oswald. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.

product_name: Disney Tinker Bell Celestial Thimble Charm
description: Add a little pixie dust to your every day with our Disney Tinker Bell Celestial Thimble Charm. This sterling silver charm sets a magical scene with hand-applied green enamel details and brilliant-cut blazing yellow man-made crystals. Style it with other green and yellow charms for a nostalgic tribute to Tinker Bell and your childhood memories.

product_name: Disney Tinker Bell & Captain Hook’s Pirate Ship Charm
description: Add adventure to your every day with our Disney Tinker Bell & Captain Hook’s Pirate Ship Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features thoughtful details fans will love, like Tick-Tock the crocodile, Peter Pan's outline in the ship's flag and Tinker Bell dangling from the bottom of the ship as it flies through the air. Wear it as a reminder to believe in magic and a sprinkle of pixie dust.

product_name: Disney Mickey & Minnie Mouse Kiss Red Murano Glass Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate love that was meant to be with our Disney Mickey & Minnie Mouse Kiss Red Murano Glass Dangle Charm. Engraved with the message “A forever kind of love”, this sterling silver charm features Disney’s most iconic couple. Look through the heart-shaped red Murano glass to see a silhouette of them sharing a sweet kiss and forming a heart with their hands. A meaningful gift for the Disney fan you love to love.

Carry the symbols of your favourite game with our Mahjong Triple Dangle Charm. In Chinese numerology, six is considered a lucky number and triple six represents a blessing for everything to go well. This sterling silver charm features three Mahjong tiles detailed with six red and green man-made crystals, six imprinted green enamel bamboo motifs and an engraved red enamel Chinese character for “six million.” Add it to your collection to always have a winning hand close by.

product_name: ME Broken Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Live your feelings with the ME Broken Heart Mini Dangle Charm. One side features a vibrant red man-made crystal heart and the other reveals a sterling silver broken heart. Whether you're feeling the love or going through heartbreak, add this to your collection as a reminder that it's all a part of the journey. This mini dangle charm can be styled on ME openable links across link chain bracelets, necklaces, rings and hoops.

Commit to the most important person in your life - yourself - with the ME Marry Me Double Link. Hand-finished and engraved with the reminder "Self love", this sterling silver double styling link features a rounded rectangular link connected to a small solitaire ring. Wear yours between openable links on your ME link chain bracelets or necklaces, or hang it on a pair of hoops for a unique statement.

Give yourself a little tough love with the ME Wire Heart Medallion Charm. Barbed wire swirls around the outline of an open heart, hand-finished in sterling silver. Whether you're guarding your heart, protecting your love or processing heartbreak, wear this as a reminder that you're stronger than you know.

Our Boxing Glove Dangle Charm serves as a reminder of how far you can get if you combine passion with dedication. Hand-finished in sterling silver, it features realistic stitching on its sides, a raised heart on its closing strap, a hand-applied pink enamel heart on its top and laces on its bottom. Carry its message of "Strength" with you into the arena of life.

Take flight with our Curved Feather & Pavé Clip Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features blue man-made crystals and floating feathers detailed with realistic texturing. Inspired by the idea that each feather has the power to give you wings, gift it to the one who always lifts you up. Please note: this clip charm is not lined with silicone, so it will slide unless styled over threads (two raised charm dividers).

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Cinderella's Enchanted Carriage Lab-grown Diamond Charm
description: Be swept away by our Disney 100 Cinderella's Enchanted Carriage Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, Cinderella's magical pumpkin coach is formed by an openwork swirling pattern. This limited edition design features a stem and door crafted in 14k solid gold and a window set with a sparkling lab-grown diamond. "Disney 100" is engraved on the back of the carriage to commemorate 100 years of wonder. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.

product_name: Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Dancing Groot Charm
description: Swaying from side to side in his flower pot,  Goot is crafted in sterling silver with brown man-made crystals set as his eyes and grooved, bark-like detailing as his hair and eyebrows. The only thing he ever says, "I AM GROOT" is engraved on the back of his head. Add this charm to your collection as a symbol of your ability to grow stronger every day.

product_name: Disney Parks Railroad Train Dangle Charm
description: Ride the legendary rails with our Disney Parks Railroad Train Dangle Charm. Modelled after the ride that takes you on a scenic tour of the park, this dangle charm features a sterling silver train with hand-applied transparent red enamel along its front and sides. It is detailed with a silhouette of Mickey Mouse's head on the back, a clear cubic zirconia set as the light at the front and realistic railroad tracks around the bail. Engraved with "All aboard" on its bottom and the Disney Parks logo on one side of its bail, this sentimental piece invites you on a magical journey down memory lane.

product_name: Disney Parks Zootopia Pawpsicle Dangle Charm
description: Our Disney Parks Zootopia Dangle Charm looks good enough to eat. Designed to resemble the cherry-flavoured ice pops sold by Nick Wilde and Finnick in Disney's Zootopia, this sterling silver dangle charm features a puffed paw coated with hand-applied transparent glittery pink enamel. It dangles from a sparkling bail engraved with the Disney Parks logo, "Zooptopia" and paw prints on one side. Add this charm to your collection as a reminder of sweet treats and even sweeter memories.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Minnie Mouse Lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm
description: Collect a beloved icon with our Disney 100 Minnie Mouse Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver with hand-applied black enamel detailing, this limited edition piece features Minnie Mouse in a playful pose, showing off her famous accessories. Her shoes are crafted in 14k solid gold and her bow is set with a sparkling lab-grown diamond. "Disney 100" is engraved on the back of her head to commemorate 100 years of wonder. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.

product_name: Disney Parks Stitch Tower of Terror Dangle Charm
description: Enter The Twilight Zone with our Disney Parks Stitch Tower of Terror Dangle Charm. Inspired by one of Disney's most famous attractions, this sterling silver dangle charm features the  Tower of Terror. Dressed in a bellhop outfit detailed wtih transparent red enamel, Stitch scales the tower, which appears eerily haunted with purple enamel windows and a gradient enamel cracked pattern around its bail. Engraved with "The HOLLYWOOD TOWER Hotel" on its bottom and the Disney Parks logo on one side of its bail, wear this piece as a reminder of a thrilling trip to The Fifth Dimension.

product_name: Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Star-Lord Dangle Charm
description: Crafted in sterling silver, Star-Lord is detailed with hand-applied enamel to accentuate his headphones, jacket and boots. Here to save the day, he holds his Quad Blaster and Walkman and wears his iconic helmet set with glowing red stones in the eyes. "STAR-LORD" and "LEGENDARY OUTLAW" are engraved on either side of the bail, which is also imprinted with the Guardians of the Galaxy emblem on its front. Add Star-Lord to your Marvel x collection to bring the action into your style.

product_name: Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Rocket Raccoon Charm
description: Our Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Rocket Raccoon Charm. An expert pilot and marksman, Rocket poses with his Laser Cannon and Aero-Rigs jetpack. He is crafted in sterling silver with hand-applied enamel detailing to accentuate his jumpsuit and grumpy demeanour. His tail, lined with grooves to give it a fur-like look, curls around his body. Engraved with "NOTHING LIKE ME 'CEPT ME" on the back of his head, wear this charm as a reminder to always be proud of who you are.

product_name: Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Cassette Tape Dangle Charm
description: Bring the funk with our Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Cassette Tape Dangle Charm. Designed to resemble the "AWESOME MIX VOL. 1" and "AWESOME MIX VOL. 2" Star-Lord listens to while he defends the galaxy, this sterling silver dangle charm features realistic tape detailing accentuated with hand-applied black and transparent red enamel. The design extends up its bail with grooved lines and a cut-out pattern similar to the tape reels in the charm. Wear it as a reminder to dance like nobody's watching - even if they actually are.

product_name: Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Rocket Raccoon & Groot Emblem Charm
description: Celebrate friendships across the galaxy with our Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Rocket Raccoon & Groot Emblem Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this shield-shaped charm features Rocket and Groot with the engraving "OH YEAAHH" on one side and a cut-out star emblem with the engraving "GUARDIANS" on the other. Its intricate detailing pops with hand-applied blue and shimmering deep blue enamel. Gift this charm to the Rocket to your Groot.

Immerse yourself in spring with our Cloud & Swallow Charm. This sterling silver charm features an intricate swirling cloud scene detailed with soaring swallows and sparkling pavé in varying shades of blue. Three raindrops set with blue man-made crystals dangle from the cloud. Engraved with "Let your dreams be your wings", wear it as an everyday reminder of all the inspiring possibilities that lie ahead.

product_name: Sparkling Swallow & Quote Double Dangle Charm
description: Spread your wings with our Sparkling Swallow & Quote Double Dangle Charm. Symbolising hope for better days to come, this sterling silver piece features a swallow detailed with grooved feather lines and pavé in varying shades of blue. "Time to fly" is engraved on a round disc behind the soaring swallow. Style this double dangle charm with other swallow-inspired jewellery for a look that channels the spirit of the season.

Reconnect with nature this spring with our Red Ladybird Dangle Charm. A universal symbol of hope and luck, this ladybird charm features a sterling silver cut-out wing pattern that shines through an opaque red stone. The ladybird's characteristic spots are carved into the stone and then filled with black enamel to create a realistic shell. Adding a touch of sparkle, the ladybird dangles from a bail set with a row of pavé. Wear it on your favourite Moments charm holder to bring your styling to life.

Defy the odds with our Flying Unicorn Pig Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver coated with transparent pink enamel, this charm features a pig poised to take flight. It is detailed with a spiralling rainbow enamel horn, grooved wings, raised hearts on all four feet and a curly tail. Engraved with "Nothing is impossible" on its stomach, wear this persistent pig as a reminder that you can do anything if you just believe.

Take flight with our Blue Curved Feather Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, both sides of this charm feature a curved feather detailed with hand-applied transparent blue enamel, accentuating the realistic texturing underneath. Inspired by the idea that each feather has the power to give you wings, gift it to the one who always lifts you up.

product_name: Multicolour Murano Glass & Curved Feather Charm
description: Reflect the spring sunshine with our Multicolour Murano Glass & Curved Feather Charm. Resembling the first rays of sun that break through after winter, this charm is crafted in gradient Murano glass with hopeful bursts of pink dichroic throughout. Realistically detailed feathers gracefully float around its sterling silver core. Gift this gleaming charm to the one who is a bright light in your life.

product_name: Openable Heart Chocolate Gift Box Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate the sweetest things in life with the Openable Heart Chocolate Gift Box Dangle Charm. This sterling silver dangle charm take the shape of an openable heart-shaped box of chocolates tied with a bright enamelled bow. Open the box and you'll see a selection of delicious-looking chocolates with red and purple enamel wrapping. The back of the box is engraved with "All you need is love and chocolate." A sweet treat for the one you love.

Take a trip to Transylvania with the Count Dracula Dangle Charm. This legendary Romanian vampire is ready to welcome you to his mountain abode of darkness and horror - just watch out for his fangs! This sterling silver dangle charm depicts Count Dracula with his cape wrapped around him secretively, adorned with swirling details and hand-applied black enamel, with transparent red enamel for the cape lining. His scowling face features a pointed nose and enamel details on his eyes and hair. The bail is engraved with the word "Dracula" and is surrounded by swirling raised vine details for a creepy finishing touch. Collect Count Dracula as a memory of your travels or a spooky jewellery gift for the horror fan in your life.

Celebrate their hard work and dedication with the Blue 2023 Graduation Heart Charm. This rounded heart charm is brought to life with transparent blue enamel over sterling silver, with a graduation cap perched at a jaunty angle on top of the heart, featuring a dangling tassel detail. The year "2023" is engraved on the front of the heart to mark their milestone. The perfect jewellery gift for your new graduate to congratulate them on their achievement and wish them all the best for their next step in life.

A jewellery gift as sweet as your love. The Sparkling Sprinkled Donut Charm is inspired by a universe of pop art and saturated candy colours. This playful yet modern charm takes the shape of a donut in sterling silver, complete with hand-applied pink gradient enamel frosting and a bite taken out of one side (who can resist a delicious donut?). The frosting is topped with polished silver sprinkles, one clear cubic zirconia and two Aurora Borealis cubic zirconia - shimmering with clear, pink and blue tones depending on how the light hits. The back is engraved with the words "Love at the first bite." An irresistible treat to add to your favourite jewellery.

product_name: Blue Murano Glass Family Tree Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate the power of family with our Blue Murano Glass Family Tree Dangle Charm. Just like the interconnected branches of a family or community, we are stronger when we support each other. This sterling silver dangle charm is inspired by the powerful family tree motif, featuring a Murano glass tree crown in shades of blue and cut-out tree branches on the back with heart-shaped leaves and grooved bark details. The tree trunk features the engraving “Keep growing” and the bail is engraved with the words “Supporting young voices”. Wear it or gift it as a symbol of the ones who matter most and how you’ll be always there for each other.

product_name: Disney Parks, Disney 100th Anniversary Mickey Mouse Costume Double Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate 100 Years of Wonder with the Disney Parks, Disney 100th Anniversary Mickey Mouse Costume Double Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm features Disney's iconic Mickey Mouse all dressed up to celebrate the occasion in a tailcoat outfit with purple enamel details. Behind him is a pavé-set number 100 dangling at an angle. Collect this special piece of Disney history as a tribute to your favourite Disney memories over the years.

product_name: Disney Parks Kanga & Roo Double Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate love for your family with your favourite characters from Disney's Winnie the Pooh. The Disney Parks Kanga & Roo Double Dangle Charm is crafted from sterling silver and features mother and son Kanga and Roo in a sweet pose on the front dangle. Behind them is a heart-shaped disc with a landscape depicted in coloured enamel and raised daisy and leaf details on the heart dangle and the bail. On the back of the heart is the engraving "M❤M". A special piece of jewellery to act as a reminder of fun family memories at Disney Parks.

product_name: Disney Parks WDW Castle Fireworks Double Dangle Charm
description: Capture the magic of Disney with the Disney Parks WDW Castle Fireworks Double Dangle Charm. This hand-finished sterling silver charm depicts the iconic Disney Parks WDW Castle with its six towers and blue enamel details on their rooftops. Showing behind the castle is a firework-shaped disc with hand-applied blue enamel on each streak of the starburst shape, using the "plique-à-jour" enamel technique to create a transparent effect that lets the light shine through. A raised five-pointed star sits at the centre of the firework shape and the bail features imprinted stars in various sizes. Collect the charm as a lasting reminder of the legendary fireworks display at Disney Parks.

Take inspiration from the beautiful shapes of nature with the Sparkling Herbarium Cluster Charm. Inspired by pressed flowers and leaves, this hand-finished charm features a cluster of pear-shaped clear cubic zirconia stones on each side, creating an elegant, nature-inspired shape. A cluster of microbeads at the centre of the stones creates the finishing touch. Style it on your favourite bracelet or charm holder as an everlasting reminder of the beauty of nature.

Add a touch of timeless sparkle to your look with the elegant and symbolic Sparkling Pavé Round Charm. This spherical sterling silver charm is set with a total of 88 clear cubic zirconia stones in different sizes, creating a voluminous geometric effect. 88 is a powerful number that represents progress, success and good fortune. It also resembles a double infinity symbol, representing the unlimited possibilities the future holds. Add it to your favourite jewellery styling or gift it to a loved one as a symbol of good things ahead.

The Sparkling Pavé Round Blue Charm is a bold addition to your collection of sterling silver charms. This sparkling pavé charm is set with precisely 88 stones. Why? Because the number 88 is thought to signify achievement, progress and success, and resembles an infinity sign. This blue man-made crystal and clear cubic zirconia charm is a sparkling reminder of eternal possibility. Our classic Sparkling Pavé Round Charm has been updated in a bold, blue hue, making it the ultimate piece for a solo style statement, or as a partner to your everyday favourites.

Add a touch of timeless sparkle to your look with the elegant and symbolic Sparkling Pavé Round Pink Charm. This spherical sterling silver charm is set with a total of 88 clear and pink cubic zirconia stones in different sizes, creating a voluminous geometric effect. 88 is a powerful number that represents progress, success and good fortune. It also resembles a double infinity symbol, representing the unlimited possibilities the future holds. Add it to your favourite jewellery styling or gift it to a loved one as a symbol of good things ahead.
