It also resembles a double infinity symbol, representing the unlimited possibilities the future holds. Add it to your favourite jewellery styling or gift it to a loved one as a symbol of good things ahead.

A meaningful charm to symbolise the unbreakable bond between mother and daughter. The Splittable Mother & Daughter Dangle Charm consists of two sterling silver dangle charms that fit together to create a heart shape in two halves, with a clear cubic zirconia stone at the centre and a cut-out heart on the reverse side. One half of the charm is engraved with the word "MOTHER" and the other half with "DAUGHTER", so you can each wear one half as a reminder that the love you share is always there, even when you're apart - because you'll always have a piece of each other's heart.

A meaningful charm for the one who's always there to save the day - Mum. The hand-finished Mum Hero Openwork Charm is crafted from sterling silver and features a circular openwork pattern on each side, with cut-out lettering reading "SUPER M❤M" on one side and "I❤YOU" on the other. With a modern, pop-art inspired look and a powerful message, it's the perfect charm to show her that you see and appreciate all the things she does for you, both big and small.

This special charm commemorates a love that is eternal, even when our dear ones are no longer with us. The Heart & Angel Dangle Charm is crafted from sterling silver and features a heart shape with a cut-out angel wing motif on one half of the heart, with the upper part of the wing slightly raised and decorated with pavé. The other half of the heart bears the engraved message "You left my world but never my ❤". The bail features two rows of pavé on its outer side. A meaningful piece to wear as a reminder of the ones you'll always carry in your heart.

This one's for all the dog mums out there! Wear a symbol of your love for your fur baby with the Heart & Dog Double Dangle Charm. This cute sterling silver double dangle charm features a cut-out heart with a row of sparkling pavé following the shape of the heart and two floppy dog ears at the top. A heart-shaped disc behind it is engraved with the message "I WOOF you." Gift it to the dog parent in your life or wear it on your jewellery or charm holder as a reminder of your faithful four-legged friend.

product_name: Pearlescent White Heart Mum Double Dangle Charm
description: An elegant gift for a mum who loves pearly tones. The Pearlescent White Heart Double Dangle Charm is crafted from sterling silver and features a cut-out heart shape adorned with a row of bioresin man-made mother of pearl stones. Behind this is another heart-shaped disc with the engraving "Thanks M❤M for all that you do", with a cut-out heart at the centre forming the central letter in the word "M❤M". Celebrate the mother figure in your life with a jewellery gift that speaks to your gratitude for all her love and care.

product_name: Pink Family Tree & Heart Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate the heart of your family with the Pink Family Tree & Heart Dangle Charm. This hand-finished dangle charm is crafted from sterling silver with a transparent pink cabochon man-made crystal shaped like a heart. On the back of the dangle, the heart is embraced by an openwork family tree motif in sterling silver, its polished branches and leaves symbolising an eternal love that grows like a tree and nurtures the lives we touch. The bail is engraved with the word "Family" and set with a sparkling pink cubic zirconia stone. Wear it on your bracelet or favourite charm holder to represent keeping the ones who matter most close to your heart, always.

product_name: Glittery White Murano Glass Mum & Love Charm
description: Gift a sweet message of love to the mother figure in your life with the Glittery White Murano Glass Mum & Love Charm. This hand-finished charm is crafted from sterling silver and glittering white Murano glass with a shimmery light-reflecting effect. Raised sterling silver scripts on either side of the charm's core read "m♥m" and "love" with a handwritten look, bringing a personal touch to this elegant and meaningful charm.

product_name: Map of France C’est La Vie Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate all things French with the Map of France C’est La Vie Dangle Charm. This hand-finished sterling silver charm is shaped like France with a red enamel heart and the engraved message "C'est la vie", meaning "that's life" - a famous French phrase that represents acceptance and living life to its fullest. The bail is decorated with clear, red and blue stones to represent the colours of the French flag. Wear it as a reminder of home or a symbol of unforgettable travel memories.

There's nothing like the smell of coffee in the morning... or any time! Bring the flavour of Italy to your styling with the Moka Pot Dangle Charm. This distinctive coffee pot has become an iconic part of Italian coffee culture. Our moka pot charm is crafted from sterling silver and features an openable lid with enamel detail, a band of pavé around the middle and a cut-out heart on the bottom. Pairs perfectly with your favourite charm holder and your morning brew.

Meet your passport to dream land - the Openable Passport Dangle Charm. Crafted from sterling silver, this sterling silver charm is engraved with "PASSPORT" "CITIZEN OF THE WORLD" and "Dream land" on the outside, with a blue enamel globe on the front. Open the passport to reveal engraved travel stamps and the messages "The world is yours" and "to explore". Add it to your styling as a reminder of all the places you've been and the ones you're dreaming of.

product_name: Celestial Sun, Star & Moon Clip Charm
description: Wear the power of symbols with the Celestial Sun, Star & Moon Clip Charm. This sterling silver clip charm is inspired by the mysterious beauty of the universe, combining sun, moon and star motifs brought to life with sparkling stones in clear, yellow and deep blue tones. It's lined with silicone so it stays in place on your chain and does not fit over threaders (raised bracelet dividers). The perfect finishing touch to your celestial bracelet styling.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Baloo Lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm
description: Can you hear a swinging beat? It's our Disney 100th Anniversary Baloo Dangle Charm! The fun-loving, easy-going sloth bear from Disney's The Jungle Book, Baloo is the life of the party and a loyal friend. Inspired by a scene from the much-loved film, our sterling silver charm captures Baloo dancing to the beat, wearing a solid 14k gold grass skirt and grasping a sparkling lab-grown diamond in one paw. To commemorate 100 years of magic, "Disney 100" is engraved on his back. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.
category: Talent Jewellery Selects: The Little Mermaid

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Donald Duck Lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm
description: For the ultimate Disney fan - collect our Disney 100th Anniversary Donald Duck Dangle Charm and celebrate one of Disney's most iconic original characters. Outfitted in his classic sailor shirt, Donald Duck is hand-finished in sterling silver with 14k gold accents on his beak and feet. Striking a jaunty pose, Donald raises his sailor's cap to reveal a sparkling lab-grown diamond. To commemorate 100 years of wonder, "Disney 100" is engraved on his side. Add him to your collection as a light-hearted reminder to look on the bright side and seek laughter every day. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.
category: Talent Jewellery Selects: The Little Mermaid

product_name: Disney The Little Mermaid Ursula Dangle Charm
description: Channel the deepest corners of the ocean with our Disney The Little Mermaid Ursula Dangle Charm. Inspired by the mysterious power of Ursula, this charm captivates with a luminous purple lacquered artificial pearl encased in sterling silver tentacles. Sparkling stones on the tentacles and a pavé-covered bail catch the light like the sun reflecting off the waves.
category: Talent Jewellery Selects: The Little Mermaid

product_name: Disney The Little Mermaid Seashell Charm
description: Discover treasures untold with our Disney The Little Mermaid Seashell Charm. This sterling silver piece depicts a wondrous underwater scene complete with colourful fish and swimming Ariel, each finished with hand-applied enamel details. Sterling silver beads represent ocean bubbles and add a whimsical touch to the coral reef set with pink stones . "Under the sea" is engraved over the seascape, reminding us that there's beauty and magic beyond the shore. Please note, this shell charm is closed and does not open. Slide it onto your favourite charm holder.

Our ME Butterfly Mini Dangle Charm serves as a reminder that you're always free to be yourself. Sterling silver openwork wings are offset with a sparkling round brilliant-cut stone at the centre of the butterfly. The bail is made to style on openable ME openable links and hoop earrings. Carry this icon of freedom as a symbol of your independent spirit.

Go your own way with our ME Compass Medallion Charm. Crafted from polished sterling silver, this hand-finished medallion charm features eight cardinal points set with a sparkling round brilliant-cut stone at their centre. The bail is made to style on openable ME openable links and hoop earrings. Carry this medallion charm as a reminder that you have the power to choose which direction your future takes.

product_name: Disney The Little Mermaid Sebastian Crab Dangle Charm
description: Carry a piece of your favourite story and add our Disney The Little Mermaid Sebastian Crab Dangle Charm to your collection. Inspired by Ariel's crustacean sidekick, this sterling silver charm features realistic crab details, like bead-set eyes, six crab legs and a crab claw dangling from a jump ring. An orange Murano glass crab shell is encased in an openwork wave pattern, allowing Sebastian’s signature colour to shine through. The crab-claw shaped bail features an engraved logo on one side and ©Disney logo on the other. Keep Sebastian close as a symbol of guidance and friendship, or gift it to someone who you can always count on.
category: Talent Jewellery Selects: The Little Mermaid

product_name: Disney The Little Mermaid Ariel Dangle Charm
description: Journey beyond the sea with our Disney The Little Mermaid Ariel Dangle Charm, inspired by the new live-action film adaptation. Celebrate your free spirit and curious heart by adding this sterling silver charm to your collection. Ariel's face and locs are brought to life with engraved details, and her mermaid tail shines with hand-applied teal and cerise enamel. A sparkling aurora borealis clear cubic zirconia rests atop the bail, like the sun reflecting on the ocean waves. Keep Ariel by your side as a reminder to follow your heart where adventure leads.
category: Talent Jewellery Selects: The Little Mermaid

product_name: Blue Murano Glass Butterfly Dangle Charm
description: Transform into your best self with the Blue Murano Glass Butterfly Dangle Charm. This hand-finished sterling silver charm features Murano glass wings in a bicoloured blue gradient with a cut-out sterling silver pattern on the back that shows through the glass, and sterling silver swirls on the front. Microbeads on the butterfly's body and pavé on the bail add a touch of delicate detail and sparkle. Add this blue butterfly to your styling as a powerful symbol of hope, transformation and new beginnings.

Home is a feeling you carry with you - just ask our little hermit crab. The Glow-in-the-dark Hermit Crab Dangle Charm is crafted from sterling silver and features a cute hermit crab with realistic details and a spiral shell with hand-applied spotted blue enamel that glows green in the dark. Sparkling stones on the eyes, claws and bail bring the charm to life. Hermit crabs find a shell to call home, and when they outgrow the shell, they relocate to a new one. Wear this charm as a symbol of the comfort and safety of home and our ability to carry that feeling with us as we change and grow.

Meet the newest addition to your nature-inspired styling - the Metallic Blue Gecko Charm. Inspired by the lively movement of a real-life gecko, this cute lizard charm curls around your snake chain bracelet or charm holder. A lifelike scaled pattern shows through its transparent enamel in shades of blue and turquoise, creating a metallic effect. The gecko charm is slightly smaller than most, adding variation when styled together with other charms. Wear it as a symbol of positivity, resilience and renewal.
category: The most loved summer jewellery trends 2024

product_name: Camera, Heart & Compass Triple Dangle Charm
description: One for the dreamers and explorers. Wear the Camera, Heart & Compass Triple Dangle Charm to carry your favourite travel memories on your jewellery. This sterling silver triple dangle features a camera with a sparkling stone as the lens, a heart-shaped map of the world with blue and green gradient enamel and a compass with a fixed orienteering arrow. "Discover", "Dream" and "Explore" are engraved on the backs of the dangles. Style it together with your favourite charms from your travels as a reminder to always keep exploring.

Channel the wisdom of the oceans with the Colour-changing Jellyfish Dangle Charm. This hand-finished sterling silver charm features movable sterling silver tentacles, clear cubic zirconia stones as eyes and special enamel in blue tones that changes colour in high or low temperatures. In nature, the jellyfish goes with the flow and is always moving forward - add it to your favourite charm styling as a reminder to embrace change and trust your inner self.

Keep your favourite memories close with the Barcelona Monument Dangle Charm. Inspired by the iconic Sagrada Família church designed by the architect Antoni Gaudí, this sterling silver 3D dangle features the cathedral's characteristic details including its pointed towers, spires and windows. It is engraved with "BARCELONA WITH ❤". As one of the most famous monuments in Barcelona, it's a must-visit landmark that has been under construction for over 140 years. Style the Barcelona charm together with your most treasured travel charms or bring it home as a special souvenir.

Shine bright wherever you are with the Glow-in-the-dark Lighthouse Dangle charm. Featuring hand-applied red enamel stripes and life-like lighthouse details including cut-out windows, a look-out spot as well as glow-in-the-dark glass in the windows and a cut-out heart at the bottom. Traditionally used to guide ships safely home in the night, the lighthouse is a reminder to stand firm and always be there for those in need. Style it together with your favourite charms for everyday guidance or gift it to someone that represents hope and safety in your life.

product_name: NYC Apple, Torch and Street Sign Triple Dangle Charm
description: Mark your favourite memories with the NYC Apple, Torch and Street Sign Triple Dangle Charm. Carry the unmistakable atmosphere of the Big Apple with you with this sterling silver dangle charm featuring symbols of New York City. Combining a red Murano glass apple, the Statue of Liberty's famous torch and the famous Fifth Av. street sign design in blue green enamel, this dangle charm symbolises the endless dreams the city holds. Bring home a small piece of the big city for yourself or someone close to your heart.

Show them that they're one in a million with the Friends Splittable Heart Dangle Charm. Nothing says best friends forever like gifting your bestie one half of a sterling silver charm engraved with the message "Friends to the end" on both halves. Both sides of the heart feature a polished centre with sparkle along the outline. The heart-shaped design features a crack in the middle, which completes the heart shape when the two halves are placed together. A great friend is hard to find, so celebrate yours with a special Moments charm that represents your bond.

Bring even more of the iconic studded texture into your look with the Studded Clip Charm in sterling silver. With its pyramid and spherical stud texture, this clip charm will feel right at home on your studded chain bracelet, as its pattern echoes the new icon. The charm features no silicone grips on the inside, so it will add movement to your styling, while spacing your charms. It will stay fixed when styled on threads, however, spacing your charms. Create a camouflage-style look by adding it to the studded chain of the same tone.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Dumbo Lab-grown Diamond Charm
description: Believe in yourself like Disney's Dumbo, the little elephant with big ears and even bigger dreams. The limited edition Disney 100th Anniversary Dumbo lab-grown Diamond Charm depicts the baby elephant soaring through the sky using his wonderful ears, crafted in sterling silver with solid 14k gold accents. He holds a lab-grown diamond in his trunk, symbolising the “magic” feather that gives him the confidence to fly. "Disney100" is engraved on the back of Dumbo's head to commemorate 100 years of wonder. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Simba Lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm
description: Be the mane event with Disney's Simba from The Lion King. The limited edition Disney 100th Anniversary Simba lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm is crafted from sterling silver and solid 14k gold and shows Simba as a cub in a playful pose, with one front paw resting on a sparkling lab-grown diamond. "Disney100" is engraved on the back of Simba's head to commemorate 100 years of wonder. Each Lab-grown diamond is treated with a post-growth colour enhancement called annealing.

Feel the love in cool blue tones with the Blue Spinnable Heart Charm. The heart-shaped piece in sterling silver features hand-applied transparent blue enamel, making it perfect for adding a pop of colour to your charm stack. On this charm, one of the sides features a spinning disc covered in blue sparkle on one side and an engraved message that reads "My favourite PERSON" on the other. Please note that the disc is only spinnable when not styled, so we recommend deciding which side to show before wearing it. Gift it to your bestie and leave them in no doubt about how you feel about them!

Channel your lucky side with the Four-leaf Clover Dangle Charm. This sterling silver dangle charm is shaped like the ultimate symbol of good fortunate, the four-leaf clover. Its front is set with green sparkle and each of the leaves is shaped as a half-heart for an added loving touch. Additionally, each leaf holds symbolism of its own, bringing faith, hope, love and luck into the mix. The back features a decorative cut-out pattern. Attract positive energy into your life with this unique dangle or gift it to someone you love that could use a little luck.

Bring in double the luck with the Splittable Four-leaf Clover Charm. This four leaf-clover shaped sterling silver charm packs more than meets the eye, as its inner clover is splittable from its outer shell and can be worn as a whole separate charm of its own, making it the ideal piece to gift to someone close that needs a little extra luck. The inner clover features the engraving "True friends are a rare gift" on its back and "Lucky to have you" on its side, heart-shaped leaves as well as green man-made crystals in two different tones. This Moments charm is filled with positivity and symbolism that stands for faith, hope, love and luck - and who doesn't want that!

product_name: Disney Pixar Monsters, Inc. Logo M Charm
description: The ultimate charm for fans of Disney and Pixar's Monsters, Inc. The Disney Pixar Monsters, Inc. Logo M Charm features a block letter M with blue enamel and an eye motif, a nod to the film's one-eyed co-hero Mike Wazowski. The centre of the eye features a black man-made crystal. The Monsters, Inc. slogan "WE SCARE BECAUSE WE CARE" is engraved across the top and bottom of the charm. Add it to your jewellery collection as a reminder that there's nothing more powerful than friendship and laughter.

Capture the power of laughter and friendship with the Disney Pixar Mike Wazowski Charm. This sterling silver charm with hand-applied green enamel captures Mike's iconic facial expression and single eye, set with a green man-made crystal. The enamel is transparent, giving him a metallic sheen thanks to the shine of the sterling silver underneath. Style him together with his buddy Sulley and our other charms from the Disney x collection, for a bracelet that reminds you of your favourite monster moments.

product_name: Four Leaf Clover, Heart and Horseshoe Triple Dangle Charm
description: Keep luck close with the Four-leaf Clover, Heart and Horseshoe Triple Dangle Charm. This sterling silver dangle charm features three different symbols of good fortune including a four-leaf clover, a heart and a horseshoe. The heart is engraved with the word "Sisterhood". The horseshoe sparkles with clear cubic zirconia, the heart glistens with a white lab-created opal and the clover features royal green crystals. Wear this Moments charm as a symbol of good luck and protection or gift it to someone you care about deeply

product_name: Marvel Doctor Strange Agamotto Eye Dangle Charm
description: Summon the multiverse with Doctor Strange and the MARVEL Doctor Strange Agamotto Eye Dangle Charm. Shaped as an eye, the Eye of Agamotto disc features a green man-made crystal as well as the engraving "FORGET EVERYTHING THAT YOU THINK YOU KNOW". The eye is enhanced with openwork swirling patterns echoing ancient overlapping designs, adding to the mystery of the piece. The stone inside Eye of Agamotto symbolises time, as it is one of the Infinity Stones. Add it to your collection of Marvel charms or gift it to the Doctor Strange fan in your life.

product_name: Disney Pixar Monsters, Inc. Door Dangle Charm
description: Open the door to friendship with the Disney Pixar Monsters, Inc. Door Dangle Charm. This sterling silver dangle charm features Pixar's lovable monsters Mike and Sulley hanging onto a door that opens to reveal little Boo. This dangle charm also features colourful hand-applied enamel, which brings each character to life. Wear it as a reminder of the friends who make you scream with laughter and who always have your back (be it spiky, furry or anything, really). After all, whether monster or human, there’s nothing more powerful than friendship and laughter!

Make friendship a part of your look with the Faceted Murano Glass Friendship Charm. Add a pop of colour to your charm collection with this vibrant green jewellery piece in faceted Murano glass. The inner part of the core is covered with a thin layer of silver foil for added shine and the outside parts feature the script 'friends' on the side facing one way and 'always' facing the other. Express how much your friends mean to you by wearing it together with your favourite charms or surprise your best friend with this thoughtful piece.

Summon the Chaos Magic of Scarlet Witch with the MARVEL Scarlet Witch Charm. Inspired by the iconic character's trademark look, the charm depicts her wearing her iconic headpiece filled with hand-painted red enamel. She's shown mid-action with outstretched arms and has a red stone set in each of her palms. The rest of her outfit is coloured with enamel, together with her swooshing cape, which features a special layer of gradient transparent enamel going from red to cerise. Add her to your team of Marvel legends or gift her to the Marvel fan in your life.

Show your love spans to infinity and beyond with the Sparkling Infinity Dangle Charm. The ultimate symbol of everlasting connection, the infinity symbol has been reimagined in a slightly asymmetrical shape featuring pink sparkle on its front side. Attached to the bail at the top with its smaller loop, this infinity charm features a heart shape cut-out on the back where its parts overlap. Gift it to a friend of a family member to let them know your bond will last forever and beyond

Add the magic of the night sky into your look with the Sparkling Crescent Moon Charm. The openwork, sterling silver moon charm is set with different-sized stones. One of its sides features six four-point cut-out stars, while the other side has four cut-out stars. Inspired by the Chinese Valentine's Day, the moon charm combines the mystical romance of love and the night sky and makes for the perfect gift for a loved one.

product_name: Sparkling Crescent Moon & Spinnable Star Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate love and duality with the Sparkling Crescent Moon & Spinnable Star Dangle Charm. Featuring two night sky motifs, the bright sterling silver moon and the dark ruthenium-plated star, this Moments charm is filled with magical contrasts. The dark star features a stone in its centre, openwork details and can spin, while the crescent moon is fixed and also sparkles with different-sized stones. Inspired by the Chinese Valentine's Day, this sterling silver charm combines the romance of love and the night sky and makes for the perfect gift for a loved one.

product_name: Blue Murano Glass Balloon Dangle Charm
description: Reach for the sky with the Blue Murano Glass Balloon Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm centres on a domed glittery blue Murano glass shaped like a balloon. The reverse side of the glass is covered with delicate details and openwork script that reads "Fly high."

Make a wish with our ME Wishbone Mini Dangle Charm. Referencing the tradition of pulling apart a wishbone to see who gets the longer end (and their wish granted!), each half of this mini dangle charm is detailed differently, with polished silver and cubic zirconia on one side and macro beads on the other. Still unbroken, it symbolises your unlimited potential. Style yours across your ME link chain bracelets, necklaces, rings and hoop earrings to bring a little luck to your looks.

Live life to its fullest with our ME Skull Mini Dangle Charm. Crafted from pure sterling silver, the mini dangle charm features two brilliant-cut cubic zirconia eyes and realistic nose and teeth features that prove the death is in the detail. Bringing a lighthearted touch to the collection, its meaning isn't dark or direct, it was inspired by the emoji you send when you're dying of laughter. A reminder to not take life too seriously, style yours on openable links across your ME link chain bracelets, necklaces, rings and hoop earrings. To style, or not to style - that is the question...

product_name: ME Sparkling Yin & Yang Mini Dangle Charm
description: The ME Sparkling Yin & Yang Mini Dangle Charm proves that opposites attract. Crafted in sterling silver with black enamel and cubic zirconia to capture its characteristic contrast, style yours as a reminder to bring balance to your life. Add it to your ME link chain bracelets, necklaces, rings or hoop earrings, then switch it up daily to match your mood.

Good luck is on the cards with our ME Tarot Card Medallion Charm. Bringing a new rectangular shape to the collection, this sterling silver design is our very own ME take on the world of tarot. Detailed with a horseshoe, a clover and an eye, the medallion charm features a unique motif you won't find in traditional decks. Positioned upright, it guarantees you'll always have a lucky card up your sleeve, or on your link chains. Style yours across your ME link chain bracelets, necklaces, rings and hoop earrings.

product_name: ME Hamsa Hand Mini Dangle Charm
description: Our sterling silver ME Hamsa Hand Mini Dangle Charm is crafted from sterling silver with black enamel detailing. This meaningful piece hangs downward, inspired by symbols of protection. Set with a bezel-set man-made crystal, wear yours as a reminder to welcome goodness, kindness and grace into your life. Style it across your ME link chain bracelets, necklaces, rings and hoop earrings.

Add some edge to your look when you wear the Glow-in-the-dark Sparkling Skull Charm. This sterling silver charm features a skull covered in glow-in-the-dark enamel with a mouth and heart-shaped eyes sparkling with clear cubic zirconia stones. Cut-out details adorn the sides of the mouth, the nose and the bottom of the skull. Pay homage to the mystery of the afterlife and add an irreverent – not to mention glowing – touch to your style with this skull pendant.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Mickey Mouse Lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm
description: Collect a piece of Disney history with the Disney 100th Anniversary Mickey Mouse Lab-grown Diamond Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm depicts the iconic Mickey Mouse in lifelike detail, with a lab-grown diamond sparkling from his hand, solid 14k gold shoes and black hand-applied enamel details on his eyes and nose. Collectors will appreciate the engraved , Disney and Disney100 logos that adorn this charm. A symbol of imagination, optimism and fun, this Mickey Mouse charm is sure to make anyone smile.

product_name: Disney Pixar Coco Miguel & Dante Skull Glow-in-the-dark Charm
description: Celebrate the power of family with the Disney Pixar Coco Miguel & Dante Skull Glow-in-the-dark Charm. Made of sterling silver, this charm features much-loved characters Dante and Miguel from Disney and Pixar's Coco film. Colourful enamel details – some of which are glow-in-the-dark – pop from the silver base, which has cut-out, grooved and imprinted details. For Disney lovers and charm collectors alike, this skull charm is a tribute to the love and traditions that connect us across generations.

Shine on from every angle with the Sparkling Pavé Triple-row Charm. Crafted from exactly 85 pavé-set round brilliant-cut clear cubic zirconia, this sterling silver charm from our Moments collection delivers a touch of shine to any ensemble. An elegant pavé charm that is sure to lend a dash of elevated sparkle to the everyday.

product_name: Sparkling Splitable Angel Wings Dangle Charm
description: Our Sparkling Splittable Angel Wings Dangle Charm uplifts and inspires. Designed for sharing, these sterling silver charms offer a touching tribute to your own angels. Set with clear cubic zirconia and stellar blue man-made crystals, this angel wings charm features the engraved message “I’ll always be there” on the back of each wing. One for you and one for someone you love, wear these dangle charms to honour the ones who matter most.

product_name: Double Candy Cane Heart Christmas Dangle Charm
description: Embrace the festive spirit with the Double Candy Cane Heart Christmas Dangle Charm. Our sweet candy cane charm channels the playful traditions of this special time of year. Two candy canes form a heart with red enamel details, while an apt “Sweet heart” is engraved into the centre dangling heart. Matching messages “Candy cane wishes" and "Mistletoe kisses” are engraved on the back of each candy cane, making this a fun and festive addition to your favourite sterling silver charms. Add a sprinkle of sugar to your festive-themed bracelet with one of our new Christmas charms.

Add a sprinkle of sugar to your festive season with our Gingerbread House Charm. This charm from our Moments collection features a gingerbread woman wearing a pink bow on one side, and a gingerbread man with green bowtie on the other. The colourful enamel details really bring Moments charms like this one to life. Bring a dash of holiday spirit to your favourite chain or bracelet with our sterling silver charm inspired by a classic gingerbread house.

Feel the holiday magic with the Magical Christmas Reindeer Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm features an elegant reindeer in a dashing pose, as if it's flying through the air leading Santa's sleigh. Engraved and imprinted snowflakes create a wintry feel and blue man-made crystals bring the reindeer's eyes and antlers to life. The engraving "Magic is in the air" adorns one side of the reindeer's body, while colourful man-made crystals set in star shapes bring a festive touch to the bail. A magical gift to celebrate the joy of the season.

Honour the importance of family with the Cut-out Sparkling Star Charm. This sparkling star charm is inspired by ’s vintage charms from 2004 and 2005. This sterling silver charm combines star-shaped cut-outs with cubic zirconia stones set in matching star shapes. A symbol that shines as bright as your personal universe, no matter how you wear it.

The Heart Pattern Clip Charm is a new addition to the Moments collection. This sterling silver charm features an endless pattern of alternating heart shapes that appear multi-dimensional. This clip-on heart charm has no silicone grip, so it will slide if not styled onto threads (two raised charm dividers). Give yourself – or someone special – a little love with a sterling silver clip charm as a reminder of your special bond.

Wear your heart on your sleeve with the Openwork Family Heart & Star Charm. Heart and star motifs adorn the latest Moments charms; their symbolism honouring the importance of family. A gift for yourself or someone you love, this charm features cut-out stars along the side of the charm and a larger cut-out star at each side of the heart. Two beloved motifs come together to create a sterling silver charm that shines (almost) as bright as the ones you love the most.

Travel to the stars with the Space Love Rocket Charm. With a little imagination – and a sprinkle of magic stardust – this Moments charm proves it’s always possible to reach your dream destination. One side of the rocket features a round cut-out with a grooved line detail to represent a window, with cut-out stars surrounding it. The other side has a “Love you to the moon and back" engraving, while the bottom of the rocket is set with coloured man-made crystals and has dangling stars. A sterling silver charm that serves as a symbol to remind us that no matter how far away your dreams may seem, anything is possible.

Make every day radiant with the Sparkling Sun Dangle Charm. This intricate sterling silver charm features a sun sparkling with pavé and surrounded by sleek, striking rays, half of which are polished and half of which are set with cubic zirconia stones and microbeads. One yellow man-made crystal sparkles from the bail. Inspired by the brilliant beauty in the sky, this sun pendant will light up your look and your mood.

product_name: Sparkling Sun & Crescent Moon Clip Charm
description: Bring sophisticated sparkle to your look with the Sparkling Sun & Crescent Moon Clip Charm. This sterling silver clip charm features a raised crescent moon on one side and a raised shining sun on the other. Sparkling stones are set within and surrounding both the moon and sun. Silicone inside the charm keeps it in place. Channeling the awe-inspiring beauty of the skies above, this charm makes a sleek and subtle addition to your everyday style.

One of Disney’s most beloved characters returns with the Disney Sorcerer Apprentice Mickey Charm. This charm features hand-applied glittery enamel details and shining star motifs inspired by Disney’s much-loved Fantasia. Mickey Mouse is even holding a round cubic zirconia set in a star, a sparkling reminder of the magic that's never far away. On its own or as a playful pop to your favourite everyday styling, this charm is a must-have for any Fantasia fan.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Blue Murano Glass Charm
description: Wear your favourites with the Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Blue Murano Glass Charm. Disney's most beloved duo make a return in the new Disney x collection. This special charm features a shimmering effect inspired by Disney’s much-loved Fantasia. The charm features a sterling silver core surrounded by glittery two-tone blue Murano glass with four round clear cubic zirconia suspended inside it. Wear Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse every day on your favourite chain or bracelet.

Wear a symbol of fierce courage with the Game of Thrones Daenerys Charm. Shaped like the iconic Daenerys Targaryen character from Game of Thrones, this sterling silver charm features an enlarged head and fine detailing, including transparent red enamel with a dragon-scale pattern on the clothes. On her back sits a small replica of Drogon, one of Daenerys's three dragons. This charm will remind you of her strength and determination on her incredible journey.

product_name: Game of Thrones Sparkling Dragon Egg Charm
description: Wear a symbol of otherworldly potential with the Game of Thrones Sparkling Dragon Egg Charm. This sterling silver charm features fine details that mirror the dragon eggs in Game of Thrones. The charm includes dragon scale-like textural details and a top-to-bottom crack with sparkling stones and microbeads. Whether you're gifting this charm to a die-hard fan or wearing it yourself, think of it as symbolic armour for the everyday world.

product_name: Game of Thrones Ghost Direwolf Charm
description: Carry a symbol of loyalty and protection with the Game of Thrones Ghost Direwolf Charm. Inspired by a beloved Game of Thrones animal character – Jon Snow's dependable direwolf, Ghost – this sterling silver charm features realistic grooved fur lines and facial details, including red lab-created crystals as eyes and black hand-applied enamel on the snout. An ideal gift for fans of the series, this charm serves as a reminder that safety can come in all forms of people, places and creatures.

product_name: Game of Thrones The Iron Throne Charm
description: Discover an amulet from a conquered kingdom with the Game of Thrones The Iron Throne Charm. In this sterling silver charm, elaborate detailing replicates the Iron Throne from Game of Thrones, including the many enemies' swords that created it. The charm, polished with a single green lab-created crystal, represents the legacy, lore and fierce competition to take the throne and rule the Seven Kingdoms. Wear it and be transported back to the thrilling world and fearsome battles.

product_name: Game of Thrones Ice & Fire Dragons Dual Murano Glass Charm
description: Represent your kingdom when you wear the Game of Thrones Ice & Fire Dragons Dual Murano Glass Charm. Made of red and blue Murano glass that meets seamlessly in the middle, this dragon charm has a sterling silver core that depicts dragons with heads, scaled bodies and tails. For the Game of Thrones fans who want to wear their fandom with subtle sophistication, this Murano glass charm is a must.

Reach for the stars with the Bold Sparkling Star Charm. This sterling silver charm takes the form of a star with softly rounded edges. The five-pointed star charm is set with man-made crystals in two different shades of blue, and each round stone is set in different star shapes. The puffy shape of this star-inspired charm brings an extra dimension of light and dreaminess to any bracelet or chain. Make a style statement by wearing it on its own, or add a sprinkle of stardust to your favourite charms.

Jingle through the holidays with the Christmas Sleigh 2023 Dangle Charm. Engraved onto the back of the sleigh is an everlasting memory of the year. Glittery red and blue enamel brings even more shine to the gifts, while snowflake imprints cover the bail of this sterling silver dangle charm. Whether you want to carry a reminder of the festive season all year round, or infuse the holidays with extra sparkle, this sterling silver dangle charm will bring holiday cheer to any look.

Sparkling blue stones and shimmering enamel come together in the Sparkling Moon Spinning Dangle Charm. This charm features a crescent moon shape set with smooth cabochon-cut man-made crystals in three different shades of blue, creating a dreamy effect. The small sterling silver disc inside the curve of the moon is designed to spin and features shimmering enamel on one side and a "Dreams come true" engraving on the other. Wear this sterling silver dangle charm to inspire you to pursue your dreams, every day.

Honour your angels with the Sparkling Angel Wings & Heart Charm. Designed to uplift and inspire, this sparkling addition to the Moments collection is set with 68 round brilliant-cut clear cubic zirconia stones. A memorable addition to your sterling silver charms, this charm is made even more special with a white lab-created opal dangling from the heart-shaped set of wings. A touching tribute to all the angels who watch over us.

Add a festive glow to your jewellery with the Opalescent Snowman Dangle Charm. Be reminded of the beauty of snowy days spent building and decorating snowmen with this new Moments charm. Crafted from two shimmering lab-created opals, this sterling silver dangle charm features playful details like a pavé scarf, a grooved broom and ear-warmers with microbead details. Gift it to the one you'd build a snowman with, or wear it to bring holiday cheer to any look.

product_name: Shooting Star Grooved Murano Glass Charm
description: This glittering Shooting Star Grooved Murano Glass Charm is destined to be the star of your holiday season. Crafted from grooved transparent Murano glass, it's one of the festive season's brightest sterling silver charms. The sterling silver core shines even brighter thanks to a layer of 24k gold foil. With two cubic zirconia stones set in shooting star shapes near the core, this charm delivers the kind of shimmer normally reserved for the twinkling stars in the night sky.

Shine bright this season with the Sparkling Christmas Tree Dangle Charm. Capture the true magic of the holiday season with this silver dangle charm that features a tree-shaped green man-made crystal dotted with shimmering golden enamel to represent stars. On the other side, different coloured man-made stones are set along the tree’s sterling silver branches. A twinkling, brightly coloured Christmas charm brings the most festive of touches to your collection of Moments charms – and every holiday look you pair them with.

Blue shimmer captures the magic of the night sky in the Faceted Blue Murano Glass Charm. A shiny new addition to the Moments collection, the Murano glass requires precise craftsmanship to reveal the true depth of its mesmerising blue hue. The glittering blue Murano glass charm has many rhombus-shaped facets that are designed to twinkle like a star-studded night sky, making it the perfect addition to any chain or bracelet.

Our Movable Teddy Bear Dangle Charm is made of stardust and love. This extra-special teddy bear charm is crafted with stones set in star shapes, inspired by galaxies of shooting stars. With moveable arms and legs, this silver dangle charm serves as the perfect reminder that anything is possible. Featuring a blue man-made crystal set in a star to represent its heart, this teddy makes for an extra special addition to your most-loved charms.

The Family Love Double Dangle Charm offers a special way to keep them close. A sterling silver charm with two discs that tell a story through engravings. Spread across the surfaces, it reads: "Family... are like STARS, you don't always see them... But they are ALWAYS there". Finishing this dangle charm are flush-set round clear cubic zirconia and blue man-made crystals that twinkle like stars. Wear on your favourite chain and always be reminded of those you love the most.

Whisk yourself away to a winter wonderland with our Skiing Penguin Charm. This sterling silver charm features a lovable penguin in a skiing pose, as if it's swishing through the snow. The penguin is brought to life with black enamel on its body, wings and eyes, and a cosy scarf embellished with sparkling pavé. The perfect gift to rekindle nostalgic memories of fun days in the snow.

Reach for the stars with the Bold Pavé Star Charm from our Moments collection. Combining sterling silver and sparkling pavé, this statement charm has been updated with softly rounded edges to bring an extra dimension of light and dreaminess to any bracelet or chain. This star-shaped charm is covered in blue man-made crystal pavé, bringing the perfect amount of festive shine to any look.

product_name: Disney 100th Anniversary Winnie the Pooh Lab-grown Diamond Charm
description: Celebrate 100 Years of Wonder with the Disney 100th Anniversary Winnie the Pooh Lab-grown Diamond Charm. The newest Disney100 charm from Disney x comes complete with a brilliant-cut lab-grown diamond. This Winnie the Pooh charm is sure to be as special to you as sweet, golden "hunny" is to Pooh. In this case, his honey is crafted from solid 14k gold, making this limited edition charm a precious piece of Disney history ready to join your collection.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse Sparkling Head Silhouette Dangle Charm
description: Add a sprinkling of Disney magic with the Disney Mickey Mouse Sparkling Head Silhouette Dangle Charm. Featuring three clear cubic zirconia stones arranged in the silhouette of the iconic character, this sparkling charm is the perfect holiday gift for yourself or someone special. Crafted from sterling silver, it makes a glittering addition to your favourite sterling silver charms. Just like the one that inspired it, a Mickey Mouse charm is a forever classic. Style it with your other beloved charms to bring a touch of magic to any outfit.

The stars are always aligned when you wear the ME Sparkling Star Medallion Charm. With a prism-shaped profile, this sterling silver star charm includes a sparkling stone hand-set in one of its five points. The reverse side features microbeads, a raised line and a triangle-shaped hole in the setting through which the stone is visible. Gift this medallion charm to someone who puts stars in your eyes, or wear it as a reminder that you're the star of your universe. Compatible with ME and Moments.

Tap into high-def shine with the ME Rectangular Openable Link. A staple for every jewellery collection, this polished sterling silver link features grooved lines on the sides for a subtle design detail. Designed to be worn on bracelets, necklaces or earrings, this rectangular openable link can be styled with mini dangle charms or medallion charms. Pair it with your favourite sterling silver charms for a monochromatic look or mix it up with different metal tones and coloured enamels.

Embrace your sun sign when you wear the ME Zodiac Wheel Medallion Charm. Featuring engraved symbols of all 12 zodiac signs, this sterling silver zodiac charm has the ability to spin. The bail has a teardrop-shaped pointer dangle with a sparkling stone, while the reverse side of the charm features a circle of microbeads. With intricate details and cool functionality, this zodiac medallion charm lets you spin the dial anytime you want to align your mood or your look. Compatible with ME and Moments.

Feel the cosmic love with ME Galaxy Heart Medallion Charm. One side of this sterling silver octagonal medallion charm has a raised heart surrounded by glittery deep blue hand-applied enamel. The reverse side features a raised heart surrounded by cut-out rays with microbeading. Designed to be styled on openable links, wear this medallion charm as a reminder that love always wins and is at the heart of our mysterious universe. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Sparkling Angel Wing Mini Dangle Charm
description: Let your spirits soar when you wear the ME Sparkling Angel Wing Mini Dangle Charm. One side of this sterling silver mini dangle charm boasts sparkling stones and raised line detailing, while the reverse features two curved rows of microbeading. The rich texture on each side contrasts prettily with the polished sides of the wings and the link-shaped bail. This angel wing mini dangle charm will bring an ethereal touch to your look and remind you to let your dreams take flight. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Black Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Love has no limits when you wear the ME Black Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm. This sterling silver heart charm features black hand-applied enamel and a black heart-shaped man-made crystal at centre. The reverse side features a polished sterling silver heart with grooved lines and cut-out detailing. A reminder that wild hearts can't be broken, this mini dangle charm brings a depth to your look, symbolising that love – for yourself and others – always wins. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Blue Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Love has no limits when you wear the ME Blue Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm. This sterling silver heart charm features transparent blue hand-applied enamel and a blue heart-shaped man-made crystal at centre. The reverse side features a polished sterling silver heart with grooved lines and cut-out detailing. A reminder that wild hearts can't be broken, this mini dangle charm brings a depth to your look, symbolising that love – for yourself and others – always wins. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Green Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Love has no limits when you wear the ME Green Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm. This sterling silver heart charm features green enamel and a green heart-shaped man-made crystal at centre. The reverse side features grooved lines and cut-out detailing. A reminder that wild hearts can't be broken, this mini dangle charm brings a depth to your look, symbolising that love – for yourself and others – always wins. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Purple Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Love has no limits when you wear the ME Purple Chakra Heart Mini Dangle Charm. This sterling silver heart charm features purple hand-applied enamel and a purple heart-shaped man-made crystal. The reverse side features a sterling silver heart with grooved lines and cut-out detailing. A reminder that wild hearts can't be broken, this mini dangle charm brings depth to your look, symbolising that love – for yourself and others – always wins. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Sparkling Cross Mini Dangle Charm
description: Bring a 90s edge to your vibe with the ME Sparkling Cross Mini Dangle Charm. Putting a fresh spin on a timeless symbol, this sterling silver cross mini dangle charm has microbeads on one side, sparkling stones on the other and faceted sides. The stones are set within raised lines designed to create a twisted effect. This mini dangle charm gets all the details right and will instantly bring an iconic touch to your look. Compatible with ME and Moments.

It's nothing but good vibes when you wear the ME Gratitude Spiral Medallion Charm. This sterling silver spiral charm features sparkling stones and intricate design elements including a prism-shaped outline, cut-out details and an engraved line that reads "I am grateful for all that I am, I am grateful for the power within me." Style this spiral medallion charm on your favourite openable link as a symbol and celebration of self-awareness, self-love and self-expression. Compatible with ME and Moments.

product_name: ME Freehand Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Take self-love to a new level with the ME Freehand Heart Mini Dangle Charm. Dainty and delicate, this sterling silver charm features a freehand heart outline. Polished on one side with microbeading on the other, the beauty of this piece is all in the details, including its subtle asymmetry and squared profile. Wear this heart charm solo for an understated yet cool look, or use a threader to pair it with your favourite mini dangle charms or medallion charms. Compatible with ME and Moments.

Invite good luck and protection in the coming year with the Lucky Amulet Double Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm is shaped like a red envelope, a traditional symbol of good luck in Chinese culture. Auspicious cloud patterns show through from beneath bright red enamel. One side of the amulet features the word 平安 (ping'an), meaning "peace" or "safe and sound". Dangling from the bail is a small sterling silver peace knot, inspired by a traditional Chinese art form. Wear it or gift it to a loved one as a wish for good things in the year ahead, and always.

Spell out what's in your heart with the Handwritten Love Charm. This openwork sterling silver charm is shaped like the word “love” in a handwritten style, designed to follow the line of your bracelet or charm holder. The word is mirrored on the other side of the charm, and the letter "o" is shaped like a heart for a playful touch. Gift it as a wearable love note to a special person - yourself or someone else.

product_name: Openable & Engravable Love Locket Dangle Charm
description: Keep what's most dear to you close to your heart with the Openable & Engravable Love Locket Dangle Charm. This sterling silver locket charm features a clear cubic zirconia stone on the front in the shape of a keyhole, and opens and closes securely so you can keep a tiny picture, note or lock of hair inside. The inside of the locket is engraved with the message "TODAY TOMORROW ALWAYS", and the back is blank for your own engraving. Wear it on your Moments necklace or bracelet as a symbol of keeping your love safe and a reminder to cherish it, every day.

product_name: Disney Cinderella's Glass Slipper Dangle Charm
description: Have your own glass slipper moment with the Disney Cinderella's Glass Slipper Dangle Charm. Cinderella's famous glass slipper is reimagined as a sterling silver charm with dreamy light blue man-made crystal. The bail and sole of the shoe are adorned with star shapes, and two blue cubic zirconia stones add sparkle to the bail. Wear it as a reminder that you already have everything you need within for a happily ever after - the YOU edition.

Have a ball every day with the Disney Cinderella Murano Glass Charm. Inspired by the magical moment when Cinderella's Fairy Godmother transforms a pumpkin into an enchanted carriage, this sterling silver charm features swirling openwork carriage motifs on either side of a blue Murano glass core. The glass has a unique grooved texture and silver foil within the glass for a shimmering effect. Style it on your favourite bracelet or charm holder as a reminder to keep following your dreams, just like Cinderella.

product_name: Disney Parks Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Clip Charm
description: Get ready for a Disney Parks adventure with the Disney Parks Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Clip Charm. This sterling silver Mickey and Minnie charm is set with 62 clear cubic zirconia stones. One side features a Mickey Mouse ears hat motif with black enamel and the other has a Minnie Mouse ears headband with black and red enamel - sure to bring back nostalgic memories of special Disney moments. This clip charm does not have silicone inside - style it on the threaders (raised bracelet dividers) to keep it fixed in place.

Trust your intuition with the ME Spade Medallion Charm. This sterling silver charm creates a spade motif with an inverted heart-shaped frame and a triangle shape, detailed with microbeads and a sparking stone. The Ace of Spades is often thought to represent wisdom, intellect and growth. This medallion charm can be styled on Moments charm holders and openable links on ME carriers.

Unlock your love with the Splittable Heart & Key Dangle Charm. This two-piece dangle charm includes a sparkling pavé key dangle that fits perfectly into the cut-out of the heart-shaped piece. On the heart-shaped disc, the word "Love" is spelled out in sparkling stones above the cut-out. Wear both pieces together or share it with the one who holds the key to your heart.

Find your match with the ME Key Mini Dangle Charm. This sterling silver key charm has a squared profile and grooved lines for a retro feel, with microbeads adding texture on one side. Pair it with the ME Keyhole Heart Mini Dangle Charm to symbolise those relationships that just "click", or wear one yourself and gift one to the person who's a perfect match. This mini dangle charm can be styled on Moments charm holders and openable links on ME carriers.

product_name: Red Heart & Arrow Murano Glass Dangle Charm
description: A charm for all the lovestruck hearts out there! The Red Heart & Arrow Murano Glass Dangle Charm features a red heart crafted from Murano glass, struck by a sterling silver Cupid’s arrow. The arrow spells out the word “love” through the glass, with the "o" forming a heart shape for a playful touch. A row of clear cubic zirconia pavé adds sparkle to the bail. Gift it as a fun and sweet gesture of love for the one who has your heart.

product_name: ME Keyhole Heart Mini Dangle Charm
description: Find your match with the ME Keyhole Heart Mini Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm features a heart-shaped clear cubic zirconia stone with a keyhole motif in black enamel, inspired by the symbolism of tattoo art. Behind the stone is a heart-shaped cut-out to let the light shine through. Pair it with the ME Key Mini Dangle Charm to symbolise those relationships that just "click", or wear one yourself and gift one to the person who's a perfect match. This mini dangle charm can be styled on Moments charm holders and openable links on ME carriers.

Reveal what's in your heart with the Colour-changing Hidden Message Heart Charm. At room temperature, this charm looks like a rounded heart with bright red enamel. But when you hold the charm, it heats up and the enamel turns pink, revealing a secret message: "I ♥ U” on one side of the heart and “ALWAYS” on the other. A playful charm for the one you love with an extra element of surprise.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Heart Charm
description: Celebrate a forever love with the Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Heart Charm. Mickey and Minnie’s love comes to life in this heart-shaped sterling silver charm, featuring a silhouette of the iconic duo in black enamel, sitting back-to-back and holding hands. The other side features the engraving “Always + Forever” and a red enamel heart with the "+" visible through the enamel. A love-filled gift for a special Disney fan.

Make your own luck with the ME Lucky Medallion Charm in sterling silver. This modern amulet radiates love and luck, with four cut-out hearts forming a four-leaf clover shape surrounded by glittery deep blue enamel, clear stones and raised stars. The reverse side is detailed with grooved lines and microbeads. This medallion charm can be styled on Moments charm holders and openable links on ME carriers.

Add a splash of colour to your charm styling with our Blue Mini Murano Glass Charm. This new charm design has a smaller size than our other Murano charms and a slightly squared shape, creating new ways to play with colour and dimension in your charm line-ups. The core is made from sterling silver and fits on any Moments charm holder. Pair it with your favourite sterling silver charms or get creative and mix with the same style in other colours.

The core is made from sterling silver and fits on any Moments charm holder. Pair it with your favourite sterling silver charms or get creative and mix with the same style in other colours.

description: Featuring Mickey Mouse as the sorcerer from Fantasia, this sterling silver charm is adorned with golden enamel and artificial pearl details that make it simply magical.

description: Not only a mouse, but also a fashionista, Minnie Mouse makes her mark on this glittering sterling silver charm. A gorgeous gift idea that will delight Disney fans and collectors.

description: Step back in time to when Disney’s famous Steamboat Willie cartoon premiered, with Mickey Mouse at the helm. Celebrate the historic moment with this dazzling sterling silver charm, topped with the iconic hat in sparkling stones.

product_name: Disney, Santa Mickey's Candy Cane Pendant Charm
description: You're never too old for a candy cane. Case in point: this festive Disney pendant charm in sterling silver and red enamel detailed with Mickey Mouse dressed as Father Christmas.

description: Put a festive spin on your style with this Disney pendant charm in sterling silver. Depicting Mickey Mouse dressed as Father Christmas carrying gifts, the hand-finished design is detailed with colourful enamel.
Show off your love of Christmas and magic with this hand-finished Disney charm in sterling silver and red, green and black enamel. Mickey Mouse is dressed as Father Christmas on this festive design.

Hand-finished from sterling silver and decorated with intricate flowers, Mary Poppins' iconic and magical bag is rendered as a sterling silver charm. Wear this Disney piece with other favourites from the classic film.

product_name: Disney Mary Poppins' Umbrella Dangle Charm
description: Mary Poppins' magical umbrella is immortalised on this Disney pendant charm in sterling silver, detailed with jet black enamel. Wear yours to let your style soar.
Celebrate everyone's favourite nanny with this Disney Mary Poppins charm. The sterling silver and enamel design features a silhouette of her flying through the sky, umbrella and bag in hand.
Celebrate Christmas in space with this rocket ship charm in sterling silver. Detailed with Father Christmas at the controls, the enamelled design gleams with festive spirit.

description: Our Moments safety chains are designed to keep charms securely on your bracelet. This hand-finished, sterling silver design adds a celestial touch to stylings. Fitted with swivel ends to prevent the chain from tangling, simply thread one side onto your bracelet before adding charms, connecting the unattached side of the safety chain once your charms are in place.

description: Add personality to your bracelet with our pioneering square Murano glass charm. Each Heart Melter charm is crafted with a unique expression, making it exclusive to you. It's cool to be square!

Created in collaboration with Disney's in-house toy design team, the cat’s design is centred on an enlarged head and smaller body that highlights his mysterious grin. The Cheshire Cat sterling silver charm features hand-applied enamel details as well as his signature striped outfit. Wear it with your favourite Disney x charms to create your own style adventure.

Get your own loyal sidekick with this hand-finished Disney Pluto charm from the Disney x Favourites series. Created in collaboration with Disney's in-house toy design team, the dog’s design is centred on his enlarged head and smaller body that highlights his cheerful expression. The Pluto sterling silver charm features green and black hand-applied enamel details. Wear it with your favourite Disney x charms to create your own style adventure.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Happily Ever After Dangle Charm
description: Capture the magic of Disney's Mickey and Minnie with this double dangle charm hand-finished in sterling silver. Featuring the iconic couple sitting on a bench as they look out at the night sky, the back dangle depicts a nighttime nature setting with shaded enamel details. The back of the dangle features the engraving “You are my Happily Ever After”, making the charm the perfect gift for someone special.

This dog paw print charm is the perfect gift for the fur mum that has everything. Dogs are a big part of our lives and what better way to show that than with a sterling silver Openwork Paw Print Charm. Featuring a cut-out paw in the shape of a heart, it represents the fact that dogs are a big lovable part of our lives and that they really are our best friends and a part of our family.

Say hello to Patti the Sheep and welcome her to the Friends family. Patti the Sheep reminds us that it doesn’t matter how you look, it matters who you are. She also helps us remember to embrace our differences, to be unique, to be yourself and most importantly to be kind of everyone. All in all, she represents inclusivity and diversity. The sweet charm is hand-finished in sterling silver and makes for a great addition to your Friends collection.

A special surprise for any poodle lover, this dog charm is sure to bring a smile to their face. Inspired by the love we have for our furry friends, the Poodle Puppy Dog Dangle Charm in sterling silver features beaded fur and a dangling heart tag on the collar. Give it to yourself ‘just because’ or to your favourite dog lover to let them know how much you love their pooch.

product_name: Wavy Fancy Pink Murano Glass Charm
description: Colourful and sophisticated, the Wavy Fancy Pink Murano Glass Charm can elevate any outfit. Transform your look from ordinary to extraordinary with this Fancy Pink coloured Murano glass charm filled with glitter and topped with a wavy glass surface. A touch smaller than our traditional Murano charms, this charm is the perfect complement to your style. Every Murano glass charm is hand finished and features a sterling silver core engraved with the logo.

This hand-finished Sparkling Paw Print & Heart Charm adds a sweet touch to any outfit. Made from sterling silver, the heart-shaped charm features a dog’s paw in the centre and is filled with clear cubic zirconia details for an extra touch of sparkle. A small dangling tag with the engraving “Fur mum” shows that pets are important to us and are a big, lovable part of our families and lives.

Colourful and sophisticated, the Wavy Lavender Murano Glass Charm can elevate any outfit. Transform your look from ordinary to extraordinary with this iridescent and lavender Murano glass charm filled with glitter and topped with a wavy glass surface. A touch smaller than our traditional Murano charms, this charm is the perfect complement to your style. Every Murano glass charm is hand finished and features a sterling silver core engraved with the logo.

Keep your roots close with the openwork family tree charm hand-finished in sterling silver. The family tree represents staying true to who you are and the unbreakable bonds that bind the family together. The openwork charm features the family tree motif that is set with sparkling clear cubic zirconia. The roots feature heart details to highlight love for your family. Wear this piece as a reminder of those close to you or gift it to someone important to you.

product_name: Disney Minnie Mouse Dotted Dress & Bow Charm
description: Collect one of your childhood icons with this hand-finished Disney Minnie Mouse charm from the Disney x Favourites series. Created in collaboration with Disney's in-house toy design team, the mouse’s design is centred on her enlarged ears and head and smaller body that highlights her happy face. The Minnie Mouse sterling silver charm features her signature red outfit and black hand-applied enamel eyes. Wear it with your favourite Disney x charms to create your own style adventure.

Make your mum feel special with this sterling silver double dangle charm. The charm is coloured with pink hand-applied enamel on the back dangle, while the front disk features a “MUM” openwork script with a heart-shaped detail. The bail is dotted with fairy tale pink cubic zirconia for a touch of sparkle. The engraving on the back dangle reads “I love you”, making it the ideal present for the mother figure in your life.

Say “Happy Birthday” with this sterling silver Pink Birthday Cake Dangle Charm. Celebrate the special day with a cake charm that will keep you in festive spirits all year round. The dangle features a hand-applied pink enamel design and clear cubic zirconia dotted around representing candles. The raised “Happy Birthday” script on the front dangle is joined by a candle symbol engraving and the message "Make a wish!" on the back. Make any birthday one to remember with this celebratory charm.

This Openwork Flower Heart Mummy Charm is the perfect gift for any mother or mum-to-be. Beaded grid details with pop-out flowers add a touch of shine, while the smooth heart-shaped disc engraved with “Mummy” pays tribute to the wonderful mother figure. Give this sterling silver heart charm to your mum or to the new mother in your life to let them know how much they mean to you.

Celebrate baby’s entrance into the world with a special sterling silver double dangle charm. The charm’s front dangle features a stork carrying a little bundle among a starry night sky and is set with sparkling clear cubic zirconia. The back dangle features shimmering light blue enamel and has the engraving “Twinkle twinkle little star do you know how loved you are?” engraved on the back. The dangle makes the perfect gift for new parents.

Make the special moment last forever with the sterling silver Married Couple Dangle Charm. Let the romance of saying “I do” live on with this emotional charm featuring a newlywed couple kissing. The groom gently holds his bride as she carries her flowers in her hands and the bail is set with clear cubic zirconia. Make this meaningful piece a part of your collection or gift it to a bride close to your heart.

Celebrate your family with the sterling silver Boy Teenager Charm. Create your family-inspired charm collection and let the piece remind you of a special teen in your life. The boy is holding a skateboard and is sporting his favourite bandana. The Crown O and number 1 are engraved on the back of his shirt. Whatever family means to you, keep them close and wear meaningful family charms on your favourite Moments bracelet or the O Pendant.

Celebrate your family with the sterling silver Girl Teenager Charm. Create a family-inspired charm collection and let the piece remind you of a special teen in your life. The girl’s braids dangle on the back of her head as she winks and wears her favourite pair of headphones. Whatever family means to you, make sure to keep them close to your heart and wear meaningful family charms on your favourite Moments bracelet or the O Pendant.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse Red Trousers Charm
description: Collect one of your childhood icons with this hand-finished Disney Mickey Mouse charm from the Disney x Favourites series. Created in collaboration with Disney's in-house toy design team, the mouse’s design is centred on his enlarged ears and head and smaller body that highlights his smiling face. The Mickey Mouse sterling silver charm features red and black hand-applied enamel details. Wear it with your favourite Disney x charms to create your own style adventure.

Celebrate scholarly achievement with the sterling silver Wise Owl Graduation Charm. Commemorate the special milestone that serves as a reminder of all of your hard work and personal growth with a charm featuring an owl wearing a graduation hat sitting atop a scroll, both of which feature a dangling tassel. The owl’s eyes are two stellar blue crystals. Wear the graduation charm as a symbol of the fact that you can accomplish anything you put your mind to.

Celebrate scholarly achievement with the sterling silver 2020 Graduation Books Charm. Commemorate the special milestone that serves as a reminder of all of your hard work and personal growth with a charm featuring two books, a scroll and a graduation hat with a dangling tassel that moves as you do. Wear the graduation charm with “2020” engraving as a symbol of the fact that you can accomplish anything you put your mind to.

Commemorate the trip of a lifetime or honour your Brazilian heritage with this Brazil Beach & Parrot Dangle Charm. Featuring a double dangle design, one dangle shows a beautiful Brazilian beach scene with sparkling icy blue crystals. The second dangle is open front and depicts a parrot and hibiscus flower with colourful enamel detailing. The rear of the dangle charm is engraved with the words “Love Brazil” to remind you of the special country.

A symbol of good luck and perseverance, the Red Daruma Doll Charm is the perfect memento of a Japanese adventure. This sterling silver good luck charm is covered in hand-applied bright red enamel with shimmering gold and silver accents and “” in raised lettering. Traditionally used for setting goals and bringing encouragement, you can wear your charm to help you focus on what’s important or simply to add a splash of colour to your outfits.

Capture the magic and history of the Colosseum with this Rome Colosseum Openwork Charm. The world’s most popular tourist attraction is brought to life on this Rome charm. The openwork design sparkles with clear cubic zirconia and also features heart cut-outs all around the charm to show your love for the ancient architectural wonder. Engraved with the word “Rome”, it can be worn to commemorate a special visit or your love for culture and the past.

Celebrate one of Italy’s most famous attractions with this Venice Rialto Bridge Openwork Charm. The Rialto bridge is the oldest of the four bridges that span the Grand Canal. Built in the 12th century, this landmark is memorialised on this openwork charm. The Venice charm features sparkling clear cubic zirconia and with heart cut-outs on the sides and is engraved with the word “Venice”. Wear it to relive every magical moment of your stay.

product_name: Hong Kong Peak Tram Dangle Charm
description: Make the views last forever with the Moments Hong Kong Peak Tram Dangle Charm. The only way to experience the natural beauty of Hong Kong, the Peak Tram offers breath-taking panoramic views of the harbour and skyscrapers. This double dangle design showcases the tram and skyline with colourful hand-applied enamel, silvery glitter and two clear cubic zirconia. It is engraved with the words “I love having you along the way” and “HK” for Hong Kong.

Show the world you’ve achieved your goals with this Camel & Tassels Charm. The reclining camel is a symbol of accomplishment and replenishment. This sparkling sterling silver charm features a kneeling camel with a finely detailed oriental carpet on its back with a dangling tassel. Wear the camel charm to commemorate a goal that you’ve achieved and are particularly proud of or to remind yourself to take a step back and enjoy the process.

Show your love for the Stars and Stripes with this American Pinwheel Dangle Charm. Inspired by the red, white and blue of Fourth of July celebrations, the pinwheel American charm is bursting with patriotic colour. It features a cubic zirconia set in the centre of the star and engraved stars all around the bail. It’s the perfect way to show your patriotism on the Fourth or any day of the year that could use a little sparkle or pride.

Celebrate your heritage or a fantastic Canadian holiday with this Canada Moose Maple Leaf Charm. The sterling silver Canadian Moose is wearing a hand-applied red enamel vest with a maple leaf symbol on the back to show the world where he comes from. The heart-shaped hooves leave lovely heart prints wherever he goes. Wear the moose charm to whisk you back to the Great White North every time you’re longing for adventure.

product_name: Wavy Dark Blue Murano Glass Ocean Charm
description: Get lost in the intricate patterns that are hidden inside the Wavy Dark Blue Murano Glass Ocean Charm. The ocean-inspired charm is hand-finished with iridescent and dark blue Murano glass infused with a sprinkling of glitter, wrapped around a sterling silver core. The blue charm finished with a wavy surface inspired by the waves of the ocean. Wear the wave charm to stay connected to the power of the ocean, no matter where in the world you are.

product_name: Murano Glass Sea Turtle Dangle Charm
description: The Murano Glass Sea Turtle Dangle Charm is inspired by the peaceful creatures of the deep blue sea. The sea turtle charm features bleached aqua blue crystals, icy green crystals and a single peacock Murano glass bead. The sterling silver cut-out pattern on the belly of the turtle features a heart and shines through the Murano glass to create a beautiful scale-like effect that dances with the light.

product_name: Murano Glass Pink Sea Turtle Dangle Charm
description: Our much-loved sea turtle charm is joined by a new friend in frosted pink. This sterling silver dangle charm features pink and purple man-made crystals on the bail and frosted Murano glass as its shell with unique shimmering flecks that catch the light. The belly of the sea turtle has a sterling silver cut-out pattern with an off-centre heart to create a pretty scale-like effect. Carry more turtle friends on your Moments bracelet or charm holders.

Make a splash with this Shimmering Dolphin Dangle Charm. Symbols of diplomacy, good luck and peace, dolphins have the natural ability to build bridges with anyone. This dolphin charm comes to life with a sparkling icy green crystal and hand-applied glossy blue enamel that fades elegantly into the sterling silver. Wear the dolphin charm to show your love for marine life and all the beautiful, playful creatures that live in the deep blue sea.

Show that your love goes all the way to the bottom of the ocean with this Openwork Seahorses Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this openwork charm with two kissing sea horses in love features hidden starfish details and delicate wave cut-outs on the sides. A polished round tag engraved with the heartfelt message “When we have each other, we have everything” dangles from the bottom of the heart and dances every time you move.

Dive into summer with this Openwork Starfish, Shells & Hearts Charm, inspired by the treasures hidden underneath the ocean’s surface. The sterling silver openwork design is decorated with different types of seashells, starfish and heart details with chiselled and beaded textures, which create an intricate and eye-catching finish. Wear it to show your love for everything the ocean has to offer or simply as a way to add a little sparkle to a summer outfit.

Take a bite! The strawberry was ’s first-ever charm and has been reimagined and relaunched to celebrate charms' 20th birthday. Each finely detailed sterling silver strawberry charm is finished with a special 20-year hallmark. This is the first of a curated selection of 12 of our most loved charms, created in a very limited number for collectors. Each collectable charm represents a universe of stories, unique to those who wear them, to say something about you.

The kiss of true love! The playful little frog has been reimagined and relaunched to celebrate charms' 20th birthday. Each finely detailed sterling silver frog charm is finished with a special 20-year hallmark. This is the second of a curated selection of 12 of our most loved charms, created in a very limited number for collectors. Each collectable charm represents a universe of stories, unique to those who wear them, to say something about you.
