Each finely detailed sterling silver bee charm wears a crown and is finished with a special 20-year hallmark. This is the first of a curated selection of 12 of our most loved charms, created in a very limited number for collectors. Each collectable charm represents a universe of stories, unique to those who wear them, to say something about you.

product_name: Disney Pixar's Up House & Balloons Charm
description: Get ready to go on a journey of a lifetime with Disney Pixar’s Up House & Balloons Charm. The colourful charm features a bundle of hand-applied enamel princess blue, light blue, mandarin orange, pale cerise, vibrant green, purple and magenta balloons carrying the sterling silver dangle house that Carl uses to go on his fantastic journey. Raised letters amongst the many colourful balloons add an inspirational touch with the statement “Adventure is out there”.

Get inspired to go looking for the deeper, hidden meaning in life with this Shimmering Narwhal Charm. Often called the unicorn of the sea, the narwhal represents protection, freedom and wisdom. They are also believed to have magical powers that let them see beyond the surface. This Narwhal Charm is finished with a hand-applied glossy deep blue enamel that brings out the shine of the sterling silver tusk on top of its head.

Add a splash of raspberry pink shine to your look with the Pink Spacer Charm. This charm marks the first time hand-applied enamel is used in the ME collection. The pink enamel creates a multi-dimensional metallic finish that resembles pink metal and adds a pop of colour to your stack. Use the spacer to create fixed stylings on the ME snake chain bracelet or ME bangle or just to add a burst of bright colour.

product_name: ME Blue Whale Mini Dangle Charm
description: Blue Whale Mini Dangle Charm is inspired by the ocean, summer and self-discovery. This hand-finished sterling silver shimmering pavé whale is covered in hidden details including a small lifted fin and life-like lines on its belly. The ME charm also features a black crystal, sparkling clear cubic zirconia, icy blue, skylight blue and stellar blue crystals. Let the beachy vibes inspire you to find what the whale symbol means to you.

product_name: ME Four-leaf Clover Mini Dangle Charm
description: Every day is your lucky day with the ME Four-leaf Clover Mini Dangle Charm. Sparkling green pavé crystals sparkle against the shine sterling silver for good luck or whatever else this symbol means to you. Each leaf forms a heart in the clover supported by a polished stem. The back is covered in micro-beads for a reversible design that captures your mood. Wear it as a reminder to achieve your goals or gift it to your bestie to let them know you've got their back.Discover how to mix and re-mix your ME look here.

Set your own course with the ME Compass Mini Dangle Charm. Four guiding cardinal points overlap the polished edges and a sparkling pink crystal acts as a beacon in the centre of the compass. The back of the sterling silver mini dangle charm is embellished with micro-beads forming a star. Mix and re-mix it as a part of the ME collection or wear as a daily reminder to stay true to yourself.Discover how to mix and re-mix your ME look here.

product_name: ME Summer Sun Mini Dangle Charm
description: Add a ray of sunshine to any moment with the Summer Sun Mini Dangle Charm. Inspired by the ocean, summer and self-discovery, the ME sun charm sparkles with limelight yellow crystals and blazing yellow crystals. A pavé design on the front and beading on the back create a naturally sparkling effect that sparkles and shines when the light hits them – just like you. Carry a little sunshine with you wherever you go and decide what the sun means to you.

A little bit naughty, a little bit nice and all you, the Pineapple Mini Dangle Charm means exactly what you want it to. Designed in collaboration with Millie Bobby Brown, The ME charm sparkles with royal green, limelight yellow and blazing yellow crystals. The reverse side features beaded details in sterling silver. Inspired by the ocean, summer and self-discovery, it’s the perfect way to say everything without saying a word and decide what the symbol means to you.

Wear your heart on your sleeve and show the world your loves with the ME Love Mini Dangle Charm. Sparkling red cubic zirconia on one side and beaded sterling silver detail on the other add a dazzling twist to this ME style. Inspired by the symbols of love and self-discovery, this heart mini dangle charm will complete up any outfit, but more importantly - serve as a reminder of what love means to you!Discover how to mix and re-mix your ME look here.

product_name: ME Pink Flamingo Mini Dangle Charm
description: Get ready to go tropical with the Pink Flamingo MIni Dangle Charm. Cerise crystals, fancy fairy tale pink and a single clear cubic zirconia create shaded pink pavé effect on the front of this ME charm. Turn it over to reveal beaded sterling silver on the back. Designed in collaboration with actress, model and activist Millie Bobby Brown, the charm is inspired by the symbols of summer, ocean, travel and self-discovery, but only you can decide what it means to you.

product_name: ME Flying Bird Mini Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate your independent spirit with the ME Flying Bird Mini Dangle Charm. Symbolising freedom and the future’s endless possibilities, this sterling silver ME mini dangle charm takes flight with sparkling clear cubic zirconia. The front of the bird features sparkling pavé and the back showcases sterling silver micro-beads. The bird mini dangle charm makes for the perfect addition to your ME rotation and serves as a reminder to spread your wings and fly on the wings of style.Discover how to mix and re-mix your ME look here.

Mark a special occasion with the 2020 Limited Edition Hearts Clip Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this clip charm features slightly oxidised heart outlines and a specially designed logo in celebration of the 20th anniversary of Moments. Inspired by The brand's original clip charm and archived, collectable Moments charms, the piece has been reinterpreted and redesigned for the current moment. Die-hard fans and new lovers alike will love this limited-edition piece. This clip charm features no silicone grip, so it will slide if not styled onto threads (two raised charm dividers).

Keep your heart safe! The heart safety chain has been reimagined and relaunched to celebrate charms' 20th birthday. Each finely detailed sterling silver safety chain charm with heart details is finished with a special 20-year hallmark. This is the sixth of a curated selection of 12 of our most loved charms, created in a very limited number for collectors. Each collectable charm represents a universe of stories, unique to those who wear them, to say something about you.

product_name: ME Blue Ocean Wave Mini Dangle Charm
description: Show the world that your feelings run deep with the Blue Ocean Wave Mini Dangle Charm. Featuring sparkling clear cubic zirconia, icy blue, skylight blue and blue crystals, this ME blue charm is hand-finished in sterling silver. Designed in collaboration with actress, model and activist Millie Bobby Brown, it is inspired by the symbols of the ocean, travel and self-discovery, but only you can decide what it means to you.

product_name: ME Pink Starfish Mini Dangle Charm
description: Express every side of your personality with the Pink Starfish Mini Dangle Charm. Designed in collaboration with actress, model and activist Millie Bobby Brown as a part of the ME collection, the starfish charm is inspired by the symbols of the ocean, summer, travel and self-discovery. The ocean piece sparkles with synthetic pink sapphires set on a sterling silver starfish shape. Wear it on your favourite ME style and add your own meaning to complete the look.

product_name: Disney Beauty and the Beast Dancing Dangle Charm
description: Enter the magical world of Disney's Beauty and the Beast with this evocative double dangle charm. Disney's Belle and the Beast dance within an openwork frame surrounded by roses set with man-made yellow crystals. The ballroom is depicted in a background disc in transparent yellow hand-applied basse-taille enamel technique. The bail features 3D rose details. Commemorating the imperfect but magical love between Belle and the Beast, the dangle charm is engraved with the phrase “Beauty is found Within”.

product_name: Disney Beauty and the Beast Mrs. Potts and Chip Dangle Charm
description: Be our guest and help yourself to this Disney Beauty and the Beast Mrs. Potts and Chip Dangle Charm. Featuring two of the most unforgettable characters from Disney's Beauty and the Beast, this sterling silver Mrs. Potts-shaped charm features an adorable little Chip swinging from the base. Both characters are brought to life with lilac, blue and pink hand-applied enamel details. The sweet charm will add heartwarming cheer to every look.

The universal symbol of love, the iconic heart has been reimagined and relaunched. To celebrate charms' 20th birthday, this is the fourth of a curated selection of 12 of our most loved charms, re-created in a very limited number for collectors. Each finely detailed sterling silver heart charm is finished with a special 20-year hallmark.  Each collectable charm represents a universe of stories, unique to those who wear them, to say something about you.

Add your favourite place to your bracelet with the Singapore Merlion Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the charm depicts the Merlion, the iconic symbol of Singapore. Featuring a lion’s head with a fish body, the character echoes Singapore’s past as a fishing village and its original name “Singapura”, which means “lion city.” Featuring a highly detailed mane and fish scale details, let this symbolic piece remind you of good times spent in a special place.

Show off your love for the game with the Badminton Birdie Dangle Charm. Featuring openwork feathers on the base and a tiny embossed heart on the underside of the cork, this detailed badminton charm is hand-finished in sterling silver with ibis rose hand-applied enamel touches and a "loves badminton" engraving. Pair it with other charms that represent your favourite sports and hobbies and enjoy the playful, charming flair it brings to your look.

Step into the ring and show off your inner and outer strength with the Boxing Glove Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this boxing glove charm features a vintage-style glove with top stitching, lace-up detail and bow-shaped knot. Engraved with the word "strong" for extra inspiration. Each time you wear this charm, allow it to be a symbolic reminder of your own power, in and out of the boxing ring.

product_name: Bella Bot at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 Charm
description: Celebrate history in the making with the Bella Bot at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14k gold, along with hand-applied pink enamel touches, the charm embodies a new incarnation of Bella Bot, a Friend, who wears a 14k gold medal to symbolise the strength of female athletes. The dangle tag is engraved with the monogram and logo on one side and the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 emblem on the other.

Spread your wings and embrace great style with the American Bald Eagle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the bald eagle is the national symbol of the United States of America and makes for a great addition to any meaningful charm stack. The happy eagle sports a backpack with blue, red and white hand-applied enamel stars and stripes in the colours of the USA flag to remind you of a special trip or a place close to your heart.

Add a new loyal friend to your collection with the Japanese Akita Inu Dog Charm. The sweet pup is hand-finished in sterling silver and his snout is detailed with hand-applied black enamel. The loyal canine also sports a bandana around his neck with white and red enamel detail representing the flag of Japan. A national icon in his native country, let the Akita Inu represent what the country of the rising sun means to you.

Ride the wave of great style with the Surfing Koala Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the koala is one of Australia’s most popular and iconic animals. The Koala Charm’s features are accentuated with hand-applied black enamel and the sweet bear is also holding a surfboard with a hand-applied Australian flag representing one of the country’s favourite pastimes. Wear as a reminder of a country close to your heart or gift the charm to an Australia-loving friend.

Make your charm stack roar with great style with the Wavy Union Jack Lion Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this lion charm is sporting a highly detailed wavy mane and wears an enamelled cape patterned with the Union Jack flag. Symbolising strength, courage and dignity, the lion charm is a great addition to your charm collection full of meaning. Wear it as a reminder of your favourite place or gift it to a your travel buddy.

Make a signature style statement with the Logo & Heart Bands Spacer Charm. This chunky, architectural piece features two interlinking and overlapping bands and is hand-finished in sterling silver. The first band is embossed with hearts on both sides, while the second band is embossed with the logo on both sides. Simple and classic in every way, this versatile, wear-it-anywhere charm will make for an ideal addition to your everyday look.

Bring a regal flourish to your look with the Logo & Crown O Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the charm features the iconic Crown O in a new, rounded shape with openwork details. Embossed with the logo on both sides of the O, with cut-out hearts along the edges and a 3D crown atop the circle, this charm makes a classic yet modern addition to your everyday look.

product_name: Sparkling Pavé Lines & Logo Clip Charm
description: Make every day a little special with the Sparkling Pavé Lines & Logo Clip Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver with two rows of bead-set clear cubic zirconia and a raised row with logo in the centre, this clip charm can be worn to any event in any season and will make a sophisticated style statement. The sparkling pavé, embossed hearts and square edges bring intriguing detail to this instantly iconic piece. This clip charm features a silicone grip, does not fit onto threads (two raised charm dividers.) This charm can be styled anywhere else on the bracelet.

Express your love for with the eye-catching Triple Monogram & Logo Dangle Charm. This tri-coloured monogram charm is made of sterling silver, 14k rose gold plating and 14k gold plating. The smallest circle features a centred cubic zirconia stone and cut-out heart, the medium circle is embossed with the logo and the largest circle has pavé and micro-beading on one side and embossed hearts on the other.

Stand out from the crowd with the Sparkling Blue Crown O charm. The pavé, hearts and micro-beading create a cool texture and the stone's rich hue is eye-catching. With two round rose-cut skylight blue crystals hand-set in sterling silver and delicate rows of clear cubic zirconia, this stunning charm will get you lots of compliments. Consider it your new go-to piece for when you're in the mood to make a bold style statement.

Make a powerful colour statement with this Wavy Turquoise Murano Glass Charm. Made of iridescent and turquoise Murano glass and sterling silver, this eye-catching charm has a rippled surface with glitter inside, inspired by the natural flow of oceans and rivers and their movement and waves. The piece is slightly smaller than The brand's standard Murano glass charms, rendering it beautifully delicate. Its subtle sparkle and calming blue hue make it an ideal addition to any bracelet.

Bring some fun and playfulness to your everyday look with the 2020 Anniversary Pig Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this meaningful charm celebrates the 20th anniversary of Moments by reimagining a classic, collectable pig charm from The brand's design archives. This up-to-date and adorable new version breathes new life into the original and equally iconic pig charm. Plus, it will make you smile every time you see it.

Roll the winning style dice with the 2020 Limited Edition Love Dice Charm. Specially designed for the 20th anniversary of the Moments, the piece reinvents a collectable Moments charm from the design archives. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14 karat gold, the dice features an engraved "I love you" message and a 14k gold heart with an engraved 20th anniversary logo to celebrate the past and look forward to the future.

On the lookout for a new pet? Add the Fluffy Llama Charm to your collection. Featuring a bell hanging around its neck, this charm is a must-have for fans of sweet and fluffy creatures. Get to know a new spooky friend the Skeleton Girl Charm. A Halloween-themed charm decorated with hearts, this piece is hand-finished in sterling silver. Including a heart shape that connects the skeleton’s dangling upper and lower body, this charm’s more sweet than scary.

Ideal for someone who has a lot of heart, this piece would make a great addition to any Moments bracelet.

Whether you’re into horseback riding or horses happen to be your favourite animal, the Horse Charm is the one for you. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this horse charm comes complete with black enamel eyes, a cute nose, finely detailed mane and riding harness detailing. Made for lovers of all things equestrian, leap at the chance to add this silver horse charm to your selection of much-loved Moments pieces.

Welcome a new little one into the world with the Baby Shoe Dangle Charm. Shaped into a small shoe, this two-tone piece is hand-finished in sterling silver with 14k gold laces. Hollow on the inside, this baby charm includes stitching details for extra decoration. A lifted heart featuring the logo on the side gives this dangle charm an iconic finish. Spread the joy with this Moments silver charm.

Take your forest friends with you wherever you go with the Bear, Fox & Squirrel Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece features a double dangle design. The front disc features a three-dimensional fox, bear and squirrel sitting inside a beaded circle. On the back disc, there’s a small cut-out heart and the engraving: “Life is better with Friends.” Never be without your pine-dwelling pals with this sweet dangle charm.

Make a lifelong buddy with the Ellie the Elephant Charm. A Friend that’ll always remind you that “Elephants never forget,” let Ellie encourage you to remember your roots and cherish your earliest memories. A pal with a purpose, carry your experiences everywhere you go with this elephant charm.

product_name: Pavé Snake Chain Pattern Clip Charm

Let the Blue-Eyed Fox Charm burrow its way into your collection. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this fox charm has eyes made from two flush-set pear-shaped crystals in brilliant blue. To add to its cuteness, this piece also features a black enamel nose. A must-have to add to your growing collection of sweet forest friends, allow this silver fox charm to slyly make its way onto your favourite Moments bracelet.

Allow yourself to be tempted by the Sparkling Wrapped Snake Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece is an updated take on our original snake charm. Including clear cubic zirconia, the snake’s body features a mixture of pavé rows and our iconic snake chain pattern for a highly detailed finish. Snakes symbolise health, temptation and transformation, so let this charm slither onto your favourite Moments bracelet for a glittering reminder of all three themes.

product_name: Snake Chain Pattern Open Heart Charm
description: Make a statement with the Snake Chain Pattern Open Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece includes clear cubic zirconia embellished on both the front and back. Attach this sparkling open heart charm to your go-to Moments bracelet to show your love for classic design.

Looking for a gift for the piano player in your life? Hit the right note with the Grand Piano Heart Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features engravings of the logo, musical notes and the words “Play with heart” on the back. As added detailing, this piano charm also includes hand-applied black-and-white enamel keys. Ideal for any music lover or fan of Moments jewellery, this charm is guaranteed to strike a chord.

Get ready to go nuts over this Cute Squirrel Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece features black enamel detailing for the squirrel’s eyes. If you look closely, you’ll notice that this furry friend is holding an acorn and also includes heart prints on the soles of its little feet. Let this squirrel charm buddy up with other animal friends from the forest to transform your treasured Moments bracelet.

product_name: Openwork Heart & Three Feathers Dreamcatcher Charm
description: Promote positive vibes with the Openwork Heart & Three Feathers Dreamcatcher Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, a small open heart detail features at the centre of this intricately detailed charm. Inspired by the original dreamcatcher charm, this heart-shaped piece features intricate openwork detailing and includes three dangling feathers. As an added detail, “Dreams of the heart” is engraved on top of the charm to help ward off evil spirits and bad dreams, and boost your mood.

For a lesson in statement jewellery, look no further than the Chalkboard Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this dangling chalkboard piece features a textured wood-like frame with a small heart-shaped detail attached to resemble a sponge. Featuring the corresponding engravings “Teach” on one side and “With heart” on the other, this chalkboard charm is the ideal gift for the person in your life with a strong passion for teaching.

Mark 20 years of collecting Moments charms with the 2020 Limited Edition Swirl Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14k gold, this design is a reinterpretation of a piece from our archives. A few of the charm’s raised swirls feature solid 14k gold and are set amongst sterling silver swirls for an eye-catching two-tone finish. Including a special 20th anniversary logo engraving, express your passion for collecting with this symbolic swirl charm. Style with sterling silver charms on your bracelet to let this piece stand out.

Celebrate the 20th anniversary of Moments charms with the 2020 Limited Edition House Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece is a reinterpretation of a design from our archives. A 3D house with a chimney and embossed windows, this charm also features a special 20th anniversary logo engraving to symbolise two decades of collecting. Wear this house charm on your Moments bracelet alongside your other keepsakes for a reminder that home is where the heart is.

Fall for the 2020 Limited Edition Stars Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this cylinder-shaped piece is a reinterpretation of an original design from our archives. Decorated with cut-out stars, shine bright with this standout charm. Made to celebrate 20 years of collecting Moments charms, this piece includes a special 20th anniversary logo. Style it with other celestial-inspired designs on your go-to carrier to add a mystical edge to your look.

product_name: Harry Potter, Hedwig Owl Dangle Charm
description: Pay tribute to a loyal companion with the Harry Potter, Hedwig Owl Dangle Charm. Want to send a special message or show the world how much of a Harry Potter fan you are? Do both with this sterling silver charm from the Harry Potter x collection that depicts Hedwig delivering a letter with a hand-applied red enamel seal. A truly noble and iconic character, Harry Potter’s snowy owl was known for her loyalty and intelligence.

Which house do you belong to? Are you a courageous Gryffindor, a loyal Hufflepuff, a witty Ravenclaw or a cunning Slytherin? Find out with this sterling silver Sorting Hat charm from the Harry Potter x collection and start your Hogwarts journey. The magical charm features all the characteristics of the beloved Hogwarts icon, including its slouched shape, extra stitching, and age-old crinkles.

product_name: Harry Potter, Hogwarts Acceptance Letter Dangle Charm
description: Get a special delivery from Hogwarts with the Harry Potter, Hogwarts Acceptance Letter Dangle Charm. This sterling silver letter charm from the Harry Potter x collection features two dangles - an envelope with a red hand-applied enamel seal and a letter. The charm features the engravings "Mr. H. Potter, the Cupboard under the Stairs, 4, Privet Drive, Little Whinging, Surrey" and "We are pleased to inform you that you have a place at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry".

product_name: Harry Potter, Deathly Hallows Dangle Charm
description: Join the adventure with the Harry Potter, Deathly Hallows Dangle Charm. The charm’s shape is made up of the three iconic and powerful objects in sterling silver and features sparkling clear cubic zirconia. The Elder Wand is the straight line, the Resurrection Stone is the circle and the Cloak of Invisibility surrounds them with a triangle. Possessing these objects makes one the Master of Death – a feat only Harry Potter has mastered.

product_name: Harry Potter, Openwork Harry Potter Icons Charm
description: Let the adventure continue with the Openwork Harry Potter, Icons Charm. Harry Potter’s initials, HP, feature in the centre, where the P is shaped as the lightning bolt scar on his forehead. This hand-finished sterling silver openwork charm also displays other icons inspired by the Boy Who Lived, including his round glasses, magic wand, snowy owl Hedwig and the Golden Snitch. The detailed charm from the Harry Potter x collection is finished with a sparkling honey-coloured crystal in the centre of the Quidditch ball.

product_name: Harry Potter, Glasses, Nimbus 2000 & Lightning Bolt Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate your favourite wizard with the Harry Potter, Glasses, Nimbus 2000 & Lightning Bolt Dangle Charm. This triple dangle charm features three iconic symbols that are synonymous with Harry Potter’s character and adventures. His signature round glasses are hand-finished in sterling silver and his unique lightning bolt scar flashes in 14k gold plating. His first Quidditch broomstick, the speedy Nimbus 2000 glows in 14k rose gold plating.

Always channel positive vibes with the Protective Hamsa Hand Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this Hamsa charm features an intricate openwork design and hangs from a beaded bail. An eye, rays and crescent moon motifs feature inside the hand, which includes beading along its outline as a reference to signature design. A talisman to defend against evil, the dangling hand is seen as a gesture of welcoming an abundance of goodness, kindness, friendship and grace into your life.

Dream big with the Magical Unicorn Double Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the charm’s front disc includes an openwork winged animal based on the Greek mythical creature Pegasus. On the back disc, embossed hearts and stars appear underneath hand-applied transparent enamel. The engraving “Love is the closest thing to magic” features on the reverse side. Hearts and stars set with shimmering rainbow-effect stones decorate the bail. Team with sparkling charms on your go-to bracelet for a glittering finish.

Make your maid of honour feel special with the Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this highly detailed heart-shaped piece is the ideal bridesmaid charm. The engraving “I couldn’t say I do without you,” features on one side, while the iconic logo is included on the other. A ribbon and assortment of flowers feature along the edges of the design for a sweet finish. Celebrate a wedding and a close friendship with this sentimental piece.

Celebrate a close bond with the Goddaughter Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this symmetrical design features a small hand-applied enamel heart on each side in pearlescent pink. Engraved with the word “Goddaughter,” this piece includes beaded sides with a central row of heart-shaped beads for a standout finish. A sweet addition to any Moments bracelet, present this goddaughter charm to your loved one to mark your special relationship.

product_name: Disney Nightmare Before Christmas Double Dangle Charm
description: Available for a limited time only. Celebrate Halloween with the Disney Nightmare Before Christmas Double Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the design’s back disc features a full moon and night sky made with hand-applied transparent enamel in yellow and deep lavender. The front openwork disc includes a 3D version of main character, Disney's Jack Skellington. The bail includes spiderweb decoration, the Disney and logos and the engraving “What’s this?” Team this piece with other festive charms for some seriously spooky fun. Product is subject to availability and has limited stock.

Keep your loves close with the Heart Family Tree Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, inside the heart shape stands a tree with pronounced leaves and roots wrapped around the charm’s outline. A small cut-out heart detail features at the base of the trunk and on the bail, which includes two raised hearts and the engraving “Family forever.” Wear this charm to represent your roots or gift it to a family member so they know you’re always thinking of them.

product_name: Disney Parks Maleficent & Dragon Button Charm
description: Prepare to be spellbound by the Disney Parks Maleficent & Dragon Button Charm. Style this piece on your favourite bracelet with other colourful charms for a majestic effect.

product_name: Pink Heart Family Tree Dangle Charm
description: Always remember your roots with the Pink Heart Family Tree Dangle Charm. This openwork dangle charm is hand-finished in sterling silver. Inside the heart shape stands a tree at an angle with its leaves extending beyond the outline. On one side, the leaves are decorated with pink stones in various shades. This effect is mirrored on the bail for a decorative finish. Wear this piece with other family-inspired charms on your bracelet for a beautiful reminder of your loved ones.

Feel extra fortunate with the Good Luck Horseshoe Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this positive talisman features a horseshoe that hangs at an angle. Including embossed circles to represent nail holes, the charm includes beading and heart patterns along its sides. A heart symbol is nestled between the two ends of the horseshoe with a sparkling stone in its centre. Finished with a beaded bail, never run out of luck with this silver charm.

Wear a reminder of those you hold close with the Two-Tone Heart and Lock Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14k gold, the heart-shaped design includes a padlock and slightly raised keyhole with 14k gold detailing at the top. Beading features on the front and back to represent nails, with clear stones decorating the top of the charm. The small 14k gold padlock dangles from a chain. Style with other heart-shaped charms on your carrier for a look filled with love.

product_name: Blue Night Sky Crescent Moon & Stars Dangle Charm
