The back disc includes a raised blue half-moon-shaped stone, which is a brand-new addition to jewellery, surrounded by clear stones with the engraving “I love you more than all the stars in the sky” on the reverse. Gift this moon and stars charm to someone special to show how much you care.

Spread the love with the Sparkling Levelled Hearts Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece is inspired by key design features from the Timeless collection. This charm features an elevated heart-shaped stone at the centre outlined by two rows of clear stones. A cut-out heart pattern features on the sides. Style this piece on your go-to Moments bracelet with simple charms in sterling silver to make a sparkling statement.

Love at first sight - add our Sparkling Levelled Heart Charm to your collection and enjoy this classically elegant style year after year. Two vibrant red man-made crystal hearts are set in a pavé embrace on each side of this sterling silver charm. Treat yourself or gift it to someone you'll love to see wear it.

Celebrate the power of love with the Bow & Love Heart Dangle Charm. This design is hand-finished in sterling silver and features a small dangling bow decorated with clear glittering stones and a flat heart-shaped disc with the engraving “The gift of love.” A line of sparkling stones feature on the bail. A statement addition to any Moments bracelet, surprise your loved one with this special charm.

Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece is inspired by the wonders of summer. The charm features clear stones in the form of a raised flower-like formation inside a circle decorated with clear cubic zirconia. One clear stone features on the bail. Style this decorative piece on your go-to bracelet with other summer themed charms for a shimmering seasonal look.

Hand-finished in sterling silver, this symmetrical design is inspired by the magic of spring. Featuring pear-shaped stones set in the form a flower at its centre, this charm is outlined with clear cubic zirconia and includes cut-out hearts along the sides. Team this shimmering piece with other spring-inspired charms on your bracelet for a statement seasonal look.

Add a hint of shimmer to your collection with the Sparkling Round Openwork Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this openwork design is set with round and pear-shaped clear cubic zirconia. Attach this design to a Moments bracelet hand-finished in sterling silver and style with other sparkling pieces for a classic look that makes an impact. Alternatively, wear alongside charms in different metal tones for a contrasting finish.

Get set for the holidays with the Glitter Christmas Tree Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, celebrate the magic of the festive season with this sparkling charm. This openwork Christmas tree includes stars, hearts and snowflakes alongside red and green stones to represent baubles. A star on top and cut-out snowflake on the bottom complete this highly detailed piece. Style this charm with other glittering designs to express how much you love the most wonderful time of the year.

product_name: Dangling Orbiting Moon & Blue Planet Charm
description: Delight in astronomy with the Dangling Orbiting Moon & Blue Planet Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design includes a blue planet encircled by an angular orb that features a dangling moon decorated with clear stones. The shadows of the continents are visible on the planet underneath the hand-applied glittery blue enamel. This charm spins at a unique angle when worn on a bracelet, so gift to someone special to show that you love them more than the universe itself.

Wish your love a happy holidays with the Christmas Mistletoe Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design includes a front openwork mistletoe dangle decorated with green stones that hangs at an angle. The back disc features hand-applied shimmering green enamel and the engraving: “Meet me under the mistletoe.” The engraving “Christmas wishes” features on the bail. Finished with a small bow at the top, gift this charm to your sweetheart to spread the love this festive season.

Look to the night sky for answers with the Openwork Star Constellations Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece is inspired by a galaxy-themed design from ’s archive. Clear stones are set along the charm’s rounded openwork lines to mimic the formation of the stars in space. Wear this piece alongside other zodiac-inspired charms on your Moments bracelet to show your love for the universe.

product_name: Sleeping Moon and Stars Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate the night sky with the Sleeping Moon and Stars Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the front dangle features an open circle with a sleeping crescent moon with a face on both sides. The back disc includes stars, some of which are set with round or star-shaped stones. The engraving “You are my universe” features on the reverse alongside cut-out stars. Gift this charm to someone special to show your love knows no bounds.

Get ready for any adventure with the Star Wars BB-8 Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver with hand-applied black and orange enamel, this charm captures all the makings of BB-8, the loyal and intrepid droid who helps commander Poe Dameran to fight on behalf of the Resistance. Engraved details replicate the robot's machine elements, while the domed head can spin 360 degrees over its spherical body. Feel a touch of Star Wars' BB-8's courage every time you wear this charm.

product_name: Star Wars C-3PO and R2-D2 Openwork Charm
description: Wear iconic characters with the Star Wars C-3PO and R2-D2 Openwork Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this 3D charm features two beloved Star Wars droids, C-3PO and R2-D2, along with the instantly recognisable Star Wars logo. It represents the unique friendship between the two droids, who are different yet inseparable and loyal to one another. A micro-beaded border, background rock details, cut-out stars and a "Far, far away" engraving, this Star Wars charm is perfect for true fans.

Keep the Force close with the Star Wars Silver 3D Logo Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver with hand-applied black enamel touches, the charm is an exquisitely detailed small-scale replica of the Star Wars logo, one of the most globally recognisable logos of all time. Stay connected to the universally beloved films and the magic of the Star Wars world with this charm, which adds a futuristic yet vintage touch to any look.

Release your fun spirit with the Star Wars R2-D2 Dangle Charm. This charm is hand-finished in sterling silver with blue, red and black hand-applied enamel touches and the bail features stars with blue cubic zirconia stones in the middle. Even without speaking, R2-D2 is one of the most beloved and funny Star Wars characters. The charm brings him to life with moving head and arms and engraved machine details. Emulate R2-D2's courage and creativity every time you wear this charm.

Never forget the power of true friendship when you wear the Star Wars Chewbacca Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver with hand-applied dark brown and black enamel touches, this charm captures the essence of Chewbacca, a longstanding Star Wars fan favourite. Endlessly loyal to Han Solo, 'Chewie' serves as co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon. Design details like a hair pattern and 3D belt bring this Star Wars charm to life and make it an intriguing addition to any look.

product_name: Star Wars Princess Leia Double Dangle Charm
description: Channel your inner rebel with the Star Wars Princess Leia Double Dangle Charm. The top disc features Princess Leia's 3D face and a frame with four stellar blue crystals. The back disc has space-inspired details surrounded by shimmering blue enamel and a "Don't mess with this Princess" engraving. The bail features stars with blue cubic zirconia in the center. Princess Leia always fights for what she believes in and this charm will remind you to do the same.

product_name: Star Wars Lightsaber Double Dangle Charm
description: Power up with the Star Wars Lightsaber Double Dangle Charm. The design is inspired by the opening of Star Wars films, which shows a galaxy of stars. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the front disc has two crossed lightsabers, one with red stones and one with blue. The back disc includes hand-applied sparkling blue enamel, star details and the engraving “May the Force be with you” on the reverse. As this charm proves, the Force goes with any look.

Tap into a well of wisdom when you wear the Star Wars™ Grogu™ Charm. The charm is hand-finished in sterling silver with hand-applied black enamel and conveys the popular character from the series The Mandalorian™ and his signature features, including an enlarged head with black eyes, large ears, small body and cloak. Wear this Star Wars™ charm as a reminder of your own inner child and intuitive wisdom.

Balance light and dark with the Star Wars Darth Vader Charm. A core character in the Star Wars universe, Darth Vader, formally known as Anakin Skywalker, is a formidable villain armed with a deadly lightsaber and telekinetic abilities. Hand-finished in sterling silver with hand-applied black enamel, the charm features Darth Vader's head, face mask and helmet. Wear it to keep all the symbols of Star Wars close and as a reminder that without darkness, there can be no light.

product_name: Disney Parks Mickey Mouse Passholder Charm
description: This Disney Parks Mickey Mouse Passholder Charm is inspired by the special pass used to enjoy celebrations and events at Disney Parks around the world. Hand-finished in sterling silver and decorated with orange and black enamel, this special Disney Parks exclusive charm features Disney's Mickey Mouse himself and stones set to look like fireworks, adding a celebratory touch wherever you choose to style it.

product_name: Disney Parks Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Teacup Charm
description: This romantic Disney Parks Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Teacup Charm is inspired by the Mad Tea Party ride found at Disney Parks across the world. Finished with red and pink enamel, the Disney x charm celebrates the romance of one of the most beloved couples in history: Disney's Mickey and Minnie Mouse. Hand-finished in sterling silver, add this playful charm to your favourite bracelet, or gift it to your valentine as a special surprise.

product_name: Spinning Forever & Always Soulmate Dangle Charm
description: Gift the love of your life the Spinning Forever & Always Soulmate Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this dangling design includes a spinning heart surrounded by a round frame. The heart features the engravings “Forever & Always” and “Soulmate,” with a sparkling stone inside a cut-out heart on the front and a cut-out star detail on the back. Celebrate an everlasting bond with this piece.

Welcome Chinese New Year with the Cute Ox Charm. As 2021 marks the year of the ox in Chinese culture, this piece hand-finished in sterling silver celebrates the animal valued for its role in agriculture. This design includes a 14k gold nose ring and a dangling firecracker detail in hand-applied red enamel. The ox is known for symbolising positive traits like honesty and being hardworking, so wear this charm with other talismans of good fortune to feel extra lucky.

Gift a symbol of your love with the Sparkling Entwined Hearts Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design includes intertwining polished sterling silver hearts and sparkling stone-embellished hearts on the front and back. Entwined hearts also feature on the sides. Inspired by the famous love story of Romeo & Juliet, present this detailed openwork charm to someone special for Valentine’s Day.

Send a special message to the one that you love with the Engravable Letter & Envelope Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this polished dangle includes a lifted heart detail on the envelope. A cut-out heart features in the corner of the letter. Engrave this design with a personalised note for someone you hold dear, so they can carry you with them wherever they go.

Wear a symbol of good fortune with the Mahjong Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design includes the Chinese character for “get rich” in hand-applied red enamel with a sparkling stone on the front. The back is decorated in hand-applied transparent red enamel with the crown O monogram and logo shining through. The bail is embellished with clear stones. Pair with other lucky charms on your bracelet to carry positive vibes around with you.

Add the national symbol of New Zealand to your collection with the Kiwi & Fern Leaf Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design includes a detailed kiwi bird sat on a curved fern leaf. With hand-applied domed black enamel eyes, the bird is decorated with fine lines to mimic the appearance of feathers. Green and clear stones feature on the leaf for a touch of sparkle. Wear your wanderlust by styling this charm with other country-themed designs on your bracelet.

Express your true feelings with the Open Heart & Rose Flowers Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this open heart design features intricate detailing. The heart-shaped front and back frames are embellished with decorative rose flower and leaf details and clear stones for added sparkle. The sides of the charm include rose flower engravings as well as rose petal and heart cut-outs. Inspired by the epic love story of Romeo & Juliet, gift someone special this timeless design.

product_name: Disney Parks Disneyland Paris Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Eiffel Tower Charm
description: Add a little joie de vivre to your charm styling with this Disney Parks Disneyland Paris Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Charm. Featuring one of the world's most iconic couples on a romantic getaway to the City of Lights, this romantic charm would make a very special gift for a loved one. Hand-finished in sterling silver with stones in heart-shaped settings and black and red enamel detailing, add a little love to your charm collection with Disney's Mickey and Minnie Mouse.

Make your style pop with the Metallic Purple Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this heart-shaped piece is decorated with hand-applied transparent purple enamel so that the base shines through. The perfect balance between opaque and translucent, allow this reflective design to stand out by teaming it with minimal charms on your Moments bracelet. Alternatively, wear with other colourful pieces for a vibrant finish.

Make your style pop with the Metallic Red Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this heart-shaped piece is decorated with hand-applied transparent red enamel so that the base shines through. The perfect balance between opaque and translucent, allow this reflective design to stand out by teaming it with minimal charms on your Moments bracelet. Alternatively, wear with other colourful pieces for a vibrant finish.

Our Metallic Pink Heart Charm will add a bright burst of romance to your jewellery collection. Decorated in vibrant pink enamel, the charm is hand-finished in sterling silver, which shines through the enamel creating a unique metallic aesthetic. Add yours to your charm holders for an instant injection of vibrancy.

product_name: Heart Family Tree Safety Chain Charm
description: Inspire your loved one to keep their treasured styles safe with the Heart Family Tree Safety Chain Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design is inspired by our iconic family tree motif. A heart-shaped openwork disc with the family tree nestled inside is attached to the chain. The top parts include embellished leaf details and small beading, with the engraving “Family” on one part and “Love” on the other. Gift this special piece to someone you hold dear.

Discover a special charm for your BFF with the Friends Forever Heart Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this heart-shaped dangle includes an asymmetric infinity sign cut-out with “Friends” in raised lettering on the front and the engraving “Forever” on the back. Another infinity sign connects the dangle with the bail, which features a sparkling clear stone. Let your bestie know that your friendship will last a lifetime with this piece.

Gift them the soundtrack to your love story with the Vintage Cassette Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece includes a cassette tape with cut-outs dangling from a thin heart-shaped bail. The cassette features a little red hand-applied enamel heart with rose, heart and crown O monogram engravings. The words “Our love songs” and “Mix tape” are also engraved onto the charm. Inspire your love to wear this design as a symbol of your special connection.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Love and Kisses Dangle Charm
description: Mark true love with the Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Love and Kisses Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the open front frame includes Minnie Mouse’s silhouette. The back disc features Mickey Mouse detailing and shaded red and magenta hand-applied transparent enamel with sterling silver hearts shining through it. Including the engraving “Love and Kisses,” red stones in heart-shaped settings decorate the bail. The ideal gift to symbolise your romance, the characters kiss when the dangles are layered together.

Gift the love of your life the Spinning World Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design features a flat spinning globe inside a round frame with a sparkling stone on the bail. Including engraved longitude and latitude lines, the globe’s continents are hand-finished in 14k gold. The frame has small lifted hearts and the engraving “You mean the world to me” on the front with the logo on the back. Show your love knows no limits with this piece.

Show your love of colour with the Fuchsia Rose Oval Cabochon Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece features two oval cabochon-cut stones to create a see-through button-shaped charm. The edges are lined with fuchsia stones for added sparkle. Style this piece on its own on your go-to Moments bracelet for an eye-catching effect. Alternatively, wear with other colourful designs for a striking look.

Show your love of colour with the Green Oval Cabochon Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this piece features two oval cabochon-cut stones to create a see-through button-shaped charm. The edges are lined with green stones for added sparkle. Style this piece on its own on your go-to Moments bracelet for an eye-catching effect. Alternatively, wear with other colourful designs for a striking look.

product_name: Disney Parks, Mickey Mouse Graduation Hat Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate proud graduates with the Disney Parks, Mickey Mouse Graduation Hat Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm features the silhouette of Disney's Mickey Mouse ear hat topped by a graduation hat. It includes colourful pops of black and blue hand-applied enamel, a hat tassel, logo, Disney and Disney Parks logo, plus a bail with sparkling pavé. Inspired by and designed to celebrate life's important moments, this charm is ideal for Disney lovers.

Embody graceful elegance with the Two-tone Swans & Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14k gold, this charm features two swans curving to form a heart shape and has a gold hallmark stamp disc on the bottom. With lifelike details including feathered wings, eyes and beaks, the swans wear 14k gold crowns on their heads and represent love, magic and happily ever after. Never forget the power of two becoming one when you wear this heartfelt charm.

Elevate your style with the Flower Pattern Clip Charm. Featuring raised intersecting circles and a floral pattern on top of lightly oxidised fluted lines, this flower clip charm can be styled anywhere on your bracelet. Each of the connected flowers features four marquise shapes as petals, plus centre beads surrounded by micro beads. Intricately textured with lots of dimension, this sleek sterling silver clip charm makes a perfect everyday addition to your look.

product_name: Disney Parks, Mickey Mouse & Dumbo Dangle Charm
description: Wear two of your favourite characters with the Disney Parks, Mickey Mouse & Dumbo Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features Disney's Mickey Mouse waving from a carrousel ride shaped like Disney's Dumbo. Yellow and blue hand-applied enamel details brighten up this charm, including the bail, which also features , Disney and Disney Parks logos. If you love Disney amusement rides and these iconic characters, this charm is a sweet way to celebrate their joy and magic.

product_name: 14k Gold Two-tone Wedding Rings Dangle Charm
description: Carry a symbol of forever love with the Two-tone Wedding Rings Dangle Charm. This silver charm features a 14k gold heart link with two entwined rings, one sterling silver solitaire with a sparkling stone set in a 14k gold setting and one sterling silver band. Both feature the engraved messages 'You and I' and 'Forever and always' inside. The bail includes the iconic logo and two raised hearts. There's no better way to symbolise your love and commitment.

Express yourself with the Artist's Palette Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this colourful charm represents a 3D artist's palette with five vivid paint colours represented by red cubic zirconia and pink, yellow, green and blue crystal stones. The creative charm also features two paint brushes with bristle details and sterling silver beads at the tail. Inspired by the idea of pursuing your passions and living your life creatively, let this charm be a reminder to embrace your unique point of view.

product_name: Daughter & Mother in Law Split Dangle Charm
description: Make a sweet statement with the Daughter- & Mother in Law Split Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this heart charm features a 3D heart split in half. The outer rounded surfaces feature the engraving 'Lucky to have you' and a stone-set and beaded heart-shaped detail, while the inner flat surfaces feature shimmering mother-of-pearl-like enamel and raised messages "Daughter-in-law" and "Mother-in-law". Designed to celebrate family bonds, share this special piece with your mother or daughter-in-law.

product_name: 14k Gold Two-tone Happy Anniversary Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate a special moment with our Two-tone Happy Anniversary Dangle Charm. Featuring two heart-shaped discs in sterling silver, the front dangle shows two glasses in 14k gold with a gold hallmark, making this charm the perfect way to say congratulations. The outline of the heart and the bail are set with clear cubic zirconia for extra shine. The engraving on the back dangle reads "Happy Anniversary", so raise a glass and say cheers to a special milestone!

Say it in sterling silver with the Congratulations Heart & Stars Dangle Charm. This hand-finished charm features a dangling heart-shaped disc with a cut-out star and "You did it" engraving on the front, "The sky is the limit" engraving on the back, plus indented stars with sparkling clear cubic zirconia stones across the bail. This heart charm makes it easy to show your pride and remind your loved one of their accomplishments every day.

product_name: Love My Home Heart Dangle Charm
description: Wear a reminder of your roots with the Love My Home Heart Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features a heart-shaped disc with the engraving 'Home is Where the Heart is' and a house-shaped sparkling pink crystal stone inside a raised house outline. The disc's back side includes a raised house and engraved heart that resembles smoke coming out of a chimney. It's a sweet and meaningful way to carry your home with you wherever you go.

Celebrate a grad's big moment with the 2021 Graduation Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this meaningful graduation charm features two school books, one with a '2021' engraving, as well as a graduation scroll and hat with a dangling tassel detail. Mark a major life milestone and an academic achievement with this stylish milestone charm that will remind graduates that they can achieve anything they dream of and put their mind to.

product_name: Japanese Sakura, Omamori & Fan Dangle Charm
description: Pay stylish tribute to Japan with the Japanese Sakura, Omamori & Fan Dangle Charm. Featuring a trinity of dangling Japanese cultural icons, including a sakura flower, Japanese fan and lucky Omamori amulet, this sterling silver charm incorporates colourful hand-applied enamel and sparkling stones. The Omamori has details including a sakura made of miniature snake chain lines and a yellow enamel logo. Intricate and culturally significant, this Japanese-inspired charm brings a subtle pop of colour to any look.

Carry your favourite furry friend everywhere with the My Pet Dog Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver with shimmering hand-applied enamel, this dog charm has one disc shaped as a dog's silhouette with ears and a second disc shaped like a dog's body with a polished tail. A raised message on the shimmering enamel on the second disc reads 'My best friend,' while the bail includes two paw stamps on each side. A dog lover's perfect accessory.

product_name: 14k Gold Two-tone Birthday Candle Dangle Charm
description: Mark the moment with the Two-tone Birthday Candle Dangle Charm. This hand-finished sterling silver charm features a 3D two-tone candle with a 14k gold flame with gold hallmark and a round disc with a 'Make a wish' engraving on the front and a raised heart outline on the back. No matter what the age, this charm will be a reminder of important birthdays, accomplishments and celebrations with loved ones.

Keep your favourite furry friend close with the My Pet Cat Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver with shimmering hand-applied enamel, this cat charm has one disc shaped as a cat's silhouette with whiskers and ears, plus a second disc shaped like a cat's body with a polished tail. A raised message on shimmering enamel on the second disc reads 'My best friend,' while the bail includes two paw stamps on each side. A cat lover's perfect accessory.

Wear your love of eco-conscious travel with the Electric Car Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this car charm includes realistic details like a spare wheel, side mirrors, hood, front light and a stamped battery on the underside. Stylistic details include license plates with partial monogram and a back plate with the word 'LOVE' where the O is a red enamel heart, as well as an oxidised grooved rope holding a raised heart on the roof.

Let the world know your feelings with the Comedy & Tragedy Drama Masks Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this intricate sterling silver charm is inspired by theatre and self-expression. The smiling comedy mask has pink enamel cheeks, while the sad tragedy mask on the reverse side features a blue enamel tear. The masks are framed by 3D ruffles and tasselled ropes that, on each side, feature a sparkling stone and interlink to form a heart. Embrace both your sides in style.

product_name: Disney Alice in Wonderland Drink Me Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate an iconic character with the Disney Alice in Wonderland Drink Me Dangle Charm. Representing an unforgettable scene from the Disney film, this sterling silver charm features Alice in Wonderland with lifelike details – including face, hair, hands, apron, feet and dress – inside a bottle made of blue semi-transparent enamel. A dangling tag features an engraved 'Always' on one side and 'Curious' on the other. Wear this charm as a reminder to explore the world with wonder and curiosity.

Bring a touch of magic to every day with the Two-tone Castle Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features a 14k gold heart on bail and the Monogram framed by a 3D castle with three turreted towers with lightly oxidised features and two battlements. On the bottom, there's an engraving that reads 'Life is a fairy tale.' It's a message you'll never forget when you're wearing this shining castle charm.

Accessorise like a royal with the Two-tone Regal Crown Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14k gold, this charm features a four-sided 3D crown with a 14k gold marquise-shaped flower on top and two 14k gold sides with swirling details and a floral pattern. Micro beading along the edges and a gold hallmark stamp disc on the bottom makes this intricate and ornate crown charm even more eye-catching. Wear it to bring an elegant and regal flourish to any look.

Hold your dreams close with the Blue Dreamcatcher Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm depicts a dreamcatcher with a flower pattern, micro beading and sparkling blue cubic zirconica centre stones. Three feathers dangle from the dreamcatcher and include feather details and shaded transparent blue enamel. The top of the dreamcatcher charm is engraved with the message 'Believe in the power of your dreams' – a reminder to never stop believing in yourself.

Wear a reminder to believe in true love with the Two-tone Frog Prince Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14k gold, this charm features a smiling frog with big eyes and micro beaded feet wearing a miniature 14k gold crown, plus a gold hallmark stamp disc on the bottom. Inspired by the idea that you have to kiss a few frogs to finally find your prince, this fairy-tale charm brings a bit of whimsy to any outfit or occasion.

product_name: Disney Alice in Wonderland Key & Door Knob Dangle Charm
description: Tap into your sense of adventure with the Disney Alice in Wonderland Key & Door Knob Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm evokes a memorable moment from the iconic Disney film, when Disney's Alice is talking to an enchanted door knob. The adventure-filled charm features a regal openwork key and a 3D doorknob with detailed facial features and a quote from the film engraved on the backside that reads 'A new adventure.'

product_name: Disney Alice in Wonderland, Unbirthday Party Teapot Charm
description: Carry a reminder of joy and wonder with the Disney Alice in Wonderland, Unbirthday Party Teapot Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm celebrates Disney's Alice in Wonderland Mad Hatter's unbirthday tea party scene. The detailed charm features a Victorian teapot with hand-applied blue enamel, from which the Dormouse peeks out with a pocket watch and chain dangle. This Alice in Wonderland charm will bring a sprinkle of magic to your life.

Add a dash of shimmering colour to your style with the Blue Pavé Heart Clip Charm. This heart charm is hand-finished in sterling silver with 38 crystals in shades of blue. With the stones set in a linear diagonal pattern, the shades of blue fade from one edge to another. The back side features a polished heart outline. Bring some extra sparkle to your look with this heartfelt charm.

product_name: Disney Alice in Wonderland & The Mad Hatter's Tea Party Charm
description: Wear a little whimsy with the Disney Alice in Wonderland & The Mad Hatter's Tea Party Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features pops of enamel in white, yellow, blue, pink and red. This Alice in Wonderland charm celebrates the film's Mad Hatter character and his iconic hat, featuring a miniature Alice in Wonderland, butterfly, playing cards, roses and ten shillings and sixpence price tag. The playful engraving – 'We're all mad here' – will make you smile every time.

Brighten up your style with the Colourful Rainbow Dangle Charm. This sterling silver rainbow charm features tapered arcs of pink, blue, yellow, orange and lavender enamel that culminate in a shooting star on one end and are set with crystals in five different colours matching the enamels on the opposite end. The bail includes raised stars, cloud outlines and a 'Together is better' engraving. A bold, joyful and stylish addition to any outfit.

Light up your look with the Glow-in-the-dark Firefly Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this firefly charm features rounded glow-in-the-dark glass – white in the daylight and milky green at night – which recharges when exposed to sunlight or UV light. A second silver disc reads 'You light up my life.' This engraved charm makes the perfect gift for the one you love, or a stylish statement of self-love to remind you of the light you carry within.

product_name: Colourful Rainbow Bruno the Unicorn Charm
description: Show your true colours with the Colourful Rainbow Bruno the Unicorn Charm. The colourful charm features a shaded rainbow effect created through hand-applied transparent pink, blue, lavender and green enamel. This unicorn charm also includes heart outlines under the feet and polished horn, mane, wings and tail. A vibrant makeover of the friend Bruno the Unicorn, this bright charm celebrates diversity, inclusivity, equality and pride in who you are.

product_name: Triple-tone Cross, Heart, & Anchor Dangle Charm
description: Sport symbols of your values with the Triple-tone Cross, Heart, & Anchor Dangle Charm. This charm features a 14k gold-plated cross with 'Faith' engraved on the back; an 14k rose gold-plated anchor with 'Hope' engraved on the back; and a sterling silver and a stone-set sparkling pavé heart with 'Love' engraved on the back. This tri-tone, triple dangle symbolic charm brings extra meaning to your look.

Carry your connection to nature with the Watering Can & Trowel Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes a 3D watering can with a 'Live life in full bloom' engraving and a trowel featuring two sparkling clear cubic zirconia stones on the blade. The bail features a raised flower with a sparkling yellow crystal in its centre. Wear this gardening-inspired charm as an ode to green fingers and the magic of nature.

Wear a tribute to beloved pets with the Hearts & Paw Print Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this paw print charm features a dangling open paw silhouette with a heart-shaped centre and four toes, as well as a solid heart-shaped disc with a 'Paw prints on my heart' engraving. The bail on this pet charm features two paw stamps on each side for an extra dose of cuteness. Animal lovers, this charm will win your heart.

product_name: Disney Alice in Wonderland, Cheshire Cat & Absolem Caterpillar Charm
description: Never forget your sense of wonder with the Disney Alice in Wonderland Cheshire Cat & Absolem Caterpillar Charm. This sterling silver charm depicts the gate into the Wonderland forest, Alice in Wonderland peeking over a mushroom at the caterpillar Absolem, the Cheshire Cat sitting on a tree and a 'Nothing is impossible' engraving. Intricate, detailed and whimsical, this Alice in Wonderland charm captures the magic and mystery of this Disney world.

Make your look pop with the Pink Pavé Clip Charm. Featuring crystals and cubic zirconia stones in two shades of pink and varying sizes, this sterling silver clip charm is full of sparkling dimension. The polished back side features the iconic logo and monogram. Inside, strategically placed silicone keeps the charm in a fixed position when clipped on a Reflexions bracelet. Choose this pretty pink charm as your new go-to colourful finishing touch.

product_name: Disney Minnie Mouse Bow & Mum Charm
description: Introduce a touch of magic to her collection with the Disney Minnie Mouse Bow & Mum Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design includes “Mum” script with a symmetrical front and back. Polished Minnie Mouse ears and a bow decorated with hand-applied red enamel feature above the “U”. This charm includes the Disney and logo on both ends. Gift this style to your Disney-loving mum to make her extra happy. Due to the length of this charm, it does not move on small and medium-sized O Pendants or the Heart O Pendant.

Let your mum know you feel lucky to have her with the Heart & Clover Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this rounded heart design includes a cut-out area with a raised 3D clover on the upper right-hand side. The motif is decorated with lines to emphasise the leaflets. On the front, the engraving reads “Lucky to have you” while “Mum” features on the back with a raised sterling silver heart in the centre. Gift her this design as a symbol of your love.

product_name: Two-tone Family Tree & Heart Dangle Charm
description: Celebrate the bond between you and your mum with the Two-tone Family Tree & Heart Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver and 14k gold, this design includes a large heart-shaped disc. “Mum” is engraved on the front with the “U” replaced by a heart while “You are the heart of your family” features on the back. The 14k gold front dangle features a round frame with an openwork family tree motif. Surprise her with this style so she can carry your love everywhere.

Show her your love knows no bounds with the Angel Wings & Mum Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this symmetrical openwork heart design includes angel wings extending outwards to cross the charm’s edges. There’s a polished raised heart in the centre with the engraving “Mum” on one side and “My Angel” on the other. Cut-out hearts decorate the sides of the piece. Gift this style to your mum as a celebration of your special connection.

Show her she's your world with the Glitter Globe Mum Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, both dangles are surrounded by a circle decorated with beading. The front dangle includes “Mum” script with the “U” replaced by a heart engraved with continents. Hand-applied transparent glittery blue enamel covers the back disc, which features longitude and latitude lines as well as heart details. “You mean the world to me” is engraved on the back. Prove your love has no limits with this special style.

Mark a special trip to London with the Sparkling Buckingham Palace Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this openwork piece features clear cubic zirconia along the edges and cut-out hearts around the sides. Small hearts decorate the palace, which includes gates set with sparkling stones and a Union Jack flag at the top. The engraving “London” features on the side. Style this charm with other designs inspired by the city to create a look fit for a queen.

product_name: Disney Lilo & Stitch Family Dangle Charm
description: Gift your best friend the Disney Lilo & Stitch Family Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the openwork front dangle includes Disney's Lilo and Stitch hugging. Lilo’s dress is decorated with hand-applied red enamel and raised sterling silver leaf details. Stitch’s ear features hand-applied purple enamel. The back disc is covered in hand-applied shaded transparent blue enamel with raised leaf details. The engraving “Family means no one gets left behind” features on the reverse. Surprise your close friend with this style to celebrate your connection.

product_name: Disney Winnie the Pooh Birthday Dangle Charm
description: Make their special day one to remember with the Disney Winnie the Pooh Birthday Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the front dangle includes a 3D version of Disney's Winnie the Pooh wearing a hat and shirt decorated with hand-applied blue and red enamel. The back disc features the engraving “HapBee Birthday” with a honey pot on the other side. A small bee detail decorates the bail. Gift this piece to your loved one as they celebrate another year.

Show that you’re a true fan of classic stories with the Disney Lady Charm. Designed in collaboration with Disney’s toy designers, this piece is hand-finished in sterling silver. Disney’s Lady features an enlarged head, smaller body and textured ears for a cute, fluffy finish. The character has black hand-applied enamel eyes and nose and her collar is decorate with hand-applied blue enamel for a distinctive look. Wear this piece with other Disney x styles for a heartfelt combination.

Delight in Chinese performing arts with the Peking Opera Doll Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this detailed design includes a Peking opera doll in a costume decorated with intricate hand-applied red enamel details. The doll is wearing a beaded crown set with sparkling red and blue stones and features hand-applied shaded pink enamel detailing around the eyes. Style this charm on your favourite bracelet with theatre-themed designs to show off your creative side.

Cherish your favourite memories of France with the French Rooster Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design is inspired by the Gallic rooster, which is the unofficial national symbol of the country. Featuring feather-like engravings on its tail for added texture, the rooster is wearing a beret decorated with hand-applied red, white and blue enamel, which are the colours of the French flag. Style this special symbol with other travel-themed charms to show off your adventurous side.

Fly high with the Disney Dumbo Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm was designed in collaboration with Disney’s toy designers. Disney’s Dumbo features an enlarged head and smaller body for an adorable finish. The character has big polished ears, engraved toes and black hand-applied enamel eyes. Dumbo’s wearing a ruffled collar and his iconic hat covered in hand-applied yellow enamel with sterling silver detailing. Wear this magical design alongside other Disney x styles for a fun-filled look.

Treat yourself to the Pretzel Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this pretzel-shaped design is inspired by the baked snack, which originates from Germany. The front of the charm is decorated with small beads to copy the look of salt on a pretzel, while the plain polished back includes the logo. Twisted detailing features on the bail to mimic the appearance of dough. Show you’ve got great taste by teaming this charm with other designs based on your favourite foods.

Share your love of the Great White North with the Canadian Beaver & Maple Leaf Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this design features a sweet beaver, which is the official emblem of Canada. Fine lines decorate the beaver’s tail to imitate its fur-like texture. The animal holds a maple leaf, which is the country’s national symbol, decorated with transparent red enamel to allow the leaf-like texture to shine through. Style with other travel-inspired charms to express your wanderlust.

product_name: Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Eternal Love Charm
description: Gift your love the Disney Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse Eternal Love Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this convex-shaped design includes Disney’s Mickey Mouse carrying Minnie Mouse surrounded by shimmering silver hand-applied enamel. A small ring set with a sparkling stone dangles from the bottom of the charm. The raised message “I will always love you” in sterling silver letters features on the back. Cut-out hearts decorate the sides of the piece. Celebrate your romance with this special design.

Take extra pride in your collection by adding the Disney Simba Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm was designed in collaboration with Disney’s toy designers. Disney’s Simba has an enlarged head and smaller body for a sweet finish. The character features engraved whiskers, hand-applied black enamel eyes and brown hand-applied enamel details inside his ears and on the tip of his tail. Team with other Disney x charms to style your own adventure.

Surprise her with the Heart & Mum Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the heart-shaped front disc is outlined with pink crystals and features “Mum” script with the “U” replaced by a heart set with a matching stone. The engraving “All of me loves all of you” features on the back heart-shaped disc in a repeating pattern. A row of pink sparkling stones features on the bail. Put a smile on your mum's face with this colourful design.

Step up your style with the Sparkling Line Clip Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this round polished design includes a line of shimmering clear stones which goes all the way around the clip. Style this charm on your go-to Moments bracelet with other sparkling sterling silver designs to make a statement. Alternatively, offset this piece with charms in various metal finishes for a contrasting look. This clip charm features a silicone grip which fits onto threads (as opposed to other clips with silicone that do not fit onto threads). This charm can be styled anywhere on the bracelet.

product_name: Stellar Blue Pavé Tilted Heart Dangle Charm
description: Add a pop of colour to your look with the Stellar Blue Pavé Tilted Heart Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this titled heart-shaped design is decorated with different-sized blue crystals on the front. The polished back side includes cut-out circles and hearts. Style with sterling silver charms on your favourite bracelet to make this piece stand out or team with other colourful symbols for a vibrant finish.

product_name: Disney Dumbo Sweet Dreams Dangle Charm
description: Believe in magic with the Disney Dumbo Sweet Dreams Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the circular front disc features a 3D version of Disney’s Dumbo snuggling into Mrs. Dumbo’s trunk. Clouds, stars and a crescent moon shine through the hand-applied transparent blue enamel that decorates the back disc. The engraving “Sweet dreams little one” features on the back. Engraved stars decorate the bail for added detail. Pair with other Disney x charms for a playful look.

Delight your loved one with the Openwork Heart & Family Tree Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this openwork design includes a heart-shaped mother of pearl disc with a raised family tree detail in the centre, held in place by a beaded outline with four prongs. The engraving “Family forever and always” featured on the polished sterling silver reverse side. Cut-out branches and leaves decorate the sides of the charm. Gift to a family member as a symbol of your special bond.

Watch your loved one fall for the Domed Golden Heart Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this heart-shaped piece includes a slightly domed 14k gold heart centre with a plain polished look for a subtle effect. The two-tone charm features a heart detail on the back, incorporated into an engraving that reads “You have a heart of gold.” Gift your family member this piece as a reminder of how much you love them.

Straight from the silver screen, the Movie Clapperboard Dangle Charm is ready for its close-up. This sterling silver charm with hand-applied black enamel features the iconic striped clapperboard design. The front is engraved with “Title”, “” and the monogram, while the back is engraved with “Hollywood”, along with a heart and star outline. If you’ve ever dreamed of being on the big screen or simply love the movies, add this to your collection today.

product_name: ME Peace Sign Mini Dangle Charm
description: The ME Peace Sign Mini Dangle Charm combines all the best things in life: love, unity, joy… and sparkle, of course. An eye-catching combination of crystals and cubic zirconia give the universal symbol of hope a fresh update in a rainbow of vibrant colours. The mini dangle charms's reverse side features micro-beaded details along the circular open design. This peace mini dangle charm instantly adds good karma and great vibes to any look.Discover how to mix and re-mix your ME look here.

Add an enchanting underwater friend to your collection with the Blue Scaled Fish Dangle Charm. This sterling silver fish charm captures the essence of the sea with shimmering clear cubic zirconia eyes, hand-applied blue enamel scales in three tones, grooved lines on the tail and fins and delicate beading along the spine. A reminder to go with the flow, the fish appears to be swimming as you move thanks to a flexible design and subtle moving parts.

Express your love for our world with the Blue Globe Clip Charm. Polished sterling silver continents are surrounded by hand-applied blue enamel waves and Australia is shaped as a heart. Wear it as a reminder of future and past travels and pair it with other blue Moments charms as a tribute to our blue planet. This clip charm features no silicone grip, so it will slide if not styled onto threads (two raised charm dividers).

Tell someone they mean the world to you with the Blue Globe Dangle Charm. A moonlight blue crystal encased in a beaded meridian ring rotates 360 degrees in our modern take on the traditional globe. Engraved with the message “Wonderful World” and the iconic logo on the bail, this sterling silver charm is a reminder to dream big and care for our blue planet. Wear it with other colourful Moments charms or create your own travel-themed bracelet.

Embrace your sense of adventure with the Moments Chest of Treasure Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this box charm features a lid that opens with a delicate seashell closure and is accented by rope-textured handles. Starfish adorn the front and back and heart-shaped feet rest at the corners of the chest. Engraved with “Treasure every moment” and a hidden heart inside, this charm is a reminder that each day holds a memory to cherish.

It’s time to pack your bags and add the Airplane, Globe & Suitcase Dangle Charm to your collection. 3 charms in 1, this sterling silver piece is every travel lover’s dream. Details include grooved windows on the airplane, longitude and latitude lines on the globe and a hand-applied pink enamel heart on the suitcase. Add this travel charm to your collection as a promise to plan future adventures or gift it to your globe-trotting BFF.

Embrace the warmth of summer and beachy holiday memories with the Palm Tree & Coconuts Dangle Charm. Tropical coconuts embellished with green crystals sit atop a sterling silver palm tree swaying in the cool breeze. An additional green crystal sits at the base of the tree and a clear cubic zirconia stone shines on the bail. Wear this palm tree charm to recall past tropical escapes and as a promise to plan future getaways.

The Sail Boat Dangle Charm is perfect for anyone dreaming of adventure and the open sea. Engraved with the message “Sail Away With Me”, the sterling silver charm rests on the waves with the wind in its sails. All the sailing essentials are here – a wheel at the mast, a lifebuoy and an anchor – and it’s connected to the bail with a traditional sailor’s rope. Pair it with other Moments charms to create your own inspirational bracelet.

Make your everyday outfits shine with the Pavé & Logo Charm. Hand-finished in Sterling Silver, this charm features four rows of brilliant-cut clear cubic zirconia pavé separated in the middle by a raised polished row with two logos. Each row is also framed by micro-beading, adding another cool element of texture to this detailed charm. Encapsulating modern sophistication, this round charm makes a bold, sparkling addition to any look.

Go bold with the Logo Circles Dangle Charm. This logo charm is hand-finished in Sterling Silver and features three intertwined circles. The polished central hoop intertwines with a larger swinging circle with two logos and cut-out hearts. A smaller circle features a clear cubic zirconia pavé row framed by microbeading and hangs perpendicular to the outer circles. All three circles swing, creating dynamic movement and making this charm an eye-catching addition to any look.

Channel your inner princess with the Disney's Tangled, Rapunzel Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes engraved facial features and lilac and glittery lavender hand-applied enamel, giving Rapunzel's dress and flower headband a vivid pop of colour. Inspired by Rapunzel's intelligent personality and trademark locks, this Rapunzel charm will remind you of your favourite Disney Princess moments, making it an iconic addition to any collection by bringing a playful touch to your everyday style.

Wear your love for Korean culture with the Korean Doll Hanbok Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this Korean doll charm wears a hanbok dress, the vibrantly coloured clothing traditionally worn in Korean festivals and ceremonies. The doll's clothing includes transparent green and pink hand-applied enamel details, along with black and pink hand-applied enamel on the doll's hair, accessories and eyes. A pink cubic zirconia stone tops off the bail with a sparkling flourish.

Be a true fan with the Star Wars™ Yoda™ Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes two dangles, one an openwork design featuring Yoda™ standing with his gimer stick framed by raised ivy, the other a disc featuring hand-applied green and blue enamel with forest details. The backside of the second disc is engraved with "Do. Or do not. There is no try" and the bail is engraved with "Jedi master".

Choose sleek style with the Ribbons clip charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this clip charm has no silicone grip, so it will slide if not styled onto threads. With flat, polished ribbons wrapped around the clip in a textured criss-crossing pattern, this ribbon charm will bring a sleek, minimalist element to your look and pairs perfectly on a bracelet or necklace to make the rest of your favourite charms shine even brighter.

product_name: Star Wars Han Solo & Leia Kiss Charm
description: Channel galactic love with the Star Wars™ Han Solo™ & Leia™ Kiss Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features Han Solo™ and Princess Leia™ kissing on one side and the Millennium Falcon spaceship on the other side. The sides of the charm are engraved with the characters' quotes from the scene: "I love you" and "I know". With intricate openwork details, including cut-out stars and facial features of the beloved characters, this charm represents an iconic Star Wars moment.

Channel your inner princess with the Disney's Aladdin, Jasmine Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes engraved facial features and translucent yellow and glittery blue hand-applied enamel, giving Jasmine's earrings, necklace, clothes and hair accessory vivid pops of colour. Inspired by Jasmine's unique personality and iconic look, this charm will remind you of one of your favourite Disney Princess moments, making it an iconic addition to any collection by bringing a playful touch to your everyday style.

product_name: Disney Princess The Little Mermaid Ariel Charm
description: Channel your inner princess with the Disney's The Little Mermaid, Ariel Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes engraved facial features and translucent purple and green hand-applied enamel, giving Ariel's tail, top and hair accessory vivid pops of colour. Inspired by Ariel's courageous personality and unforgettable look, this charm will remind you of one of your favourite Disney Princess moments, making it an iconic addition to any collection by bringing a playful touch to your everyday style.

Channel your inner princess with the Disney Cinderella Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes engraved facial features and translucent blue hand-applied enamel, giving Cinderella's dress, headband and earrings vivid pops of colour. Inspired by Cinderella's positive personality and instantly recognisable look, this Disney Cinderella charm will remind you of your favourite Disney Princess moments, making it an iconic addition to any collection by bringing a playful touch to your everyday style.

product_name: Disney Princess Tiana And The Frog Charm
description: Channel your inner princess with the Disney Princess And The Frog, Tiana Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes engraved facial features and glittery green and yellow hand-applied enamel, giving Tiana's dress and tiara vivid pops of colour. Inspired by Tiana's goal-oriented personality and zest for life, this Princess Tiana charm will remind you of one of your favourite Disney Princess moments, making it an iconic addition to any collection by bringing a playful touch to your everyday style.

Wear your fandom with the Star Wars™ Grogu™ & Crib Charm. This sterling silver charm features the beloved Star Wars: The Mandalorian character Grogu™ inside a floating crib. Grogu™ is waving and has its signature big ears and black hand-applied enamel eyes. Add this charm to your look and carry a reminder of the iconic Star Wars world and the incredible powers of Grogu™ with you everywhere you go.

product_name: Star Wars Death Star Clip Charm
description: Wear your devotion with the Star Wars™ Death Star Clip Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this Star Wars charm depicts the Death Star™ space station with intricate engraved details and a crater. This Death Star™ charm is inspired by the Empire's ultimate weapon, the massive space station armed with a planet-destroying superlaser. Add this charm to your collection and make one of the Star Wars galaxy's most iconic symbols a part of your everyday style.

product_name: Disney Parks The Haunted Mansion Madame Leota Dangle Charm
description: Go three-dimensional with the Disney Parks The Haunted Mansion Madame Leota Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features a disc with Disney's Madame Leota's headstone with three-dimensional details on the front and an engraving on the reverse: "Dear sweet Leota, beloved by all in regions beyond now, but having a ball". The open front dangle has floral embellishments, adding to the charm's intricate textured look. It's the perfect way to bring the Disney Parks experience into your look.

Show off your love of dancing with the Openwork Dancing Queen Charm. This sterling silver charm features the words "Dancing Queen" in cut-out script surrounded by star and heart details. Sparkling clear cubic zirconia stones at the top symbolise disco balls. This dancing charm will remind you of every joyous moment you've ever spent on the dance floor – plus, it will bring a fun, sparkling and graphic touch to your everyday style.

Tap into gratitude with the Thankful Heart & Stars Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this heart-shaped charm features star cut-outs and detailing in different sizes, with blue crystals sparkling out from two of the stars. The front features the engraved word "Thankful" and the back features the word "Blessed". In addition to adding some sleek, sparkling style to any look, this charm is a beautiful reminder of all the blessings in your life.

Bring a natural touch to your look with the Cute Mushroom Charm. This sterling silver charm is shaped like a mushroom, including a line textured cap with polished dot and heart details, filament details underneath the cap and brilliant-cut black crystals for eyes. Tiny hands and feet add sweetness and personality to this little charm's allure. Mushrooms are a symbol of rebirth, so wear this charm as a reminder of fresh starts, new seasons and joyful moments spent in nature.

Show off your love of the game with the American Football Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this American football charm features micro and bead-set leather brown crystals and clear cubic zirconia, giving this charm lifelike dimension and sparkling style. The sides of the charm include sterling silver lace-shaped details and the bail includes sparkling stones. This charm makes the perfect addition to your look for American football lovers – wear it on on game day and beyond.

product_name: Spatula, Frying Pan & Whisk Dangle Charm
description: Get in the mood to cook with the Spatula, Frying Pan & Whisk Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this cooking charm features one dangle shaped like a spatula, another dangle shaped like a whisk and a third dangle shaped like a frying pan. The frying pan has two sparkling cubic zirconia stones that represent food on the front and cut-out hearts on the back. Perfect for foodies and home chefs, this charm is full of culinary style.

product_name: Murano Glass Red Apple Dangle Charm
description: Bring a vivid red pop of colour to your look with the Murano Glass Red Apple Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in Sterling Silver, this charm features red Murano glass in the shape of an apple with a delicate heart-shaped stem and textured leaf detail. The bail is decorated with glittering clear cubic zirconia for an extra dose of sparkle. In addition to brightening up any look with its rich red hue, this apple charm symbolises knowledge and a love of nature.

Be a proud cat lover with the Kitten & Yarn Ball Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features a kitten with engraved details and grooved lines to imitate fur patches and raised paw detailing. The kitten holds a yarn ball, which includes a small dangling tag with "ME❤W" engraved on one side and the logo on the reverse. You may not be able to carry your cute kitty with you everywhere, but this charm is the next-best thing.

Wear a playful nod to your love of shopping with the Shopping Bag Dangle Charm. This heart bag charm is hand-finished in sterling silver, features an engraved logo on the front and back, plus a delicate bow detail on the front. A separate dangling heart-shaped bag tag includes the engraved message "I ❤ shopping". This charm is ideal for you if you adore shopping and are looking for a sleek, polished silver addition to your look.

Style meets sentiment in the Openable Heart Locket Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features a heart with a clear cubic zirconia stone set in the centre. The heart opens to reveal the engraved message "Always be in my heart". The bail features clear cubic zirconia for an extra dose of sparkle. Inspired by classic locket designs, this charm is elegant, heartfelt and meaningful no matter what you wear it with.

product_name: Linked Sister Hearts Split Dangle Charm
description: Show off your sisterly bonds with the Linked Sister Hearts Split Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes two linked open hearts, each featuring a sparkling clear cubic zirconia stone and engraving (one says "Sis" and the other reads "Sister"). On the back, each heart has small heart-shaped cut-outs and is engraved with "I will always have a friend". The hearts can be separated, so one can be gifted to your sister – a reminder of your forever bond.

Celebrate a sweet 15th birthday with the 15th Birthday Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm includes the number 15 with a polished front and back with micro beads and heart-shaped bead details, plus a small crown-shaped dangle with pavé on the front and pavé on the bail. Inspired by Quinceañera, the celebration of a 15-year-old girl's birthday rooted in Spanish and indigenous cultures, this charm is a sweet and stylish way to mark the moment.

Bring a natural touch to your look with the Purple & Green Leaf Charm. This sterling silver charm is shaped like a leaf, with translucent purple and dark green hand-applied enamel creating a lovely shaded effect over the leaf's textured details that shine through. The leaf is a symbol of hope, so wear this charm as a reminder of your future dreams and joyful moments spent in nature. Its rich colours will bring a bold flourish to your style.

Wear your love for fitness with the Dumbbell & Heart Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features a dumbbell sitting inside an open heart shape. The dumbbell is covered in hand-applied pink enamel, with delicate heart details on each end. With a design inspired by fitness and strength, this charm is perfect for anyone who finds their joy in physical movement and excercise, whether that's at the gym, at home or outside.

Show off your love for cats with the Cats & Hearts Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features an open front dangle with two cats whose tails form a heart that's partly embellished with clear cubic zirconia. One cat features hand-applied shimmering silver enamel, while the other wears a collar embellished with clear cubic zirconia. The back dangle features clear cubic zirconia sparkling from star-shaped settings and the engraved message "I'll always be there for you".

Dial up the cute factor with the Cute Piggy Bank Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features a polished piggy bank with a coin sticking out of its back, heart-shaped feet, raised nose and coiled tail. The coin includes ridged edges, an engraved heart on one side and a Crown O on the other. This charm represents a love of animals in all their forms, whether a fond childhood memory or your spirit animal.

Show you love bath time with the Polished Rubber Duck Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, this charm features hand-applied enamel details, including an orange beak and black eyes. Cute and lifelike, this rubber duck charm represents a love of animals in all their forms, whether a fond childhood memory or a pop culture icon. This sweet and whimsical charm will bring a playful touch to any outfit and remind you to stay young at heart.

Energize your look with the Matte Green Murano Glass Charm. Featuring frosted dark green Murano glass, this charm's centre is hand-finished sterling silver. The glass has a matte appearance that will naturally evolve over time, becoming more shiny and uniquely yours. With a rich hue that's equally eye-catching on its own or paired with your other favourite charms, this charm will bring a splash of captivating colour to your style.

Brighten up your style with the Sparkling Heart Pattern Dangle Charm. This round charm features a flat disc with a grooved freehand heart pattern with synthetic rubies and pink crystals inside the hearts. The back of the disc has small cut-out heart details and the bail is engraved with a repeat "I love you ❤" pattern. As a stylish symbol of love, this charm is a modern and sparkling way to upgrade your look.

Make your look sparkle with the Pavé Feather Dangle Charm. This sterling silver charm has a back dangle with pavé made of pink cubic zirconia and pink and purple crystals, along with an engraved message on the reverse that reads "Spread love everywhere you go". The openwork front dangle features an intricate feather design that slides aside to reveal the pavé back dangle, bringing a layered, textural touch to this delicate charm.

Definitely more of a treat than a trick, this sterling silver Disney Mickey Mouse Pumpkin Charm will bring a spooky vibe to your looks all year round. Featuring hand-applied, transparent orange enamel that transforms Disney’s Mickey Mouse into a metallic jack o’ lantern, this cute charm includes the word “Boo” in raised letters on the back and is inspired by the pumpkins that decorate Disney World every year at Halloween.

product_name: Dreams Of The Future Crayon Dangle Charm
description: Support young voices with the Dreams of the Future Crayon Dangle Charm. Hand-finished in sterling silver, the dangle features a six-sided crayon with blue, pink and yellow hand-applied enamel for a colourful finish. The crayon is winged and features the engraving "Supporting young voices" on the bail, which also has a small butterfly detail in blue enamel. The charm represents the spirit of the children today and their many hopes and dreams, including a colourful world full of opportunities.

This mischievous Gingerbread Man Dangle Charm will steal your heart. Hand-finished in sterling silver and decorated with colourful red, pink and green enamel, this dangle charm features a gingerbread man holding a red and white striped candy cane. Bow and button details, as well as silver icing on his wrists, legs and head, bring the gingerbread man to life. This adorable dangle charm also features the lovely engraving "Life is Sweet". Catch this gingerbread man before it's too late!

product_name: Disney Frozen Snow Olaf Double Dangle Charm
description: Channel everyone's favourite snowman with the Disney Frozen Snow Olaf Double Dangle Charm. This charm features Disney's Olaf in 3D with colourful enamel details on the front disc and a snowy landscape on the back disc. Snowflakes detailed with blue and white stones decorate the charm, which is engraved with Olaf's famous saying: "I like warm hugs". The bail features sparkling pavé and engraved snowflakes on the sides. This charm will add a sprinkle of Olaf-inspired joy to your collection.

Wear a shining example of who you are with the Magnified Star Double Dangle Charm. This charm is delicately detailed with clear cubic zirconia that is cut like a magnifying glass to illuminate the stars covering the back disc. The dangle design is hand-finished in sterling silver, set with glittering stones and asymmetric cut-out stars. Wear it as part of your style story and a reminder to aim high and dream big.

product_name: Double Dangle Tree & Galaxy Moon Charm
description: Add a little night-time magic to your daytime look with the Double Dangle Tree & Galaxy Moon Charm.
